16.4.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ munīndrāḥ kathite prabhāve śaṃkareṇa tu ..
punaḥ papraccha sā devī kṛtāṃjalipuṭā satī .. 1 ..
16.4.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं मुनीन्द्राः कथिते प्रभावे शंकरेण तु ..
पुनः पप्रच्छ सा देवी कृतांजलिपुटा सती .. 1 ..
16.4.m: Sūta said: / When its majesty was thus declared by Śaṃkara, O chief sages, / the virtuous goddess asked again with joined palms.

16.4.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
devadeva jagannātha kṣetratīrthamaya prabho ..
prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyaṃ vistarātkathayasva me .. 2 ..
16.4.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
देवदेव जगन्नाथ क्षेत्रतीर्थमय प्रभो ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यं विस्तरात्कथयस्व मे .. 2 ..
16.4.m: The goddess said: / O God of gods, Lord of the universe, Lord who consists of sacred fields and sacred fords, / declare to me in detail the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya.

16.4.s:
kathaṃ tuṣyasi martyānāṃ kṣetre tatra vicetasām ..
japtaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ yaṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat ..
prabhāse tu mahākṣetre kasmāttatrākṣayaṃ bhavet .. 3 ..
16.4.d:
कथं तुष्यसि मर्त्यानां क्षेत्रे तत्र विचेतसाम् ..
जप्तं दत्तं हुतं यष्टं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत् ..
प्रभासे तु महाक्षेत्रे कस्मात्तत्राक्षयं भवेत् .. 3 ..
16.4.m: How are you pleased with foolish mortals in that sacred field? / Whatever is recited, given, offered in fire, sacrificed, and whatever austerity is performed— / why does it become imperishable there in the great sacred field of Prabhāsa?

16.4.s:
jātyaṃtarasahasreṣu yatpāpaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam ..
tatkathaṃ kṣayamāpnoti tanmamācakṣva śaṃkara .. 4 ..
16.4.d:
जात्यंतरसहस्रेषु यत्पापं पूर्वसंचितम् ..
तत्कथं क्षयमाप्नोति तन्ममाचक्ष्व शंकर .. 4 ..
16.4.m: Whatever sin has been accumulated previously through thousands of other births, / how does it meet its destruction? Tell me that, O Śaṃkara.

16.4.s:
yadi prabhāsaṃ sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ matam..
kimanyairbahubhistatra karttavyaṃ tīrthavistaraiḥ .. 5 ..
16.4.d:
यदि प्रभासं सर्वेषां तीर्थानां प्रवरं मतम्..
किमन्यैर्बहुभिस्तत्र कर्त्तव्यं तीर्थविस्तरैः .. 5 ..
16.4.m: If Prabhāsa is considered the foremost of all sacred fords, / what need is there for many other extensive sacred fords there?

16.4.s:
ekaṃ yadi bhavettīrthaṃ mano niḥsaṃśayaṃ bhavet ..
bahutve sati tīrthānāṃ mano vicalate nṛṇām .. 6 ..
16.4.d:
एकं यदि भवेत्तीर्थं मनो निःसंशयं भवेत् ..
बहुत्वे सति तीर्थानां मनो विचलते नृणाम् .. 6 ..
16.4.m: If there is only one sacred ford, the mind becomes free of doubt; / when there is a multiplicity of sacred fords, the minds of men waver.

16.4.s:
tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya tīrthajālaṃ savistaram ..
prabhāsasyaiva māhātmyaṃ kathayasva sureśvara .. 7 ..
16.4.d:
तस्मात्सर्वं परित्यज्य तीर्थजालं सविस्तरम् ..
प्रभासस्यैव माहात्म्यं कथयस्व सुरेश्वर .. 7 ..
16.4.m: Therefore, setting aside the entire vast collection of sacred fords, / declare the māhātmya of Prabhāsa alone, O ruler of gods.

16.4.s:
kṣetrapramāṇaṃ sīmāṃ ca kṣetrasāraṃ hi yatprabho ..
vaktumarhasi tatsarvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 8 .. ..
16.4.d:
क्षेत्रप्रमाणं सीमां च क्षेत्रसारं हि यत्प्रभो ..
वक्तुमर्हसि तत्सर्वं परं कौतूहलं हि मे .. 8 .. ..
16.4.m: The measure of the sacred field, its boundary, and the essence of the field, O Lord, / you ought to declare all that, for great indeed is my curiosity.

16.4.s:
īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kṣetrāṇāṃ kṣetramuttamam ..
sarvakṣetreṣu yatkṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ tu priyaṃ mama .. 9 ..
16.4.d:
ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि क्षेत्राणां क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
सर्वक्षेत्रेषु यत्क्षेत्रं प्रभासं तु प्रियं मम .. 9 ..
16.4.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall declare the best field among sacred fields, / that sacred field among all sacred fields, Prabhāsa, which is dear to me.

16.4.s:
prabhāse tu parā siddhiḥ prabhāse tu parā gatiḥ ..
yatra saṃnihito nityamahaṃ bhadre nirantaram .. 7.1.4.10 ..
16.4.d:
प्रभासे तु परा सिद्धिः प्रभासे तु परा गतिः ..
यत्र संनिहितो नित्यमहं भद्रे निरन्तरम् .. 7.1.4.10 ..
16.4.m: In Prabhāsa is the supreme perfection; in Prabhāsa is the supreme goal, / where I am always and constantly present, O auspicious lady.

16.4.s:
tasya pramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvasīmāsamanvitam..
kṣetraṃ tu trividha proktaṃ tatte vakṣyāmyanukramāt .. 11 ..
16.4.d:
तस्य प्रमाणं वक्ष्यामि सर्वसीमासमन्वितम्..
क्षेत्रं तु त्रिविध प्रोक्तं तत्ते वक्ष्याम्यनुक्रमात् .. 11 ..
16.4.m: I shall declare its extent, together with all its boundaries. / The sacred field is said to be threefold; that I shall tell you in order.

16.4.s:
kṣetraṃ pīṭhaṃ garbhagṛhaṃ prabhāsasya prakīrtyate ..
yathākramaṃ phalaṃ tasya koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ smṛtam .. 12 ..
16.4.d:
क्षेत्रं पीठं गर्भगृहं प्रभासस्य प्रकीर्त्यते ..
यथाक्रमं फलं तस्य कोटिकोटिगुणं स्मृतम् .. 12 ..
16.4.m: The field, the seat, and the inner sanctum of Prabhāsa are celebrated; / their fruits are remembered to be millions and millions of times greater in succession.

16.4.s:
kṣetraṃ tu prathamaṃ proktaṃ tacca dvādaśayojanam ..
pañcayojanamānena kṣetrapīṭhaṃ prakīrtitam .. 13 ..
16.4.d:
क्षेत्रं तु प्रथमं प्रोक्तं तच्च द्वादशयोजनम् ..
पञ्चयोजनमानेन क्षेत्रपीठं प्रकीर्तितम् .. 13 ..
16.4.m: The field is declared to be the first, and that is twelve yojanas. / The seat of the field is proclaimed to have a measure of five yojanas.

16.4.s:
garbhagṛhaṃ ca gavyūtiḥ karṇikā sā mama priyā ..
kṣetrasīmā pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi yathākramam .. 14 ..
16.4.d:
गर्भगृहं च गव्यूतिः कर्णिका सा मम प्रिया ..
क्षेत्रसीमा प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु देवि यथाक्रमम् .. 14 ..
16.4.m: And the inner sanctum is a gavyūti; that pericarp is dear to me. / I shall declare the boundary of the sacred field; listen, O goddess, in due order.

16.4.s:
āyāmavyāsataścaiva ādimadhyāntasaṃsthitam ..
pūrve taptodaka svāmī paścime mādhavaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 15 ..
16.4.d:
आयामव्यासतश्चैव आदिमध्यान्तसंस्थितम् ..
पूर्वे तप्तोदक स्वामी पश्चिमे माधवः स्मृतः .. 15 ..
16.4.m: In length and breadth, situated from beginning, middle, to end: / in the east is Taptodakasvāmin, in the west Mādhava is remembered,

16.4.s:
dakṣiṇe sāgarastadvadbhadrā nadyuttare matā ..
evaṃ sīmāsamāyuktaṃ kṣetraṃ dvādaśayojanam .. 16 ..
16.4.d:
दक्षिणे सागरस्तद्वद्भद्रा नद्युत्तरे मता ..
एवं सीमासमायुक्तं क्षेत्रं द्वादशयोजनम् .. 16 ..
16.4.m: in the south is the ocean, and likewise in the north the river Bhadrā is recognized. / Thus endowed with boundaries is the sacred field of twelve yojanas.

16.4.s:
etatprābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvapātakanāśanam..
tanmadhye pīṭhikā proktā pañcayojanavistṛtā .. 17 ..
16.4.d:
एतत्प्राभासिकं क्षेत्रं सर्वपातकनाशनम्..
तन्मध्ये पीठिका प्रोक्ता पञ्चयोजनविस्तृता .. 17 ..
16.4.m: This is the sacred field of Prabhāsa, destroying all sins. / Within it, the seat is declared to extend five yojanas.

16.4.s:
nyaṃkumanyapareṇaiva vajriṇyāḥ pūrvatastathā ..
māheśvaryā dakṣiṇataḥ samudrottaratastathā .. 18 ..
16.4.d:
न्यंकुमन्यपरेणैव वज्रिण्याः पूर्वतस्तथा ..
माहेश्वर्या दक्षिणतः समुद्रोत्तरतस्तथा .. 18 ..
16.4.m: To the west of the Nyaṅku river and to the east of Vajriṇī, / to the south of Māheśvarī and to the north of the ocean,

16.4.s:
āyāmavyāsataścaiva pañcayojanavistaram ..
pīṭhametatsamākhyātamatho garbhagṛhaṃ śṛṇu .. 19 ..
16.4.d:
आयामव्यासतश्चैव पञ्चयोजनविस्तरम् ..
पीठमेतत्समाख्यातमथो गर्भगृहं शृणु .. 19 ..
16.4.m: in length and breadth an extent of five yojanas, / this is declared to be the seat; now listen to the inner sanctum.

16.4.s:
dakṣiṇottarato yāvatsamudrā tkauraveśvarī ..
pūrvapaścimato yāvadgomukhāccāśvamedhikam ..
etadgarbhagṛhaṃ proktaṃ kailāsānmama vallabham .. 7.1.4.20 ..
16.4.d:
दक्षिणोत्तरतो यावत्समुद्रा त्कौरवेश्वरी ..
पूर्वपश्चिमतो यावद्गोमुखाच्चाश्वमेधिकम् ..
एतद्गर्भगृहं प्रोक्तं कैलासान्मम वल्लभम् .. 7.1.4.20 ..
16.4.m: From south to north, from the ocean as far as Kauraveśvarī; / from east to west, from Gomukha as far as Āśvamedhika: / this is declared to be the inner sanctum, dearer to me than Kailāsa.

16.4.s:
atrāntare tu deveśi yāni tīrthāni bhūtale ..
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca ..21..
16.4.d:
अत्रान्तरे तु देवेशि यानि तीर्थानि भूतले ..
वापीकूपतडागानि देवतायतनानि च ..21..
16.4.m: In this intervening space, O ruler of gods, whatever sacred fords there are on the earth, / stepped wells, wells, ponds, and temples of deities,

16.4.s:
sarāṃsi saritaścaiva palvalāni hradāstathā ..
tāni medhyāni sarvāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca..22..
16.4.d:
सरांसि सरितश्चैव पल्वलानि ह्रदास्तथा ..
तानि मेध्यानि सर्वाणि सर्वपापहराणि च..22..
16.4.m: lakes, rivers, puddles, and pools— / all of them are pure and destroy all sins.

16.4.s:
yatra tatra naraḥ snātvā svargaloke mahīyate ..
kṣetrasya prathamo bhāgo medhyo māheśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 23 ..
16.4.d:
यत्र तत्र नरः स्नात्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते ..
क्षेत्रस्य प्रथमो भागो मेध्यो माहेश्वरः स्मृतः .. 23 ..
16.4.m: Bathing anywhere [there], a man is honoured in the world of heaven. / The first pure portion of the field is remembered as belonging to Maheśvara;

16.4.s:
dvitīyo vaiṣṇavo bhāgo brahmabhāgastṛtīyakaḥ ..
tīrthānāṃ koṭirekā tu brāhme bhāge vyavasthitā .. 24 ..
16.4.d:
द्वितीयो वैष्णवो भागो ब्रह्मभागस्तृतीयकः ..
तीर्थानां कोटिरेका तु ब्राह्मे भागे व्यवस्थिता .. 24 ..
16.4.m: the second portion belongs to Viṣṇu, and the third portion belongs to Brahmā. / One crore of sacred fords is situated in the portion belonging to Brahmā,

16.4.s:
vaiṣṇave koṭirekā tu tīrthānāṃ varavarṇini ..
sārddhakoṭistu saṃproktā rudrabhāge ca madhyataḥ .. ..25..
16.4.d:
वैष्णवे कोटिरेका तु तीर्थानां वरवर्णिनि ..
सार्द्धकोटिस्तु संप्रोक्ता रुद्रभागे च मध्यतः .. ..25..
16.4.m: one crore of sacred fords is in the portion belonging to Viṣṇu, O fair-complexioned lady, / and one and a half crores are declared in the central portion belonging to Rudra.

16.4.s:
evaṃ devi samākhyātaṃ tatkṣetraṃ hi tridaivatam ..
guhyādguhyataraṃ kṣetraṃ mama priyataraṃ śubhe ..26..
16.4.d:
एवं देवि समाख्यातं तत्क्षेत्रं हि त्रिदैवतम् ..
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं क्षेत्रं मम प्रियतरं शुभे ..26..
16.4.m: Thus, O goddess, that sacred field has been declared to belong to three deities. / A sacred field more secret than the secret, it is most dear to me, O auspicious one.

16.4.s:
tisraḥ koṭyo'rddhakoṭiśca kṣetre proktā vibhāgataḥ ..
yātrā tu trividhā jñeyā tāṃ śṛṇuṣva varānane .. 27 ..
16.4.d:
तिस्रः कोट्योऽर्द्धकोटिश्च क्षेत्रे प्रोक्ता विभागतः ..
यात्रा तु त्रिविधा ज्ञेया तां शृणुष्व वरानने .. 27 ..
16.4.m: Three and a half crores [of sacred fords] are declared in the sacred field according to its divisions. / The pilgrimage is known to be threefold; listen to it, O fair-faced lady!

16.4.s:
raudrī tu prathamā yātrā vaiṣṇavī ca dvitīyikā..
brāhmī tṛtīyā saṃkhyātā sarvapātakanāśinī .. .. 28 ..
16.4.d:
रौद्री तु प्रथमा यात्रा वैष्णवी च द्वितीयिका..
ब्राह्मी तृतीया संख्याता सर्वपातकनाशिनी .. .. 28 ..
16.4.m: The first pilgrimage is of Rudra, the second of Viṣṇu, / and the third is recorded as of Brahmā, destroying all sins.

16.4.s:
brāhme vibhāge saṃproktā icchāśaktirvarānane ..
kriyā ca vaiṣṇave bhāge dvitīye tu prakīrtitā ..29..
16.4.d:
ब्राह्मे विभागे संप्रोक्ता इच्छाशक्तिर्वरानने ..
क्रिया च वैष्णवे भागे द्वितीये तु प्रकीर्तिता ..29..
16.4.m: In the division of Brahmā, the power of will (icchāśakti) is declared, O fair-faced lady; / and action (kriyāśakti) is proclaimed in the second division, that of Viṣṇu.

16.4.s:
raudre bhāge tṛtīye tu jñānaśaktirvarānane ..
yadi pāpo yadi śaṭho yadi naiṣkṛtiko naraḥ .. 7.1.4.30 ..
16.4.d:
रौद्रे भागे तृतीये तु ज्ञानशक्तिर्वरानने ..
यदि पापो यदि शठो यदि नैष्कृतिको नरः .. 7.1.4.30 ..
16.4.m: And in the third division, that of Rudra, the power of knowledge (jñānaśakti) [abides], O fair-faced lady. / Even if a man is sinful, even if he is deceitful, even if he is treacherous,

16.4.s:
nirmuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo madhyabhāge vasettu yaḥ ..
himavaṃtaṃ parityajya parvataṃ gaṃdhamādanam .. 31 ..
16.4.d:
निर्मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो मध्यभागे वसेत्तु यः ..
हिमवंतं परित्यज्य पर्वतं गंधमादनम् .. 31 ..
16.4.m: he is freed from all sins if he dwells in the central division. / Leaving the Himālaya and the Gandhamādana mountain,

16.4.s:
kailāsaṃ niṣadhaṃ caiva merupṛṣṭhaṃ mahādyutim ..
ramyaṃ triśikharaṃ caiva mānasaṃ ca mahāgirim ..32..
16.4.d:
कैलासं निषधं चैव मेरुपृष्ठं महाद्युतिम् ..
रम्यं त्रिशिखरं चैव मानसं च महागिरिम् ..32..
16.4.m: and Kailāsa, Niṣadha, and the brilliantly shining surface of Meru, / and the charming Triśikhara and the great mountain Mānasa,

16.4.s:
devodyānāni ramyāṇi naṃdanaṃ vanameva ca ..
svargasthānāni ramyāṇi tīrthānyāyatanāni ca ..
tāni sarvāṇi saṃtyajya prabhāse tu ratirmama .. 33 ..
16.4.d:
देवोद्यानानि रम्याणि नंदनं वनमेव च ..
स्वर्गस्थानानि रम्याणि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च ..
तानि सर्वाणि संत्यज्य प्रभासे तु रतिर्मम .. 33 ..
16.4.m: and the delightful gardens of the gods, and the Nandana forest, / the delightful dwellings of heaven, the sacred fords and temples— / abandoning all of them, my delight is in Prabhāsa.

16.4.s:
yastatra vasate devi saṃyatātmā samāhitaḥ ..
trikālamapi bhuṃjāno vāyubhakṣasamo bhavet .. 34 ..
16.4.d:
यस्तत्र वसते देवि संयतात्मा समाहितः ..
त्रिकालमपि भुंजानो वायुभक्षसमो भवेत् .. 34 ..
16.4.m: Whoever dwells there, O goddess, self-restrained and concentrated in mind, / even if eating at the three times [of day], becomes equal to one who lives on air.

16.4.s:
vighnairāloḍyamāno'pi yaḥ prabhāsaṃ na muṃcati ..
sa muṃcati jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ janmacakramaśāśvatam .. 35 ..
16.4.d:
विघ्नैरालोड्यमानोऽपि यः प्रभासं न मुंचति ..
स मुंचति जरां मृत्युं जन्मचक्रमशाश्वतम् .. 35 ..
16.4.m: Even when tossed about by obstacles, whoever does not abandon Prabhāsa / casts off old age, death, and the impermanent cycle of birth.

16.4.s:
janmāṃtaraśatairdevi yogo vā yadi labhyate ..
mokṣasya ca sahasreṇa janmanāṃ labhyate na ca .. 36 ..
16.4.d:
जन्मांतरशतैर्देवि योगो वा यदि लभ्यते ..
मोक्षस्य च सहस्रेण जन्मनां लभ्यते न च .. 36 ..
16.4.m: Even if yoga is obtained through hundreds of other births, O goddess, / liberation is still not obtained through a thousand births.

16.4.s:
prabhāse tu mahādevi ye sthitā kṛtaniścayāḥ ..
ekena janmanā teṣāṃ mokṣo naivātra saṃśayaḥ .. 37 ..
16.4.d:
प्रभासे तु महादेवि ये स्थिता कृतनिश्चयाः ..
एकेन जन्मना तेषां मोक्षो नैवात्र संशयः .. 37 ..
16.4.m: Those who abide in Prabhāsa with firm resolve, O great goddess— / their liberation occurs within a single birth; there is no doubt here.

16.4.s:
prabhāse tu sthitā ye vai brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ..
mṛtyuṃjayena saṃyuktaṃ japaṃti śatarudriyam .. 38 ..
16.4.d:
प्रभासे तु स्थिता ये वै ब्राह्मणाः संशितव्रताः ..
मृत्युंजयेन संयुक्तं जपंति शतरुद्रियम् .. 38 ..
16.4.m: Those brahmins of strict vows who dwell in Prabhāsa / and recite the Śatarudrīya joined with the Mṛtyuṃjaya [mantra],

16.4.s:
kālāgnirudrasāṃnidhye dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritāḥ ..
jñānaṃ cotpadyate tatra ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtareṇa tu .. 39 ..
16.4.d:
कालाग्निरुद्रसांनिध्ये दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रिताः ..
ज्ञानं चोत्पद्यते तत्र षण्मासाभ्यंतरेण तु .. 39 ..
16.4.m: resorting to the southern direction in the presence of Kālāgnirudra, / knowledge arises there [in them] within six months.

16.4.s:
śivastu procyate vedo nāmaparyāyavācakaiḥ ..
tasya cātmasvarūpaṃ tu śatarudraṃ prakīrtitam .. 7.1.4.40 ..
16.4.d:
शिवस्तु प्रोच्यते वेदो नामपर्यायवाचकैः ..
तस्य चात्मस्वरूपं तु शतरुद्रं प्रकीर्तितम् .. 7.1.4.40 ..
16.4.m: Śiva is declared by the Veda through synonyms of his names, / and the Śatarudra is proclaimed to be his essential self-nature.

16.4.s:
kalpeṣu vedāśca punaḥpunarāvartakāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
maṃtrāścaiva tathā devi muktvā tu śatarudriyam .. 41 ..
16.4.d:
कल्पेषु वेदाश्च पुनःपुनरावर्तकाः स्मृताः ..
मंत्राश्चैव तथा देवि मुक्त्वा तु शतरुद्रियम् .. 41 ..
16.4.m: In the cosmic cycles (kalpas), the Vedas are remembered as recurring again and again, / and the mantras likewise, O goddess, except for the Śatarudrīya.

16.4.s:
īḍyaṃ caiva tu maṃtreṇa māmeva hi yajaṃti ye ..
prabhāsakṣetramāsādya te muktā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 42 ..
16.4.d:
ईड्यं चैव तु मंत्रेण मामेव हि यजंति ये ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमासाद्य ते मुक्ता नात्र संशयः .. 42 ..
16.4.m: Those who, having reached the sacred field of Prabhāsa, / worship only me with that praiseworthy mantra, are liberated; there is no doubt here.

16.4.s:
samaṃtro'maṃtrako vāpi yastatra vasate naraḥ ..
so'pi yāṃ gatimāpnoti yajñairdānairna sādhyate .. 43 ..
16.4.d:
समंत्रोऽमंत्रको वापि यस्तत्र वसते नरः ..
सोऽपि यां गतिमाप्नोति यज्ञैर्दानैर्न साध्यते .. 43 ..
16.4.m: A man who dwells there, whether with mantra or without mantra, / also attains that state which cannot be accomplished by sacrifices or gifts.

16.4.s:
asmikṣetre svayaṃbhūśca sthitaḥ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ ..
rudrāṇāṃ koṭayaścaiva prabhāse saṃvyavasthitāḥ .. 44 ..
16.4.d:
अस्मिक्षेत्रे स्वयंभूश्च स्थितः साक्षान्महेश्वरः ..
रुद्राणां कोटयश्चैव प्रभासे संव्यवस्थिताः .. 44 ..
16.4.m: The self-manifest Maheśvara is visibly present in this sacred field, / and crores of Rudras are situated in Prabhāsa.

16.4.s: dhyāyamānāstathoṃkāraṃ sthitāḥ someśadakṣiṇe ..45 ..
16.4.d: ध्यायमानास्तथोंकारं स्थिताः सोमेशदक्षिणे ..45 ..
16.4.m: Meditating likewise on the syllable Oṃ, they dwell to the south of Someśa.

16.4.s:
brahmāṃḍodaramadhye tu yāni tīrthāni suvrate ..
someśvaraṃ gamiṣyaṃti vaiśākhasya caturdaśī ..46..
16.4.d:
ब्रह्मांडोदरमध्ये तु यानि तीर्थानि सुव्रते ..
सोमेश्वरं गमिष्यंति वैशाखस्य चतुर्दशी ..46..
16.4.m: Whatever sacred fords there are within the womb of the cosmic egg, O lady of good vows, / they go to Someśvara on the fourteenth day of Vaiśākha.

16.4.s:
manobuddhirahaṃkāraḥ kāmakrodhau tathā'pare ..
ete rakṣaṃti satataṃ someśaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 47 ..
16.4.d:
मनोबुद्धिरहंकारः कामक्रोधौ तथाऽपरे ..
एते रक्षंति सततं सोमेशं पापनाशनम् .. 47 ..
16.4.m: Mind, intellect, egoity, desire and anger, and others— / these constantly protect Someśa, the destroyer of sins.

16.4.s:
na sā gatiḥ kurukṣetre gaṃgādvāre tripuṣkare ..
yā gatirvihitā puṃsāṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinām .. 48 ..
16.4.d:
न सा गतिः कुरुक्षेत्रे गंगाद्वारे त्रिपुष्करे ..
या गतिर्विहिता पुंसां प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिनाम् .. 48 ..
16.4.m: That goal is not found in Kurukṣetra, at Gaṅgādvāra, or at Tripuṣkara, / which is ordained for men who dwell in the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.4.s:
tiryagyonigatāḥ sattvā ye prabhāse kṛtālayāḥ ..
kālena nidhanaṃ prāptāstepi yāṃti parāṃ gatim .. 49 ..
16.4.d:
तिर्यग्योनिगताः सत्त्वा ये प्रभासे कृतालयाः ..
कालेन निधनं प्राप्तास्तेपि यांति परां गतिम् .. 49 ..
16.4.m: Even creatures born in animal wombs who make their abode in Prabhāsa / and meet their end in the course of time attain the supreme goal.

16.4.s:
tadguhyaṃ devadevasya tattīrthaṃ tattapovanam ..
tatra brahmādayo devā nārāyaṇapurogamāḥ .. 7.1.4.50 ..
16.4.d:
तद्गुह्यं देवदेवस्य तत्तीर्थं तत्तपोवनम् ..
तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा नारायणपुरोगमाः .. 7.1.4.50 ..
16.4.m: That is the secret place of the God of gods, that sacred ford, that penance-grove; / there, the gods headed by Brahmā and led by Nārāyaṇa,

16.4.s:
yoginaśca tathā sāṃkhyā bhagavaṃtaṃ sanātanam ..
upāsate prabhāsaṃ tu madbhaktā matparāyaṇāḥ .. 51 ..
16.4.d:
योगिनश्च तथा सांख्या भगवंतं सनातनम् ..
उपासते प्रभासं तु मद्भक्ता मत्परायणाः .. 51 ..
16.4.m: as well as yogins and followers of Sāṃkhya, devoted to me and intent upon me, / worship the eternal Lord at Prabhāsa.

16.4.s:
aṣṭau māsānvihāraḥ syādyatīnāṃ saṃyatātmanām ..
eke ca caturo māsānaṣṭau vā niyataṃ vaset .. 52 ..
16.4.d:
अष्टौ मासान्विहारः स्याद्यतीनां संयतात्मनाम् ..
एके च चतुरो मासानष्टौ वा नियतं वसेत् .. 52 ..
16.4.m: For self-restrained ascetics, wandering should be for eight months; / and some say one should dwell fixedly for four months or for eight.

16.4.s:
prabhāse tu praviṣṭānāṃ vihārastu na vidyate ..
atra yogaśca mokṣaśca prāpyate durlabho naraiḥ .. 53 ..
16.4.d:
प्रभासे तु प्रविष्टानां विहारस्तु न विद्यते ..
अत्र योगश्च मोक्षश्च प्राप्यते दुर्लभो नरैः .. 53 ..
16.4.m: For those who have entered Prabhāsa, however, no wandering exists; / here yoga and liberation, so difficult for men to attain, are obtained.

16.4.s:
tasmātprabhāsaṃ saṃtyajya nānyadgacchettapovanam ..
prabhāsaṃ ye na sevaṃte mūḍhāste tamasā vṛtāḥ .. 54 ..
16.4.d:
तस्मात्प्रभासं संत्यज्य नान्यद्गच्छेत्तपोवनम् ..
प्रभासं ये न सेवंते मूढास्ते तमसा वृताः .. 54 ..
16.4.m: Therefore, one should not leave Prabhāsa and go to another penance-grove. / Those fools who do not resort to Prabhāsa are shrouded in darkness;

16.4.s:
viṇmūtraretasāṃ madhye saṃbhavaṃti punaḥpunaḥ ..
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho daṃbhaḥ staṃbho'tha matsaraḥ .. .. 55 ..
16.4.d:
विण्मूत्ररेतसां मध्ये संभवंति पुनःपुनः ..
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभो दंभः स्तंभोऽथ मत्सरः .. .. 55 ..
16.4.m: they are born again and again amidst feces, urine, and semen. / Desire, anger, greed, hypocrisy, arrogance, envy,

16.4.s:
nidrā taṃdrā tathā''lasyaṃ paiśunyamiti te daśa ..
ete rakṣaṃti satataṃ someśaṃ tīrthanāyakam .. 56 ..
16.4.d:
निद्रा तंद्रा तथा'ऽलस्यं पैशुन्यमिति ते दश ..
एते रक्षंति सततं सोमेशं तीर्थनायकम् .. 56 ..
16.4.m: sleep, torpor, laziness, and slander—these ten / constantly protect Someśa, the lord of sacred fords.

16.4.s:
na prabhāse mṛtaḥ kaścinnarakaṃ yāti kilbiṣī ..
yāvajjīvaṃ naro yastu vasate kṛtaniścayaḥ ..57..
16.4.d:
न प्रभासे मृतः कश्चिन्नरकं याति किल्बिषी ..
यावज्जीवं नरो यस्तु वसते कृतनिश्चयः ..57..
16.4.m: No sinner who dies in Prabhāsa goes to hell, / nor any man who dwells [there] with firm resolve as long as he lives.

16.4.s:
agnihotraiśca saṃnyāsairāśramaiśca supālitaiḥ ..
tridaṃḍairekadaṃḍaiśca śaivaiḥ pāśupatairapi ..58..
16.4.d:
अग्निहोत्रैश्च संन्यासैराश्रमैश्च सुपालितैः ..
त्रिदंडैरेकदंडैश्च शैवैः पाशुपतैरपि ..58..
16.4.m: Whatever auspicious reward is obtained through agnihotras, renunciation, well-kept hermitages, / by triple-staffed and single-staffed [ascetics], by Śaivas and Pāśupatas,

16.4.s:
etairanyaiśca yatibhiḥ prāpyate yatphalaṃ śubham ..
tatsarvaṃ labhyate devi śrīsomeśvarayātrayā .. 59 ..
eko hyarcayate liṃgaṃ tapasyati tathāparaḥ ..
tayormadhye tu śreṣṭho yaḥ someśaṃ ca prapūjayet ..7.1.4.6...
16.4.d:
एतैरन्यैश्च यतिभिः प्राप्यते यत्फलं शुभम् ..
तत्सर्वं लभ्यते देवि श्रीसोमेश्वरयात्रया .. 59 ..
एको ह्यर्चयते लिंगं तपस्यति तथापरः ..
तयोर्मध्ये तु श्रेष्ठो यः सोमेशं च प्रपूजयेत् ..7.1.4.6...
16.4.m:
and by other ascetics, / all of that is obtained, O goddess, by the pilgrimage to holy Someśvara.
One indeed worships the liṅga, while another performs austerity; / between the two, the one who worships Someśa is superior.

16.4.s:
yattadyoge ca sāṃkhye ca siddhāṃte paṃcarātrike ..
anyaiśca śāstrairvijñeyaṃ prabhāse saṃvyavasthitam ..61..
16.4.d:
यत्तद्योगे च सांख्ये च सिद्धांते पंचरात्रिके ..
अन्यैश्च शास्त्रैर्विज्ञेयं प्रभासे संव्यवस्थितम् ..61..
16.4.m: Whatever is to be known in Yoga, Sāṃkhya, the Siddhānta, the Pāñcarātra, / and other treatises is firmly established in Prabhāsa.

16.4.s:
liṃge caiva sthitaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram..
tasmālliṃge sadā devaḥ pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ .. 62 ..
16.4.d:
लिंगे चैव स्थितं सर्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम्..
तस्माल्लिंगे सदा देवः पूजनीयः प्रयत्नतः .. 62 ..
16.4.m: And in the liṅga resides this entire world, both moving and unmoving; / therefore the god should always be worshipped in the liṅga with diligence.

16.4.s:
mamaiva sā parā mūrtiḥ śrīsomeśākhyayā sthitā ..
tena caiṣā tmanātmānamārādhanaparo hyaham .. 63 ..
16.4.d:
ममैव सा परा मूर्तिः श्रीसोमेशाख्यया स्थिता ..
तेन चैषा त्मनात्मानमाराधनपरो ह्यहम् .. 63 ..
16.4.m: My supreme form itself abides under the name of holy Someśa; / therefore I myself, through myself, am intent upon worshipping myself.

16.4.s:
anekajanmasāhasrairbhramamāṇastu janmabhiḥ ..
kastāṃ prāpnoti vai muktiṃ vinā someśapūjanāt ..64..
16.4.d:
अनेकजन्मसाहस्रैर्भ्रममाणस्तु जन्मभिः ..
कस्तां प्राप्नोति वै मुक्तिं विना सोमेशपूजनात् ..64..
16.4.m: Wandering through many thousands of births, / who indeed attains that liberation without the worship of Someśa?

16.4.s:
yatkiñcidaśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ mānuṣabuddhinā ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti śrīsomeśvarapūjanāt ..65..
16.4.d:
यत्किञ्चिदशुभं कर्म कृतं मानुषबुद्धिना ..
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति श्रीसोमेश्वरपूजनात् ..65..
16.4.m: Whatever inauspicious deed was done with human understanding, / all of that vanishes through the worship of holy Someśvara.

16.4.s:
anekajanmakoṭībhirjaṃtubhiryatkṛtaṃ hyagham ..
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti śrīsomeśvarapūjanāt .. 66 ..
16.4.d:
अनेकजन्मकोटीभिर्जंतुभिर्यत्कृतं ह्यघम् ..
तत्सर्वं नाशमायाति श्रीसोमेश्वरपूजनात् .. 66 ..
16.4.m: Whatever sin has been committed by beings through crores of various births, / all of that comes to destruction through the worship of holy Someśvara.

16.4.s:
tīrthāni yāni loke'sminsevyaṃte pāpamokṣibhiḥ ..
tāni sarvāṇi śuddhyarthaṃ prabhāse saṃviśaṃti hi ..67..
16.4.d:
तीर्थानि यानि लोकेऽस्मिन्सेव्यंते पापमोक्षिभिः ..
तानि सर्वाणि शुद्ध्यर्थं प्रभासे संविशंति हि ..67..
16.4.m: Whatever sacred fords in this world are frequented by those seeking release from sin, / all of them indeed enter Prabhāsa for the sake of their purification.

16.4.s:
yo'sau kālāgnirudrastu procyate vedavādibhiḥ ..
so'yaṃ bhairavanāmnā tu prabhāse saṃvyavasthitaḥ .. 68 ..
16.4.d:
योऽसौ कालाग्निरुद्रस्तु प्रोच्यते वेदवादिभिः ..
सोऽयं भैरवनाम्ना तु प्रभासे संव्यवस्थितः .. 68 ..
16.4.m: He who is called Kālāgnirudra by those who expound the Veda / resides in Prabhāsa under the name of Bhairava.

16.4.s:
janānāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kṣetramadhye vyavasthitaḥ ..
bhairavaṃ rūpamāsthāya nāśayāmi sureśvari .. 69 ..
16.4.d:
जनानां दुष्कृतं सर्वं क्षेत्रमध्ये व्यवस्थितः ..
भैरवं रूपमास्थाय नाशयामि सुरेश्वरि .. 69 ..
16.4.m: Stationed within the sacred field, having assumed the form of Bhairava, / I destroy all the misdeeds of people, O ruler of gods!

16.4.s:
jagatsarvaṃ caritvā tu sthito'haṃ sacarācaram ..
tena bhairavanāmāhaṃ prabhāse saṃvyavasthitaḥ .. 7.1.4.70 ..
16.4.d:
जगत्सर्वं चरित्वा तु स्थितोऽहं सचराचरम् ..
तेन भैरवनामाहं प्रभासे संव्यवस्थितः .. 7.1.4.70 ..
16.4.m: Having roamed throughout the entire world, moving and unmoving, I have settled [here]; / therefore, bearing the name Bhairava, I reside in Prabhāsa.

16.4.s:
agninā yatra taptaṃ tu divyābdānāṃ caturyugam ..
meghavāhanakalpe tu tatra liṃgaṃ babhūva ha ..71..
16.4.d:
अग्निना यत्र तप्तं तु दिव्याब्दानां चतुर्युगम् ..
मेघवाहनकल्पे तु तत्र लिंगं बभूव ह ..71..
16.4.m: Where fire performed austerities for a four-age cycle of divine years, / there, indeed, the liṅga arose in the Meghavāhana kalpa. // 71

16.4.s:
agnimīḍeti vedoktaprabhāvaḥ surasuṃdari ..
kālāgnirudranāmā ca devaiḥ sarvairudāhṛtam .. 72 ..
16.4.d:
अग्निमीडेति वेदोक्तप्रभावः सुरसुंदरि ..
कालाग्निरुद्रनामा च देवैः सर्वैरुदाहृतम् .. 72 ..
16.4.m: O beautiful goddess, its glory is declared in the Veda with the words 'Agnim īḍe', / and it is called by all the gods by the name Kālāgnirudra. // 72

16.4.s:
agnīśāneti deveśi nāmatritayamucyate ..
kalpekalpe tu nāmāni kathituṃ naiva śakyate ..
asaṃkhyatvācca kalpānāṃ brahmaṇā ca varānane .. 73 ..
16.4.d:
अग्नीशानेति देवेशि नामत्रितयमुच्यते ..
कल्पेकल्पे तु नामानि कथितुं नैव शक्यते ..
असंख्यत्वाच्च कल्पानां ब्रह्मणा च वरानने .. 73 ..
16.4.m: O ruler of the gods, three names are proclaimed: Agni, Īśa, and Ina. / Yet in every kalpa the names cannot be fully told, / O fair-faced one, even by Brahmā, because the kalpas are countless. // 73

16.4.s:
evaṃ caiva rahasyaṃ ca mahāgopyaṃ varānane ..
snehānmahatyā bhaktyā ca mayā te parikīrtitam ..74..
16.4.d:
एवं चैव रहस्यं च महागोप्यं वरानने ..
स्नेहान्महत्या भक्त्या च मया ते परिकीर्तितम् ..74..
16.4.m: And so this secret, highly concealed, O fair-faced one, / has been proclaimed to you by me out of great love and devotion. // 74

16.4.s:
ekatastu jagatsarvaṃ karma kāṃḍe pratiṣṭhitam ..
yajñadānatapohomaiḥ svādhyāyaiḥ pitṛtarpaṇaiḥ ..75..
16.4.d:
एकतस्तु जगत्सर्वं कर्म कांडे प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
यज्ञदानतपोहोमैः स्वाध्यायैः पितृतर्पणैः ..75..
16.4.m: On the one side stands the entire world established in the ritual section, / through sacrifices, gifts, austerities, oblations, personal recitations, and libations to ancestors, // 75

16.4.s:
upavāsairvrataiḥ kṛtsnaiścāṃdrāyaṇaśataistathā ..
ṣaḍrātraiśca trirātraiśca tīrthādigamanaiḥ paraiḥ ..76..
16.4.d:
उपवासैर्व्रतैः कृत्स्नैश्चांद्रायणशतैस्तथा ..
षड्रात्रैश्च त्रिरात्रैश्च तीर्थादिगमनैः परैः ..76..
16.4.m: through fasts, entire observances, and hundreds of cāndrāyaṇa penances, / through six-night and three-night fasts, and eminent journeys to sacred fords and other holy places, // 76

16.4.s:
āśramairvividhākārairyatibhirbrahmacāribhiḥ ..
vānaprasthairgṛhasthaiśca vedakarmaparāyaṇaiḥ ..77..
16.4.d:
आश्रमैर्विविधाकारैर्यतिभिर्ब्रह्मचारिभिः ..
वानप्रस्थैर्गृहस्थैश्च वेदकर्मपरायणैः ..77..
16.4.m: through the stages of life of various forms—renunciants and celibate students, / forest dwellers and householders devoted to Vedic rituals— // 77

16.4.s:
anyaiśca vividhākārairlokamārgasthitaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
na tatpadaṃ paraṃ devi śakyaṃ vīkṣayituṃ kvacit .. 78 ..
16.4.d:
अन्यैश्च विविधाकारैर्लोकमार्गस्थितैः शुभैः ..
न तत्पदं परं देवि शक्यं वीक्षयितुं क्वचित् .. 78 ..
16.4.m: and through other auspicious ways of life established on worldly paths. / Yet that supreme state, O goddess, cannot be seen anywhere [by such means], // 78

16.4.s:
yāvanna cārcayeddevi someśaṃ liṃganāyakam ..
līlayā vāpi tairdraṣṭuṃ tatpadaṃ durlabhaṃ param .. 79 ..
16.4.d:
यावन्न चार्चयेद्देवि सोमेशं लिंगनायकम् ..
लीलया वापि तैर्द्रष्टुं तत्पदं दुर्लभं परम् .. 79 ..
16.4.m: as long as one does not worship Someśa, the sovereign of liṅgas, O goddess. / Even in play, that supreme state is difficult for them to behold. // 79

16.4.s:
pūjito yairjagannāthaḥ someśaḥ kila bhairavaḥ ..
tiryagyonigatā ye tu paśupakṣipipīlikāḥ .. 7.1.4.80 ..
16.4.d:
पूजितो यैर्जगन्नाथः सोमेशः किल भैरवः ..
तिर्यग्योनिगता ये तु पशुपक्षिपिपीलिकाः .. 7.1.4.80 ..
16.4.m: Those who have worshipped the Lord of the Universe, Someśa, indeed Bhairava— / even those who have entered animal wombs: beasts, birds, and ants, // 80

16.4.s:
antarjjalagatā ye tu kṛmikīṭapataṃgakāḥ ..
sthāvarā jaṃgamāścānye manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ striyaḥ .. 8! ..
bālā vṛddhāstathā ṣaṇḍhāḥ śvānagarddabhavāyasāḥ ..
caṃḍālāḥ puṣkasāḥ śūdrā mlecchā ye'nye viyonijāḥ .. 82 ..
16.4.d:
अन्तर्ज्जलगता ये तु कृमिकीटपतंगकाः ..
स्थावरा जंगमाश्चान्ये मनुष्याः पशवः स्त्रियः .. 8! ..
बाला वृद्धास्तथा षण्ढाः श्वानगर्द्दभवायसाः ..
चंडालाः पुष्कसाः शूद्रा म्लेच्छा येऽन्ये वियोनिजाः .. 82 ..
16.4.m: those residing in water: worms, insects, and moths; / other motionless and moving beings, men, beasts, women, / children, the elderly, eunuchs, dogs, donkeys, crows, / outcasts, caṇḍālas, puṣkasas, śūdras, mlecchas, and whatever others are of impure birth, // 81–82

16.4.s:
mūrkhāstu paṇḍitāścāpi ye cānye kutsitā bhuvi ..
te sarve muktimāyāṃti prabhāse ye mṛtāḥ śubhe .. 83 ..
16.4.d:
मूर्खास्तु पण्डिताश्चापि ये चान्ये कुत्सिता भुवि ..
ते सर्वे मुक्तिमायांति प्रभासे ये मृताः शुभे .. 83 ..
16.4.m: fools as well as scholars, and whatever other vile beings there are on earth— / all of them attain liberation if they die in auspicious Prabhāsa. // 83

16.4.s:
kālānalasya rudrasya kālarājena cāgninā ..
dagdhāste jantavaḥ sarve prabhāse ye mṛtāḥ śubhe .. 84 ..
16.4.d:
कालानलस्य रुद्रस्य कालराजेन चाग्निना ..
दग्धास्ते जन्तवः सर्वे प्रभासे ये मृताः शुभे .. 84 ..
16.4.m: By the fire of Rudra the all-destroying flame, and by the fire of Kalarāja, / all those creatures who die in auspicious Prabhāsa are consumed [and purified]. // 84

16.4.s:
durllabhaṃ tu mama kṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ devi pāpinām ..
na tatra labhate mṛtyuṃ pāpātmā lokavaṃdite .. 85 ..
16.4.d:
दुर्ल्लभं तु मम क्षेत्रं प्रभासं देवि पापिनाम् ..
न तत्र लभते मृत्युं पापात्मा लोकवंदिते .. 85 ..
16.4.m: Yet my sacred field, Prabhāsa, O goddess, is hard for sinners to reach; / a sinful soul does not meet death there, O one praised by the world. // 85

16.4.s:
mayā dakṣiṇabhāge ca vighneśaḥ saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
uttare daṇḍapāṇistu kṣetrametacca rakṣati .. 86 ..
16.4.d:
मया दक्षिणभागे च विघ्नेशः संप्रतिष्ठितः ..
उत्तरे दण्डपाणिस्तु क्षेत्रमेतच्च रक्षति .. 86 ..
16.4.m: By me Vighneśa was established on the southern side, / and Daṇḍapāṇi guards this sacred field on the north. // 86

16.4.s:
tathānye gaṇapāḥ sarve madājñāvaśavartinaḥ ..
kṣetraṃ rakṣaṃti deveśi teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu .. 87 ..
16.4.d:
तथान्ये गणपाः सर्वे मदाज्ञावशवर्तिनः ..
क्षेत्रं रक्षंति देवेशि तेषां नामानि मे शृणु .. 87 ..
16.4.m: Likewise, all the other leaders of gaṇas, obedient to my command, / protect the sacred field, O ruler of the gods; hear their names from me: // 87

16.4.s:
mahābalastu caṇḍīśo ghaṃṭākarṇastu gomukhaḥ ..
vināyako mahānādaḥ kākavaktraḥ śubhekṣaṇaḥ ..
ekākṣo dundubhiścaṃḍastālajaṃghastathaiva ca .. 88 ..
16.4.d:
महाबलस्तु चण्डीशो घंटाकर्णस्तु गोमुखः ..
विनायको महानादः काकवक्त्रः शुभेक्षणः ..
एकाक्षो दुन्दुभिश्चंडस्तालजंघस्तथैव च .. 88 ..
16.4.m: Mahābala, Caṇḍīśa, Ghaṇṭākarṇa, Gomukha, / Vināyaka, Mahānāda, Kākavaktra, Śubhekṣaṇa, / Ekākṣa, Dundubhi, Caṇḍa, and likewise Tālajaṅgha, // 88

16.4.s:
bhūmidaṃḍaśca caṃḍaśca śaṃkukarṇaśca vaidhṛtiḥ ..
tālacaṇḍo mahātejā vikaṭāsyo hayānanaḥ .. 989 ..
hastivaktraḥ śvānavaktro biḍālavadanastathā ..
siṃhavyāghramukhāścānye vīrabhadrādayastathā .. 7.1.4.90 ..
vināyakaṃ puraskṛtya deva devaṃ kaparddinam ..
ekādaśa tathā koṭyo niyutāni trayodaśa .. 91 ..
arbudaṃ ca gaṇānāṃ ca prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritāḥ ..
dvāridvāri pracaṃḍāste śūlamudgarapāṇayaḥ .. 92 ..
prabhāsakṣetraṃ rakṣaṃti devadevasya vai gṛham ..
na kaścidduṣṭabuddhyā tu praviśediti saṃsthitiḥ .. 93 ..
śatakoṭigaṇaiścāpi pūrvadvāri tu saṃvṛtaḥ ..
aṭṭahāso gaṇo nāma prabhāsaṃ tatra rakṣati .. 94 ..
kālākṣo bhīṣaṇaścaṃḍo vṛto'ṣṭādaśakoṭibhiḥ ..
ghaṃṭākarṇagaṇo nāma dakṣiṇaṃ dvāramāśritaḥ ..95..
paścimadvāramāśritya sthitavānviṣṭaro gaṇaḥ ..
daṇḍapāṇiḥ sthitastatra devadevasya cottare ..96..
16.4.d:
भूमिदंडश्च चंडश्च शंकुकर्णश्च वैधृतिः ..
तालचण्डो महातेजा विकटास्यो हयाननः .. 989 ..
हस्तिवक्त्रः श्वानवक्त्रो बिडालवदनस्तथा ..
सिंहव्याघ्रमुखाश्चान्ये वीरभद्रादयस्तथा .. 7.1.4.90 ..
विनायकं पुरस्कृत्य देव देवं कपर्द्दिनम् ..
एकादश तथा कोट्यो नियुतानि त्रयोदश .. 91 ..
अर्बुदं च गणानां च प्रभासं क्षेत्रमाश्रिताः ..
द्वारिद्वारि प्रचंडास्ते शूलमुद्गरपाणयः .. 92 ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रं रक्षंति देवदेवस्य वै गृहम् ..
न कश्चिद्दुष्टबुद्ध्या तु प्रविशेदिति संस्थितिः .. 93 ..
शतकोटिगणैश्चापि पूर्वद्वारि तु संवृतः ..
अट्टहासो गणो नाम प्रभासं तत्र रक्षति .. 94 ..
कालाक्षो भीषणश्चंडो वृतोऽष्टादशकोटिभिः ..
घंटाकर्णगणो नाम दक्षिणं द्वारमाश्रितः ..95..
पश्चिमद्वारमाश्रित्य स्थितवान्विष्टरो गणः ..
दण्डपाणिः स्थितस्तत्र देवदेवस्य चोत्तरे ..96..
16.4.m:
Bhūmidaṇḍa, Caṇḍa, Śaṅkukarṇa, Vaidhṛti, / Tālacaṇḍa, Mahātejas, Vikaṭāsya, Hayānana, // 89
Hastivaktra, Śvānavaktra, Biḍālavadana, / and others with faces of lions and tigers, as well as Vīrabhadra and the rest. // 90
Placing Vināyaka at their head, [they serve] the god of gods, the matted-haired one. / Eleven crores, thirteen millions, // 91
and one hundred million gaṇas resort to the sacred field of Prabhāsa. / Fierce at every gate, they hold tridents and clubs in their hands. // 92
They protect the sacred field of Prabhāsa, the very dwelling of the God of gods; / it is ordained that no one may enter with wicked intent. // 93
Surrounded by a hundred crore gaṇas at the eastern gate, / the gaṇa named Aṭṭahāsa protects Prabhāsa there. // 94
The gaṇa named Ghaṇṭākarṇa—dark-eyed, terrifying, and fierce— / surrounded by eighteen crores, guards the southern gate. // 95
Resorting to the western gate stands the gaṇa Viṣṭara; / Daṇḍapāṇi stands on the north of the God of gods, // 96

16.4.s:
yogakṣemaṃ vahannityaṃ prabhāse bhāvitātmanām..
bhīṣaṇākṣastathaiśānyāmāgneyyāṃ chāgavaktrakaḥ .. 97 ..
nairṛtyāṃ caṃḍanādastu vāyavyāṃ bhairavānanaḥ ..
nandī caiva mahākālo daṇḍapāṇirvināyakaḥ .. .. 98 ..
eteṅgarakṣakā madhye śatakoṭigaṇairvṛtāḥ ..
evaṃ rakṣaṃti bahavo hyasaṃkhyeyā gaṇeśvarāḥ .. 99 ..
kalikalmaṣasaṃbhūtyā yeṣāṃ copahatā matiḥ ..
na teṣāṃ tadbhavedgamyaṃ sthānamardhendumaulinaḥ .. 7.1.4.100 ..
gaṃdharvaiḥ kinnarairyakṣairapsarobhistathoragaiḥ ..
siddhaiḥ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ someśaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 101 ..
antardhānaṃ gatairnityaṃ prabhāsaṃ tu niṣevyate ..
saptalokeṣu ye santi siddhāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ ..
pradakṣiṇaṃ te kurvaṃti someśaṃ kālabhairavam .. 102 ...
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca ..
lākuliṃ bhārabhūtiṃ ca āṣāḍhiṃ daṇḍameva ca .. 103 ..
16.4.d:
योगक्षेमं वहन्नित्यं प्रभासे भावितात्मनाम्..
भीषणाक्षस्तथैशान्यामाग्नेय्यां छागवक्त्रकः .. 97 ..
नैरृत्यां चंडनादस्तु वायव्यां भैरवाननः ..
नन्दी चैव महाकालो दण्डपाणिर्विनायकः .. .. 98 ..
एतेङ्गरक्षका मध्ये शतकोटिगणैर्वृताः ..
एवं रक्षंति बहवो ह्यसंख्येया गणेश्वराः .. 99 ..
कलिकल्मषसंभूत्या येषां चोपहता मतिः ..
न तेषां तद्भवेद्गम्यं स्थानमर्धेन्दुमौलिनः .. 7.1.4.100 ..
गंधर्वैः किन्नरैर्यक्षैरप्सरोभिस्तथोरगैः ..
सिद्धैः संपूज्य देवेशं सोमेशं पापनाशनम् .. 101 ..
अन्तर्धानं गतैर्नित्यं प्रभासं तु निषेव्यते ..
सप्तलोकेषु ये सन्ति सिद्धाः पातालवासिनः ..
प्रदक्षिणं ते कुर्वंति सोमेशं कालभैरवम् .. 102 ...
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च ..
लाकुलिं भारभूतिं च आषाढिं दण्डमेव च .. 103 ..
16.4.m:
ever securing the welfare of the devout in Prabhāsa. / Likewise, Bhīṣaṇākṣa is in the northeast, and Chāgavaktraka in the southeast; // 97
Caṇḍanāda is in the southwest, and Bhairavānana in the northwest. / Nandin, Mahākāla, Daṇḍapāṇi, and Vināyaka— // 98
these bodyguards stand in the middle, surrounded by a hundred crore gaṇas. / Thus do numerous, innumerable lords of gaṇas protect [it]. // 99
Those whose minds are corrupted by the rise of Kali-age defilement / cannot reach that abode of the crescent-crested god. // 100
Having worshipped Someśa, the Lord of gods, the destroyer of sins, / gandharvas, kinnaras, yakṣas, apsarases, uragas, // 101
and siddhas attend upon Prabhāsa, having become invisible. / The siddhas living in Pātāla who dwell in the seven realms / circumambulate Someśa, who is Kālabhairava. // 102
Whatever sacred fords and holy sanctuaries there are on earth— / Lākuli, Bhārabhūti, Āṣāḍhi, Daṇḍa, // 103

16.4.s:
puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ caiva amareśaṃ tathāparam ...
bhairavaṃ madhyamaṃ kālaṃ kedāraṃ kaṇavīrakam .. 104 ..
haricaṃdrastu śaileśastathā vastrāṃtikeśvaraḥ ..
aṭṭahāsaṃ mahendraṃ ca śrīśailaṃ ca gayā tathā .. 105 ..
etāni sarvatīrthāni devaṃ someśvaraṃ prabhum ..
pradakṣiṇaṃ prakurvaṃti tatra liṃgaṃ stuvaṃti ca .. 106 ..
brahmā janārdanaścānye ye devā jagati sthitāḥ ..
agniliṃgasamīpasthāḥ saṃdhyākāle stuvaṃti ca .. 107 ..
ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca ..
sarve someśvaraṃ yāṃti māghakṛṣṇacaturddaśīm ... .. 108 ..
tasminkāle ca yo dadyātsomeśe ghṛtakambalam .. 109 ..
ghṛtaṃ rasaṃ tilāndugdhaṃ jalaṃ caṃdrādhivāsitam ..
ekatra kṛtvā kāśmīramityetadghṛtakaṃbalam ..7.1.4.110...
śivarātryāṃ tu karttavyametadgopyaṃ mama priyam ..
evaṃ kṛte ca yatpuṇyaṃ gadituṃ tanna śakyate .. 111 ..
16.4.d:
पुष्करं नैमिषं चैव अमरेशं तथापरम् ...
भैरवं मध्यमं कालं केदारं कणवीरकम् .. 104 ..
हरिचंद्रस्तु शैलेशस्तथा वस्त्रांतिकेश्वरः ..
अट्टहासं महेन्द्रं च श्रीशैलं च गया तथा .. 105 ..
एतानि सर्वतीर्थानि देवं सोमेश्वरं प्रभुम् ..
प्रदक्षिणं प्रकुर्वंति तत्र लिंगं स्तुवंति च .. 106 ..
ब्रह्मा जनार्दनश्चान्ये ये देवा जगति स्थिताः ..
अग्निलिंगसमीपस्थाः संध्याकाले स्तुवंति च .. 107 ..
षष्टिकोटिसहस्राणि षष्टिकोटिशतानि च ..
सर्वे सोमेश्वरं यांति माघकृष्णचतुर्द्दशीम् ... .. 108 ..
तस्मिन्काले च यो दद्यात्सोमेशे घृतकम्बलम् .. 109 ..
घृतं रसं तिलान्दुग्धं जलं चंद्राधिवासितम् ..
एकत्र कृत्वा काश्मीरमित्येतद्घृतकंबलम् ..7.1.4.110...
शिवरात्र्यां तु कर्त्तव्यमेतद्गोप्यं मम प्रियम् ..
एवं कृते च यत्पुण्यं गदितुं तन्न शक्यते .. 111 ..
16.4.m:
Puṣkara, Naimiṣa, and also Amareśa, / Bhairava, Madhyama, Kāla, Kedāra, Kaṇavīraka, // 104
Hariścandra, Śaileśa, Vastrāntikeśvara, / Aṭṭahāsa, Mahendra, Śrīśaila, and Gayā— // 105
all these sacred fords circumambulate the lord, the god Someśvara, / and praise the liṅga there. // 106
Brahmā, Janārdana, and whatever other gods abide in the world, / stand near the fire-liṅga and praise it at the twilight hour. // 107
Sixty thousand crores and sixty hundred crores [of beings] / all go to Someśvara on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha. // 108
And whoever at that time offers a blanket of ghee upon Someśa— // 109
Ghee, sugarcane juice, sesame seeds, milk, water perfumed with camphor, / combined together with saffron: this is the blanket of ghee. // 110
This secret, dear to me, should be performed on Śivarātri; / the merit acquired when this is done cannot be described. // 111

16.4.s:
tatra dakṣiṇabhāge tu svayaṃ bhūtavināyakam ..
prathamaṃ pūjayeddevi yadīcchetsiddhimātmanaḥ ..112..
ūṣarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ prabhāsakṣetramūṣaram ..
pīṭhānāṃ caiva pīṭhaṃ ca kṣetrāṇāṃ kṣetramuttamam ..
sandehānāṃ ca sarveṣāmayaṃ saṃdeha uttamaḥ .. 113 ..
ye kecidyoginaḥ saṃti śatakoṭipravistarāḥ ..
teṣāṃ kṣetre prabhāse tu ratirnnānyatra kutracit ... .. 114 ..
liṃgādīśānabhāge tu saṃsthitā surasundari .. 115 ..
mayā yā kathitā tubhyamumā nāma kalā śubhā ..
sā satī procyate devi dakṣasya duhitā purā .. 116 ..
dakṣakopāccharīraṃ tu saṃtyajya paramā kalā ..
himavaṃtagṛhe jātā umānāmnā ca viśrutā .. 117 ..
tena devi tvayā sārddhaṃ tatrasthā varadāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
navakoṭyastu cāmuṃḍāstasminkṣetre sthitāḥ svayam .. 118 ..
16.4.d:
तत्र दक्षिणभागे तु स्वयं भूतविनायकम् ..
प्रथमं पूजयेद्देवि यदीच्छेत्सिद्धिमात्मनः ..112..
ऊषराणां च सर्वेषां प्रभासक्षेत्रमूषरम् ..
पीठानां चैव पीठं च क्षेत्राणां क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
सन्देहानां च सर्वेषामयं संदेह उत्तमः .. 113 ..
ये केचिद्योगिनः संति शतकोटिप्रविस्तराः ..
तेषां क्षेत्रे प्रभासे तु रतिर्न्नान्यत्र कुत्रचित् ... .. 114 ..
लिंगादीशानभागे तु संस्थिता सुरसुन्दरि .. 115 ..
मया या कथिता तुभ्यमुमा नाम कला शुभा ..
सा सती प्रोच्यते देवि दक्षस्य दुहिता पुरा .. 116 ..
दक्षकोपाच्छरीरं तु संत्यज्य परमा कला ..
हिमवंतगृहे जाता उमानाम्ना च विश्रुता .. 117 ..
तेन देवि त्वया सार्द्धं तत्रस्था वरदाः स्मृताः ..
नवकोट्यस्तु चामुंडास्तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे स्थिताः स्वयम् .. 118 ..
16.4.m:
There on the southern side, O goddess, one should first worship / the self-manifest Vināyaka, if one desires one's own success. // 112
And of all saline lands, the Prabhāsa sacred field is the supreme saline land; / and of all seats, it is the seat; and of all sacred fields, it is the best. / And of all questions, this question is the highest.
Whatever yogins exist, numbering in hundreds of millions, / their delight is solely in the Prabhāsa sacred field and nowhere else.
In the northeast portion from the liṅga, O beautiful goddess, she is situated.
That auspicious portion named Umā, who was described by me to you, / is said to be Satī, O goddess, the daughter of Dakṣa in ancient times.
Having abandoned her body out of anger toward Dakṣa, that supreme portion / was born in the house of Himavat and became renowned by the name of Umā.
Therefore, O goddess, [the goddesses] residing there with you are remembered as boongivers; / and indeed, ninety million Cāmuṇḍās are present in that sacred field by themselves.

16.4.s:
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ tatra tvāṃ yadi pūjayet ..
eka viṃśatijanmāni dāridryaṃ tasya no bhavet .. 119 ..
amā somena saṃyuktā kadācidyadi labhyate ..
tasyāṃ someśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet .. .. 7.1.4.120 ..
etatkṣetraṃ mahāguhyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam..
rudrāṇāṃ koṭayo yatra ekādaśa samāsate ..121..
dvādaśātra dineśānāṃ vasavo'ṣṭau samāgatāḥ ..
gandharvayakṣarakṣāṃsi asaṃkhyātā gaṇeśvarāḥ ..122..
umāpi tatra pārśvasthā sarvadevaistu saṃstutā ..
nandī ca gaṇanātho yo devadevasya śūlinaḥ..123..
mahākālasya ye cānye gaṇapāḥ saṃti pārśvagāḥ ..
gaṃgā ca yamunā caiva tathā devī sarasvatī ..124..
anyāśca saritaḥ puṇyā nadāścaiva hradāstathā ..
samudrāḥ parvatāḥ kūpā vanaspataya eva ca .. 125 ..
16.4.d:
चैत्रे मासि सिताष्टम्यां तत्र त्वां यदि पूजयेत् ..
एक विंशतिजन्मानि दारिद्र्यं तस्य नो भवेत् .. 119 ..
अमा सोमेन संयुक्ता कदाचिद्यदि लभ्यते ..
तस्यां सोमेश्वरं दृष्ट्वा कोटियज्ञफलं लभेत् .. .. 7.1.4.120 ..
एतत्क्षेत्रं महागुह्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम्..
रुद्राणां कोटयो यत्र एकादश समासते ..121..
द्वादशात्र दिनेशानां वसवोऽष्टौ समागताः ..
गन्धर्वयक्षरक्षांसि असंख्याता गणेश्वराः ..122..
उमापि तत्र पार्श्वस्था सर्वदेवैस्तु संस्तुता ..
नन्दी च गणनाथो यो देवदेवस्य शूलिनः..123..
महाकालस्य ये चान्ये गणपाः संति पार्श्वगाः ..
गंगा च यमुना चैव तथा देवी सरस्वती ..124..
अन्याश्च सरितः पुण्या नदाश्चैव ह्रदास्तथा ..
समुद्राः पर्वताः कूपा वनस्पतय एव च .. 125 ..
16.4.m:
If one worships you there on the bright eighth day in the month of Caitra, / for twenty-one births poverty will not befall him.
If a new moon day combined with Monday is ever obtained, / having beheld Someśvara on that day, one attains the fruit of ten million sacrifices.
This sacred field is extremely secret and destroys all sins, / where eleven crores of Rudras reside together.
Here twelve sun gods have assembled, and eight Vasus, / gandharvas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, and innumerable lords of gaṇas.
Umā too is situated at the side there, praised by all the gods, / and Nandī, who is the commander of gaṇas for the trident-bearing God of gods,
and the other leaders of gaṇas who accompany Mahākāla, / as well as Gaṅgā, Yamunā, and the goddess Sarasvatī,
and other sacred streams, rivers, and likewise lakes, / oceans, mountains, wells, and trees—

16.4.s:
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ caiva prabhāse tu samāgatam ..
anye caiva gaṇāstatra prabhāse saṃvyavasthitāḥ .. ..126..
na mayā kathitāḥ sarva uddeśena kvacitkvacit ..
bhaktyā paramayā yukto devadevi vināyakam ..
tṛtīyaṃ pūjayettatra vāṃchetkṣetraphalaṃ yadi..127..
dvādaśaivaṃ tathā cāṣṭau catvāriṃśacca koṭayaḥ ..
nadīnāmagnitīrthasya dvāre tiṣṭhaṃti bhāmini .. 128 ..
nirmālyalaṃghanaṃ kiṃcidajñātādyadi vai kṛtam ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti agnitīrthasya darśanāt ..129..
devi kiṃ bahunoktena kṣetrametanmahāprabham ..
na te varṇayituṃ śakyaṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi..7.1.4.13...
ye cāṃtarikṣe bhuvi ye ca devāstīrthāni vai yāni digaṃtareṣu ..
kṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ pravaraṃ hi teṣāṃ someśvaraṃ devi tathā variṣṭham ..131..
16.4.d:
स्थावरं जंगमं चैव प्रभासे तु समागतम् ..
अन्ये चैव गणास्तत्र प्रभासे संव्यवस्थिताः .. ..126..
न मया कथिताः सर्व उद्देशेन क्वचित्क्वचित् ..
भक्त्या परमया युक्तो देवदेवि विनायकम् ..
तृतीयं पूजयेत्तत्र वांछेत्क्षेत्रफलं यदि..127..
द्वादशैवं तथा चाष्टौ चत्वारिंशच्च कोटयः ..
नदीनामग्नितीर्थस्य द्वारे तिष्ठंति भामिनि .. 128 ..
निर्माल्यलंघनं किंचिदज्ञाताद्यदि वै कृतम् ..
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति अग्नितीर्थस्य दर्शनात् ..129..
देवि किं बहुनोक्तेन क्षेत्रमेतन्महाप्रभम् ..
न ते वर्णयितुं शक्यं कल्पकोटिशतैरपि..7.1.4.13...
ये चांतरिक्षे भुवि ये च देवास्तीर्थानि वै यानि दिगंतरेषु ..
क्षेत्रं प्रभासं प्रवरं हि तेषां सोमेश्वरं देवि तथा वरिष्ठम् ..131..
16.4.m:
everything stationary and moving has gathered in Prabhāsa, / and other gaṇas are established there in Prabhāsa.
They have not all been spoken of by me, [save] here and there by indication. / Endowed with supreme devotion, O goddess of gods, one should worship the third Vināyaka / there, if one desires the fruit of the sacred field.
Twelve, eight, and forty crores / of rivers stand at the entrance of Agnitīrtha, O beautiful woman.
If any stepping over the leftover offerings was done through ignorance, / all of that dissolves upon the darśana of Agnitīrtha.
O goddess, what is the use of speaking much? This sacred field of great splendor / cannot be described to you even in hundreds of crores of kalpas.
Whatever gods are in the atmosphere and on earth, and whatever sacred fords are in all directions, / the sacred field of Prabhāsa is indeed the foremost of them, O goddess, and Someśvara is the highest.

16.4.s:
ye cāṃḍajāścodbhijāścaiva jīvāḥ sasvedajāścaiva jarāyujāśca ..
devi prabhāse tu gatāsavo'tha muktiṃ paraṃ yāṃti na saṃśayo'tra .. 132 ..
iti nigaditametaddevadevasya citraṃ caritamidamaciṃtyaṃ devi te śaṃkarasya ..
kalikaluṣavidāraṃ sarvaloko'pi yāyādyadi paṭhati śṛṇoti stauti nityaṃ ya ittham .. 133 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kṣetrapramāṇavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ .. 4 ..
16.4.d:
ये चांडजाश्चोद्भिजाश्चैव जीवाः सस्वेदजाश्चैव जरायुजाश्च ..
देवि प्रभासे तु गतासवोऽथ मुक्तिं परं यांति न संशयोऽत्र .. 132 ..
इति निगदितमेतद्देवदेवस्य चित्रं चरितमिदमचिंत्यं देवि ते शंकरस्य ..
कलिकलुषविदारं सर्वलोकोऽपि यायाद्यदि पठति शृणोति स्तौति नित्यं य इत्थम् .. 133 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये क्षेत्रप्रमाणवर्णनं नाम चतुर्थोऽध्यायः .. 4 ..
16.4.m:
Whatever beings are egg-born, sprout-born, sweat-born, or womb-born, / O goddess, when their breath has departed in Prabhāsa, they attain supreme liberation; there is no doubt here.
Thus has this wonderful and inconceivable deed of the God of gods, Śaṃkara, been told to you, O goddess, / which destroys the impurities of the Kali age; anyone in the whole world may attain it if he constantly recites, hears, or praises it in this manner.
Thus ends the fourth chapter, titled 'Description of the Extent of the Sacred Field', in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.5.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ityevamukte vipreṃdrā śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā ..
punaḥ papraccha sā devī harṣasaṃpūrṇamānasā .. 1 ..
16.5.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इत्येवमुक्ते विप्रेंद्रा शंकरेण महात्मना ..
पुनः पप्रच्छ सा देवी हर्षसंपूर्णमानसा .. 1 ..
16.5.m: Sūta said: / When this was spoken by the great-souled Śaṃkara, O best of brahmins, / that goddess, her mind filled with joy, asked again.

16.5.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
devadeva jagannātha sarvaprāṇahitāya vai ..
prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyaṃ vistarādvada me prabho .. 2 ..
16.5.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
देवदेव जगन्नाथ सर्वप्राणहिताय वै ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यं विस्तराद्वद मे प्रभो .. 2 ..
16.5.m: The goddess said: / O God of gods, Lord of the universe, for the welfare of all living beings, / tell me in detail, O Lord, the māhātmya of the Prabhāsa sacred field.

16.5.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
anyaddṛṣṭāṃtarūpaṃ te kathayāmi yaśasvini ..
yena sṛṣṭaṃ mahādevi kṣetrametanmama priyam .. 3 ..
16.5.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अन्यद्दृष्टांतरूपं ते कथयामि यशस्विनि ..
येन सृष्टं महादेवि क्षेत्रमेतन्मम प्रियम् .. 3 ..
16.5.m: Īśvara said: / I shall tell you another illustrative narrative, O illustrious one, / of how this sacred field, dear to me, was created, O great goddess.

16.5.s:
yā gatirdhyāyatāṃ nityaṃ niḥsaṃgānāṃ ca yoginām ..
saivaṃ saṃtyajatāṃ prāṇānprabhāse tu parā gatiḥ .. 4 ..
16.5.d:
या गतिर्ध्यायतां नित्यं निःसंगानां च योगिनाम् ..
सैवं संत्यजतां प्राणान्प्रभासे तु परा गतिः .. 4 ..
16.5.m: The state that belongs to unattached yogins who meditate perpetually / is that very supreme state for those who cast off their life-breaths in Prabhāsa.

16.5.s:
anekakalpasthāyī ca mārkaṃḍeyo mahātapāḥ ..
so'pi devaṃ virūpākṣaṃ prabhāse tu sadā'rcati ..5..
16.5.d:
अनेककल्पस्थायी च मार्कंडेयो महातपाः ..
सोऽपि देवं विरूपाक्षं प्रभासे तु सदाऽर्चति ..5..
16.5.m: Even the great ascetic Mārkaṇḍeya, who endures for many kalpas, / always worships the god Virūpākṣa in Prabhāsa.

16.5.s:
aṭitvā sarvatīrthāni prabhāsaṃ naiva muṃcati ..
durvāsāśca mahātejā liṃgasyārādhanodyataḥ ..
na muṃcati kṣaṇaṃ devi tatkṣetraṃ śaśimaulinaḥ .. 6 ..
16.5.d:
अटित्वा सर्वतीर्थानि प्रभासं नैव मुंचति ..
दुर्वासाश्च महातेजा लिंगस्याराधनोद्यतः ..
न मुंचति क्षणं देवि तत्क्षेत्रं शशिमौलिनः .. 6 ..
16.5.m: Having wandered through all sacred fords, he never abandons Prabhāsa. / And Durvāsas, endowed with great splendor, intent upon worshipping the liṅga, / does not abandon for a moment that sacred field of the moon-crested god, O goddess.

16.5.s:
bharadvājo marīciśca muniścoddālakastathā ..
kratuścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca kaśyapo bhṛgureva ca ... 7 ....
16.5.d:
भरद्वाजो मरीचिश्च मुनिश्चोद्दालकस्तथा ..
क्रतुश्चैव वसिष्ठश्च कश्यपो भृगुरेव च ... 7 ....
16.5.m: Bharadvāja, Marīci, the sage Uddālaka, / Kratu, Vasiṣṭha, Kaśyapa, and Bhṛgu,

16.5.s:
dakṣaścaiva tu sāvarṇiryamaścāṃgirasastathā.. ..
śuko vibhāṃḍakaścaiva ṛṣyaśṛṃgo'tha gobhilaḥ ..8..
16.5.d:
दक्षश्चैव तु सावर्णिर्यमश्चांगिरसस्तथा.. ..
शुको विभांडकश्चैव ऋष्यशृंगोऽथ गोभिलः ..8..
16.5.m: Dakṣa, Sāvarṇi, Yama, and Aṅgiras, / Śuka, Vibhāṇḍaka, Ṛṣyaśṛṅga, and Gobhila,

16.5.s:
gautamaśca ṛcīkaśca agastyaḥ śaunako mahān..
nārado jamadagniśca viśvāmitro'tha lomaśaḥ .. 9 ..
16.5.d:
गौतमश्च ऋचीकश्च अगस्त्यः शौनको महान्..
नारदो जमदग्निश्च विश्वामित्रोऽथ लोमशः .. 9 ..
16.5.m: Gautama, Ṛcīka, the great Śaunaka, Agastya, / Nārada, Jamadagni, Viśvāmitra, and Lomaśa,

16.5.s:
anye ca ṛṣayaścaiva divyā devarṣayastathā ..
na muṃcaṃti mahākṣetraṃ liṃgasyārādhanodyatāḥ .. 7.1.5.10 ..
16.5.d:
अन्ये च ऋषयश्चैव दिव्या देवर्षयस्तथा ..
न मुंचंति महाक्षेत्रं लिंगस्याराधनोद्यताः .. 7.1.5.10 ..
16.5.m: and other seers and divine celestial seers, / intent on worshipping the liṅga, do not abandon the great sacred field.

16.5.s:
ahaṃ tatraiva tiṣṭhāmi liṃgārādhanatatparaḥ ..
na muṃcāmi mahākṣetraṃ satyaṃsatyaṃ varānane .. 11 ..
16.5.d:
अहं तत्रैव तिष्ठामि लिंगाराधनतत्परः ..
न मुंचामि महाक्षेत्रं सत्यंसत्यं वरानने .. 11 ..
16.5.m: I myself reside right there, intent upon worshipping the liṅga; / I do not abandon the great sacred field; truly, truly, O fair-faced one.

16.5.s:
sarvatīrthāni deveśi mayā dṛṣṭāni bhūtale ..
prabhāsena samaṃ kṣetraṃ naiva dṛṣṭaṃ kadācana .. 12 ..
16.5.d:
सर्वतीर्थानि देवेशि मया दृष्टानि भूतले ..
प्रभासेन समं क्षेत्रं नैव दृष्टं कदाचन .. 12 ..
16.5.m: All sacred fords on the earth's surface have been seen by me, O goddess of the gods; / a sacred field equal to Prabhāsa has never been seen.

16.5.s:
devi ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi yājñavalkyapuraskṛtāḥ ..
japaṃ kurvaṃti rudrāṇāṃ candrabhāgāṃ vyavasthitāḥ .. 13 ..
16.5.d:
देवि षष्टिसहस्राणि याज्ञवल्क्यपुरस्कृताः ..
जपं कुर्वंति रुद्राणां चन्द्रभागां व्यवस्थिताः .. 13 ..
16.5.m: O goddess, sixty thousand [seers] led by Yājñavalkya, / residing along the Candrabhāgā, perform the chanting of the Rudras.

16.5.s:
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāmūrddhvaretasām ..
devikātaṭamāśritya japaṃti śatarudriyam .. 14 ..
16.5.d:
चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि ऋषीणामूर्द्ध्वरेतसाम् ..
देविकातटमाश्रित्य जपंति शतरुद्रियम् .. 14 ..
16.5.m: Forty thousand seers of upward-drawn seed, / resorting to the bank of the Devikā, chant the Śatarudriya.

16.5.s:
koṭayaścaiva paṃcāśanmunīnāmūrddhvaretasām ..
umāpatiṃ samāsādya liṃgaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitam .. 15 ..
16.5.d:
कोटयश्चैव पंचाशन्मुनीनामूर्द्ध्वरेतसाम् ..
उमापतिं समासाद्य लिंगं तत्रैव संस्थितम् .. 15 ..
16.5.m: And fifty crores of sages of upward-drawn seed, / having reached Umāpati, [worship] the liṅga situated right there.

16.5.s:
rudrāṇāṃ koṭi jāpyaṃ tu kṛtaṃ tatraiva taiḥ purā ..
koṭistatraiva saṃsiddhāstasmiṃlliṃge na saṃśayaḥ ..16..
16.5.d:
रुद्राणां कोटि जाप्यं तु कृतं तत्रैव तैः पुरा ..
कोटिस्तत्रैव संसिद्धास्तस्मिंल्लिंगे न संशयः ..16..
16.5.m: A crore of recitations of the Rudras was performed by them right there in ancient times; / a crore [of them] attained perfection right there at that liṅga, without a doubt.

16.5.s:
śataṃ caiva sahasrāṇāṃ deveśaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam ..
pūjayaṃti mahāsiddhā mama kṣetraniṣeviṇaḥ ..17..
16.5.d:
शतं चैव सहस्राणां देवेशं शशिभूषणम् ..
पूजयंति महासिद्धा मम क्षेत्रनिषेविणः ..17..
16.5.m: And a hundred thousand great perfected beings, devotees of my sacred field, / worship the Lord of gods, who is adorned with the moon.

16.5.s:
vedāṃteṣu ca yatproktaṃ phalaṃ caiva maharṣibhiḥ ..
tatphalaṃ sakalaṃ tatra caṃdrabhūṣaṇadarśanāt .. 18 ..
16.5.d:
वेदांतेषु च यत्प्रोक्तं फलं चैव महर्षिभिः ..
तत्फलं सकलं तत्र चंद्रभूषणदर्शनात् .. 18 ..
16.5.m: And whatever reward has been proclaimed in the Upaniṣads by the great seers, / that entire reward is attained there by the darśana of the moon-adorned god.

16.5.s:
agnitīrthe ṛṣīṇāṃ tu koṭiḥ sāgrā sthitā śubhe ..
rudreśvare smṛtaṃ lakṣaṃ kaṃparddīśe tathaiva ca .. 19 ..
16.5.d:
अग्नितीर्थे ऋषीणां तु कोटिः साग्रा स्थिता शुभे ..
रुद्रेश्वरे स्मृतं लक्षं कंपर्द्दीशे तथैव च .. 19 ..
16.5.m: At Agnitīrtha, O auspicious one, more than a crore of seers reside; / a hundred thousand are recorded at Rudreśvara, and likewise at Kapardīśa.

16.5.s:
ratneśvare sahasraṃ tu ṛṣīṇāmūrddhvaretasām ..
arkasthale mahāpuṇye koṭiḥ sāgrā sthitā śubhe .. 7.1.5.20 ..
16.5.d:
रत्नेश्वरे सहस्रं तु ऋषीणामूर्द्ध्वरेतसाम् ..
अर्कस्थले महापुण्ये कोटिः साग्रा स्थिता शुभे .. 7.1.5.20 ..
16.5.m: At Ratneśvara dwell a thousand seers of upward-drawn seed; / at auspicious Arkasthala, of great religious merit, over a crore reside.

16.5.s:
ṣaṣṭiścaiva sahasrāṇi tatra siddheśvare sthitāḥ ..
sapta caiva sahasrāṇi mārkaṃḍeye tu saṃsthitāḥ .. 21 ..
16.5.d:
षष्टिश्चैव सहस्राणि तत्र सिद्धेश्वरे स्थिताः ..
सप्त चैव सहस्राणि मार्कंडेये तु संस्थिताः .. 21 ..
16.5.m: Sixty thousand abide there at Siddheśvara; / and seven thousand reside at Mārkaṇḍeya.

16.5.s:
sarasvatyāṃ brahmakuṇḍe'saṃkhyātā munayaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
daśārbudasahasrāṇi koṭitritayameva ca .. 22 ..
16.5.d:
सरस्वत्यां ब्रह्मकुण्डेऽसंख्याता मुनयः स्मृताः ..
दशार्बुदसहस्राणि कोटित्रितयमेव च .. 22 ..
16.5.m: Countless sages are remembered at Brahmakuṇḍa on the Sarasvatī; / ten times a hundred million, and indeed three crores,

16.5.s:
ṛṣayastatra tiṣṭhaṃti yatra prācī sarasvatī ..
brahmahatyā gatā yatra śaṃkarasya ca tatkṣaṇāt .. 23 ..
16.5.d:
ऋषयस्तत्र तिष्ठंति यत्र प्राची सरस्वती ..
ब्रह्महत्या गता यत्र शंकरस्य च तत्क्षणात् .. 23 ..
16.5.m: seers dwell there where the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī [runs], / where Śaṃkara’s sin of killing a brahmin vanished in that very instant,

16.5.s:
kāyaḥ suvarṇatāṃ prāpa kapālaṃ patitaṃ karāt ..
jñātvaivaṃ śaṃkinā pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ tatra mahātapaḥ .. 24 ..
16.5.d:
कायः सुवर्णतां प्राप कपालं पतितं करात् ..
ज्ञात्वैवं शंकिना पूर्वं कृतं तत्र महातपः .. 24 ..
16.5.m: his body attained a golden hue, and the skull fell from his hand. / Knowing this, great austerity was formerly performed there by Śaṅkin.

16.5.s:
tuṣṭaḥ śrīśaṃkaro devo liṃga vāsavareṇa tu ..
koṭiyajñaphalaṃ snāne prācyāṃ liṃgasya pūjane .. 25 ..
16.5.d:
तुष्टः श्रीशंकरो देवो लिंग वासवरेण तु ..
कोटियज्ञफलं स्नाने प्राच्यां लिंगस्य पूजने .. 25 ..
16.5.m: The god Lord Śaṃkara was pleased with the liṅga by Vāsava’s boon: / the fruit of a crore of sacrifices [is gained] through ritual ablution in the eastward-flowing [stream] and worship of the liṅga.

16.5.s:
piṃḍe gayāśataguṇamamāsomayute dine ..
bhūtāyāṃ piṃḍadastatra kulakoṭiṃ samuddharet .. 26 ..
16.5.d:
पिंडे गयाशतगुणममासोमयुते दिने ..
भूतायां पिंडदस्तत्र कुलकोटिं समुद्धरेत् .. 26 ..
16.5.m: Through an ancestral cake, a hundred times the fruit of Gayā is gained on a new-moon day falling on a Monday; / one who offers an ancestral cake there on the fourteenth day delivers a crore of ancestors in his lineage.

16.5.s:
ye cātra malanāśāya nimaṅkṣyaṃti ca mānavāḥ ..
daśagodānajaṃ puṇyaṃ teṣāmapi bhaviṣyati ..27..
16.5.d:
ये चात्र मलनाशाय निमङ्क्ष्यंति च मानवाः ..
दशगोदानजं पुण्यं तेषामपि भविष्यति ..27..
16.5.m: And whatever men bathe there for the destruction of impurities, / they too shall obtain the merit born of the gift of ten cows.

16.5.s:
pādena vā krīḍamānā jalaṃ lipsaṃti ye narā ..
teṣāmapi śrāddhaphalaṃ vidhivatsaṃbhaviṣyati ..
tatra liṃgāni pūjyāni śūlabhedādikāni tu .. 28 ..
16.5.d:
पादेन वा क्रीडमाना जलं लिप्संति ये नरा ..
तेषामपि श्राद्धफलं विधिवत्संभविष्यति ..
तत्र लिंगानि पूज्यानि शूलभेदादिकानि तु .. 28 ..
16.5.m: Or men who, playing about, touch the water with their foot, / to them also shall accrue the fruit of a śrāddha performed according to rule. / The liṅgas there, such as Śūlabheda and the others, are to be worshipped;

16.5.s:
evaṃ vikalpya liṃgāni aśvamedha phalāni tu ..
darśanenāpi sarveṣāṃ sparśāddhi dviguṇaṃ phalam ..29..
evaṃ tuṣṭo jagannāthaḥ sthitaḥ prācīvane dhruvam ..
mano'pi ye kariṣyaṃti snānadāneṣu kā kathā ..7.1.5.3...
16.5.d:
एवं विकल्प्य लिंगानि अश्वमेध फलानि तु ..
दर्शनेनापि सर्वेषां स्पर्शाद्धि द्विगुणं फलम् ..29..
एवं तुष्टो जगन्नाथः स्थितः प्राचीवने ध्रुवम् ..
मनोऽपि ये करिष्यंति स्नानदानेषु का कथा ..7.1.5.3...
16.5.m:
thus regarding the liṅgas, the fruits of horse-sacrifices [accrue]. / By the mere darśana of them all, [the fruit is attained]; indeed, by touch the fruit is doubled.
Thus pleased, the Lord of the Universe dwells forever in the forest of the eastward-flowing [stream]. / What need be said of those who even set their mind on ritual ablution and gifts?

16.5.s:
teṣāṃ tuṣṭo jagannāthaḥ śaṃkaro nīlalohitaḥ ..
triṃśatkoṭigaṇastatra prācīṃ rakṣaṃti sarvataḥ ..31..
16.5.d:
तेषां तुष्टो जगन्नाथः शंकरो नीललोहितः ..
त्रिंशत्कोटिगणस्तत्र प्राचीं रक्षंति सर्वतः ..31..
16.5.m: With them the Lord of the Universe, Śaṃkara, the Blue-and-Red Lord, is well pleased. / A host of thirty crores guards the eastward-flowing [stream] there on every side.

16.5.s:
mahāpāpasamācāraḥ pāpiṣṭho vā'ti kilbiṣī ..
ghuṇākṣaramiva prāṇānprācyāṃ muktvā śivaṃ vrajet .. 32 ..
16.5.d:
महापापसमाचारः पापिष्ठो वाऽति किल्बिषी ..
घुणाक्षरमिव प्राणान्प्राच्यां मुक्त्वा शिवं व्रजेत् .. 32 ..
16.5.m: Whether one is of great sinful conduct, the most sinful, or exceedingly guilty, / relinquishing his breath at the eastward-flowing [stream], even as by mere chance, he reaches Śiva.

16.5.s:
dadhikaṃbaladānaṃ tu tatra deyaṃ dvijottame ..
kathitaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ sārātsārataraṃ dhruvam .. 33 ..
16.5.d:
दधिकंबलदानं तु तत्र देयं द्विजोत्तमे ..
कथितं पापशमनं सारात्सारतरं ध्रुवम् .. 33 ..
16.5.m: A gift of curd and a blanket should be given there to an eminent twice-born; / it is declared as that which quells sin, truly the quintessential of the quintessential.

16.5.s:
adhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi hiraṇyāśca mahodayam ..
durvāsasā tapastaptaṃ tatra sūryaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 34 ..
16.5.d:
अधुना संप्रवक्ष्यामि हिरण्याश्च महोदयम् ..
दुर्वाससा तपस्तप्तं तत्र सूर्यः प्रतिष्ठितः .. 34 ..
16.5.m: Now I shall proclaim the great rise of Hiraṇyā; / austerity was performed there by Durvāsas, and the Sun was installed there.

16.5.s:
koṭirekā tu tatraiva ṛṣīṇāmūrddhvaretasām ..
caturviṃśatitattvānāmadhiko balarūpadhṛk .. 35 ..
16.5.d:
कोटिरेका तु तत्रैव ऋषीणामूर्द्ध्वरेतसाम् ..
चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वानामधिको बलरूपधृक् .. 35 ..
16.5.m: Right there resides a crore of seers of upward-drawn seed, / surpassing the twenty-four cosmic principles, bearing form and strength,

16.5.s:
yatra tiṣṭhati deveśi bhṛgukoṭisamanvitaḥ ..
anyatra brāhmaṇānāṃ tu koṭyā yacca phalaṃ labhet .. 36 ..
16.5.d:
यत्र तिष्ठति देवेशि भृगुकोटिसमन्वितः ..
अन्यत्र ब्राह्मणानां तु कोट्या यच्च फलं लभेत् .. 36 ..
16.5.m: where, O Goddess of the gods, he abides accompanied by a crore of Bhṛgus. / Whatever fruit one would obtain elsewhere from [feeding] a crore of brahmins,

16.5.s:
brahmasthāne tathaikena bhojitena tu tatphalam ..
evaṃ jñātvā mahādevi tatra tiṣṭhāmi nirvṛtaḥ..
koṭirbhirdevaṛṣibhirdevaiḥ saha samāvṛtaḥ ..
tīrthāni tatra tiṣṭhaṃti aṃtarbhūtāni vai kalau .. 38 ..
16.5.d:
ब्रह्मस्थाने तथैकेन भोजितेन तु तत्फलम् ..
एवं ज्ञात्वा महादेवि तत्र तिष्ठामि निर्वृतः..
कोटिर्भिर्देवऋषिभिर्देवैः सह समावृतः ..
तीर्थानि तत्र तिष्ठंति अंतर्भूतानि वै कलौ .. 38 ..
16.5.m: that fruit is attained by feeding just one in this seat of Brahmā. / Knowing this, O great Goddess, I remain contented there / surrounded by crores of celestial seers and gods. / The sacred fords remain there, hidden inside, in the Kali age.

16.5.s:
tatra kṣetre mahāramye yatra someśvaraḥ sthitaḥ..
mama devi gaṇau dvau tu vibhramaḥ saṃbhramaḥ paraḥ .. 39 ..
16.5.d:
तत्र क्षेत्रे महारम्ये यत्र सोमेश्वरः स्थितः..
मम देवि गणौ द्वौ तु विभ्रमः संभ्रमः परः .. 39 ..
16.5.m: In that most delightful sacred field where Someśvara resides, / there are two attendants of mine, O Goddess: Vibhrama and the supreme Saṃbhrama.

16.5.s:
tau cātra kṣetrasaṃsthānāṃ lokānāṃ bhramavibhramaiḥ ..
yojayaṃti sadā cittaṃ vikalpānaikyasaṃkulam .. 7.1.5.40 ..
16.5.d:
तौ चात्र क्षेत्रसंस्थानां लोकानां भ्रमविभ्रमैः ..
योजयंति सदा चित्तं विकल्पानैक्यसंकुलम् .. 7.1.5.40 ..
16.5.m: These two, through illusions and delusions, ever perplex the minds / of the people dwelling in the sacred field, filling them with doubts and division.

16.5.s:
vināyakopasargāśca daśa doṣāstathā pare ..
evaṃ kṣetraṃ tu rakṣaṃti pāpināṃ duṣṭacetasām .. 41 ..
16.5.d:
विनायकोपसर्गाश्च दश दोषास्तथा परे ..
एवं क्षेत्रं तु रक्षंति पापिनां दुष्टचेतसाम् .. 41 ..
16.5.m: There are troubles caused by the Vināyakas, and likewise other ten blemishes; / in this way they guard the sacred field from sinful persons of wicked mind.

16.5.s:
daṃḍapāṇiṃ tu ye bhaktyā paśyaṃtīha narottamāḥ ..
na teṣāṃ jāyate vighnaṃ tatra kṣetranivāsinām .. 42 ..
16.5.d:
दंडपाणिं तु ये भक्त्या पश्यंतीह नरोत्तमाः ..
न तेषां जायते विघ्नं तत्र क्षेत्रनिवासिनाम् .. 42 ..
16.5.m: The best of men who behold Daṇḍapāṇi here with devotion, / to those residents of the sacred field no obstacle arises.

16.5.s:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā vai varṇasaṃkarāḥ ..
akāmā vā sakāmā vā prabhāse ye mṛtāḥ śubhe .. 43 ..
16.5.d:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्रा वै वर्णसंकराः ..
अकामा वा सकामा वा प्रभासे ये मृताः शुभे .. 43 ..
16.5.m: Brahmins, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras, or those of mixed castes, / without desire or full of desire, who die in auspicious Prabhāsa,

16.5.s:
caṃdrārddhamaulinaḥ sarve lalāṭākṣā vṛṣadhvajāḥ ..
śive mama pure divye jāyaṃte tatra mānavāḥ .. 44 ..
16.5.d:
चंद्रार्द्धमौलिनः सर्वे ललाटाक्षा वृषध्वजाः ..
शिवे मम पुरे दिव्ये जायंते तत्र मानवाः .. 44 ..
16.5.m: all crowned with the crescent moon, having an eye on the forehead, and with the bull upon their banners, / those men are reborn there in my divine city of Śiva.

16.5.s:
yastatra vasate vipraḥ saṃyatātmā samāhitaḥ ..
trikālamapi bhuṃjāno vāyubhakṣasamo bhavet .. 45 ..
16.5.d:
यस्तत्र वसते विप्रः संयतात्मा समाहितः ..
त्रिकालमपि भुंजानो वायुभक्षसमो भवेत् .. 45 ..
16.5.m: The wise brahmin who dwells there, self-controlled and concentrated in mind, / even if eating at the three times of the day, becomes equal to one who feeds on air.

16.5.s:
meroḥ śakyā guṇā vaktuṃ dvīpānāṃ ca guṇāstathā ..
samudrāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śakyā vaktuṃ guṇāḥ priye .. 46 ..
16.5.d:
मेरोः शक्या गुणा वक्तुं द्वीपानां च गुणास्तथा ..
समुद्राणां च सर्वेषां शक्या वक्तुं गुणाः प्रिये .. 46 ..
16.5.m: It is possible to recount the virtues of Meru, and likewise the virtues of the continents; / the virtues of all the oceans can also be told, my dear;

16.5.s:
ādidevasya deveśi maheśasya mahāprabhoḥ ..
śakyā naiva guṇā vaktuṃ varṣākoṭiśatairapi .. 47 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kṣetrastharṣidevagaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 5 ..
16.5.d:
आदिदेवस्य देवेशि महेशस्य महाप्रभोः ..
शक्या नैव गुणा वक्तुं वर्षाकोटिशतैरपि .. 47 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये क्षेत्रस्थर्षिदेवगणवर्णनं नाम पंचमोऽध्यायः .. 5 ..
16.5.m:
yet the virtues of the primordial God, the Great Lord, the Supreme Sovereign, / can never be told, O Goddess of the gods, even in hundreds of crores of years.
Thus ends the fifth chapter, entitled “Description of the Hosts of Seers and Gods Residing in the Field,” in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the first [subdivision] of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.6.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
atyadbhutaṃ mahādeva māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ mama ..
apūrvaṃ devadeveśa kadācinna śrutaṃ mayā .. 1 ..
16.6.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
अत्यद्भुतं महादेव माहात्म्यं कथितं मम ..
अपूर्वं देवदेवेश कदाचिन्न श्रुतं मया .. 1 ..
16.6.m: The Goddess said: / Exceedingly wondrous is the māhātmya that has been related to me, O Mahādeva, / unprecedented, O Lord of the gods of gods, never heard by me before.

16.6.s:
brahmāṃḍe yāni liṃgāni kīrtitāni tvayā mama ..
teṣāṃ prabhāvenādhikyaṃ someśe tatkathaṃ vada .. 2 ..
16.6.d:
ब्रह्मांडे यानि लिंगानि कीर्तितानि त्वया मम ..
तेषां प्रभावेनाधिक्यं सोमेशे तत्कथं वद .. 2 ..
16.6.m: Tell [me], how is it that among the liṅgas in the universe praised by you to me, / the superiority in power belongs to Someśa?

16.6.s:
kiṃ prabhāvo mahādeva kṣetrasya ca sureśvara ..
tanme brūhi sureśāna yāthātathyaṃ mamāgrataḥ ..3..
16.6.d:
किं प्रभावो महादेव क्षेत्रस्य च सुरेश्वर ..
तन्मे ब्रूहि सुरेशान याथातथ्यं ममाग्रतः ..3..
16.6.m: What is the power of the sacred field, O Mahādeva, O Lord of the gods? / Speak that in its true nature before me, O Lord of the deities.

16.6.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramaṃ tava ..
prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyaṃ someśasya varānane ..4..
16.6.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि रहस्यं परमं तव ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यं सोमेशस्य वरानने ..4..
16.6.m: Īśvara said: / Hereafter I shall tell you the supreme secret, / the māhātmya of Prabhāsakṣetra and of Someśa, O fair-faced one:

16.6.s:
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ vratam ..
jāpyānāṃ paramaṃ jāpyaṃ dhyānānāṃ dhyānamuttamam..5..
16.6.d:
तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं व्रतानां परमं व्रतम् ..
जाप्यानां परमं जाप्यं ध्यानानां ध्यानमुत्तमम्..5..
16.6.m: It is the supreme sacred ford of sacred fords, the supreme vow of vows, / the supreme recitation of things to be recited, the highest meditation among meditations,

16.6.s:
yogānāṃ paramo yogo rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mahat ..
tattehaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇu hyekamanā priye..6..
16.6.d:
योगानां परमो योगो रहस्यं परमं महत् ..
तत्तेहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु ह्येकमना प्रिये..6..
16.6.m: the supreme yoga of yogas, the supreme and great secret. / That I shall declare to you; listen with a single mind, my beloved.

16.6.s:
someśaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ paṃcavaktrasamanvitam ..
etalliṃgaṃ na muṃcāmi satyaṃsatyaṃ mayoditam ..7..
16.6.d:
सोमेशं परमं स्थानं पंचवक्त्रसमन्वितम् ..
एतल्लिंगं न मुंचामि सत्यंसत्यं मयोदितम् ..7..
16.6.m: Someśa is the supreme abode, endowed with five faces; / I never leave this liṅga: truly, truly this is spoken by me.

16.6.s:
yacca tatparamaṃ devi dhruvamakṣayamavyayam ..
someśaṃ tadvijānīhi mā vikalpamanā bhava..8..
16.6.d:
यच्च तत्परमं देवि ध्रुवमक्षयमव्ययम् ..
सोमेशं तद्विजानीहि मा विकल्पमना भव..8..
16.6.m: And that which is supreme, O Goddess, constant, imperishable, and immutable— / know that to be Someśa; do not be of wavering mind.

16.6.s:
nirbhayaṃ nirmalaṃ nityaṃ nirapekṣaṃ nirāśrayam ..
niraṃjanaṃ niṣprapaṃcaṃ niḥsaṃgaṃ nirupadravam. .. 9 ..
16.6.d:
निर्भयं निर्मलं नित्यं निरपेक्षं निराश्रयम् ..
निरंजनं निष्प्रपंचं निःसंगं निरुपद्रवम्. .. 9 ..
16.6.m: Fearless, stainless, eternal, devoid of desire, independent, / taintless, free from phenomenal expansion, unattached, free from afflictions—

16.6.s:
talliṃgamiti jānīhi prabhāse saṃvyavasthitam ..
apavargamavijñeyaṃ manoramyamanāmayam .. 7.1.6.10 ..
16.6.d:
तल्लिंगमिति जानीहि प्रभासे संव्यवस्थितम् ..
अपवर्गमविज्ञेयं मनोरम्यमनामयम् .. 7.1.6.10 ..
16.6.m: know that liṅga to be firmly established in Prabhāsa: / liberation, unknowable, delightful to the mind, and free from disease;

16.6.s:
nityaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ devaṃ makhaghnaṃ sarvatomukham ..
śivaṃ sarvātmakaṃ sūkṣmamanādyaṃ yacca daivatam .. 11 ..
16.6.d:
नित्यं च कारणं देवं मखघ्नं सर्वतोमुखम् ..
शिवं सर्वात्मकं सूक्ष्ममनाद्यं यच्च दैवतम् .. 11 ..
16.6.m: eternal and the cause, the god who destroyed the sacrifice, facing in every direction, / Śiva, the soul of all, subtle, the primordial deity,

16.6.s:
ātmopalabdhivijñeyaṃ cittaciṃtāvivarjitam ..
gamāgamavinirmuktaṃ bahiraṃtaśca kevalam .. 12 ..
16.6.d:
आत्मोपलब्धिविज्ञेयं चित्तचिंताविवर्जितम् ..
गमागमविनिर्मुक्तं बहिरंतश्च केवलम् .. 12 ..
16.6.m: known through realization of the Self, devoid of thoughts of the mind, / freed from coming and going, purely outside and inside,

16.6.s:
ātmopalabdhiviṣayaṃ stutigocaravarjitam ..
niṣkalaṃ vimalātmānaṃ prakaṭaṃ jñānadīpakam ..13..
16.6.d:
आत्मोपलब्धिविषयं स्तुतिगोचरवर्जितम् ..
निष्कलं विमलात्मानं प्रकटं ज्ञानदीपकम् ..13..
16.6.m: the domain of realization of the Self, beyond the range of praise, / partless, of pure essence, manifest, the lamp of knowledge—

16.6.s:
talliṃgamiti jānīhi prabhāse surasuṃdari ..
nirāvakāśarahitaṃ śabdaṃ śabdāṃtagocaram .. 14 ..
16.6.d:
तल्लिंगमिति जानीहि प्रभासे सुरसुंदरि ..
निरावकाशरहितं शब्दं शब्दांतगोचरम् .. 14 ..
16.6.m: know that to be the liṅga in Prabhāsa, O beautiful woman among the gods, / without lack of space, sound, and the object situated beyond sound.

16.6.s:
niṣkalaṃ vimalaṃ devaṃ devadevaṃ surātmakam ..
hetupramāṇarahitaṃ kalpanābhāvavarjitam ..15..
16.6.d:
निष्कलं विमलं देवं देवदेवं सुरात्मकम् ..
हेतुप्रमाणरहितं कल्पनाभाववर्जितम् ..15..
16.6.m: Partless, stainless, the god of gods whose essence is the celestials, / devoid of cause and means of knowledge, free from mental construction and non-being,

16.6.s:
cittāvalokaviṣayaṃ bahiraṃtarasaṃsthitam ..
prabhāse taṃ vijānīhi praṇavaṃ liṃgarūpiṇam .. 16 ..
16.6.d:
चित्तावलोकविषयं बहिरंतरसंस्थितम् ..
प्रभासे तं विजानीहि प्रणवं लिंगरूपिणम् .. 16 ..
16.6.m: the object observed by the mind, dwelling inside and outside: / know him in Prabhāsa as the Praṇava embodied as a liṅga.

16.6.s:
aniṣpaṃdaṃ mahātmānaṃ nirānaṃdāvalokanam ..
lokāvalokamārgasthaṃ viśuddhajñānakevalam..17..
16.6.d:
अनिष्पंदं महात्मानं निरानंदावलोकनम् ..
लोकावलोकमार्गस्थं विशुद्धज्ञानकेवलम्..17..
16.6.m: Motionless, the Great Self, looking beyond [mundane] bliss, / standing on the path of observing the world, pure knowledge alone,

16.6.s:
vidyāviśeṣamārgasthamanekākārasaṃjñitam ..
svabhāvabhāvanāgrāhyaṃ bhāvātītamalakṣaṇam ..18..
16.6.d:
विद्याविशेषमार्गस्थमनेकाकारसंज्ञितम् ..
स्वभावभावनाग्राह्यं भावातीतमलक्षणम् ..18..
16.6.m: standing on the path of specialized knowledge, bearing many forms and designations, / to be grasped by meditation on one's own nature, transcending existence, devoid of attributes,

16.6.s:
vākprapaṃcādirahitaṃ niṣprapañcātmakaṃ śivam..
jñānajñeyāvalokasthaṃ hetvābhāsavivarjitam..19..
16.6.d:
वाक्प्रपंचादिरहितं निष्प्रपञ्चात्मकं शिवम्..
ज्ञानज्ञेयावलोकस्थं हेत्वाभासविवर्जितम्..19..
16.6.m: devoid of speech, phenomenal expansion, and the like, whose essence is beyond phenomenal proliferation, Śiva, / situated in the perception of knowledge and knower, free from fallacious reasonings,

16.6.s:
anāhataṃ śabdagataṃ śabdādigaṇasaṃbhavam ..
evaṃ someśvaraṃ viddhi prabhāse liṃgarūpiṇam .. 7.1.6.20 ..
16.6.d:
अनाहतं शब्दगतं शब्दादिगणसंभवम् ..
एवं सोमेश्वरं विद्धि प्रभासे लिंगरूपिणम् .. 7.1.6.20 ..
16.6.m: the unstruck sound, inherent in sound, the source of the collection of sound and the rest— / know Someśvara thus in Prabhāsa embodied as a liṅga.

16.6.s:
śabdabrahmagataṃ śāntaṃ sa śabdāṃtagamāspadam ..
sarvātirikta viṣayaṃ sarvadhyānapade sthitam .. 21 ..
16.6.d:
शब्दब्रह्मगतं शान्तं स शब्दांतगमास्पदम् ..
सर्वातिरिक्त विषयं सर्वध्यानपदे स्थितम् .. 21 ..
16.6.m: Attained to the sound-Brahman, tranquil, he is the resort of that which goes to the end of sound, / surpassing all objects, situated in the state of all meditation,

16.6.s:
anādimacyutaṃ divyaṃ pramāṇātīta gocaram ..
adhaścordhvaṃ gataṃ nityaṃ jīvākhyaṃ dehasaṃsthitam .. 22 ..
16.6.d:
अनादिमच्युतं दिव्यं प्रमाणातीत गोचरम् ..
अधश्चोर्ध्वं गतं नित्यं जीवाख्यं देहसंस्थितम् .. 22 ..
16.6.m: beginningless, unfailing, divine, an object transcending means of knowledge, / moving downwards and upwards, eternal, called the living soul, abiding in the body,

16.6.s:
hṛdādidvādaśāṃtasthaṃ prāṇāpānodayāstagam ..
agrāhyamindriyātmānaṃ niṣkalaṃkātmakaṃ vibhum ..23..
16.6.d:
हृदादिद्वादशांतस्थं प्राणापानोदयास्तगम् ..
अग्राह्यमिन्द्रियात्मानं निष्कलंकात्मकं विभुम् ..23..
16.6.m: abiding from the heart to the twelve-finger breadth, the rising and setting of prāṇa and apāna, / ungraspable, the essence of the senses, spotless in nature, all-pervading,

16.6.s:
svarādivyaṃjanātītaṃ varṇādiparivarjitam ..
vācāmavācyaviṣayamahaṃkārārddharūpiṇam ..24..
16.6.d:
स्वरादिव्यंजनातीतं वर्णादिपरिवर्जितम् ..
वाचामवाच्यविषयमहंकारार्द्धरूपिणम् ..24..
16.6.m: beyond vowels, consonants, and the like, devoid of letters and the rest, / beyond the range of words, having the half-form of the ego-sense,

16.6.s:
apratarkyamanuccāryaṃ kalanākālavarjitam ..
niḥśabdaṃ niścalaṃ saumyaṃ dehātītaṃ parātparam ..25..
16.6.d:
अप्रतर्क्यमनुच्चार्यं कलनाकालवर्जितम् ..
निःशब्दं निश्चलं सौम्यं देहातीतं परात्परम् ..25..
16.6.m: inconceivable, unutterable, devoid of calculation and time, / soundless, motionless, gentle, transcending the body, higher than the highest,

16.6.s:
bhūtāvagraharahitaṃ bhāvābhāvavivarjitam ..
avijñeyaṃ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ pañcapañcādisaṃbhavam .. 26 ..
16.6.d:
भूतावग्रहरहितं भावाभावविवर्जितम् ..
अविज्ञेयं परं सूक्ष्मं पञ्चपञ्चादिसंभवम् .. 26 ..
16.6.m: free from the possession of elements, devoid of existence and non-existence, / unknowable, supreme, subtle, the origin of the five-and-twenty [principles] and the like,

16.6.s:
aprameyamanaṃtākhyamakṣayaṃ kāmarūpiṇam ..
prabhavaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bījāṃkurasamudbhavam .. 27 ..
16.6.d:
अप्रमेयमनंताख्यमक्षयं कामरूपिणम् ..
प्रभवं सर्वभूतानां बीजांकुरसमुद्भवम् .. 27 ..
16.6.m: immeasurable, named the Infinite, imperishable, assuming form at will, / the origin of all beings, the sprout arising from the seed,

16.6.s:
vyāpakaṃ sarvakāmākhyamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ mahat ..
sthūlasūkṣmavibhāgasthaṃ vyaktāvyaktaṃ sanātanam .. 28 ..
16.6.d:
व्यापकं सर्वकामाख्यमक्षरं परमं महत् ..
स्थूलसूक्ष्मविभागस्थं व्यक्ताव्यक्तं सनातनम् .. 28 ..
16.6.m: all-pervading, named all desires, imperishable, supreme, great, / abiding in the division of gross and subtle, manifest and unmanifest, eternal,

16.6.s:
kalpakalpāntarahitamanādinidhanaṃ mahat ..
mahābhūtaṃ mahākāyaṃ śivaṃ nirvāṇabhairavam .. 29 ..
16.6.d:
कल्पकल्पान्तरहितमनादिनिधनं महत् ..
महाभूतं महाकायं शिवं निर्वाणभैरवम् .. 29 ..
16.6.m: free from eons and dissolutions, beginningless and endless, great, / the great being, of immense body, Śiva, the Bhairava of ultimate liberation—

16.6.s:
evaṃ sadāśivaṃ viddhi prabhāse liṃgarūpiṇam ..
yogakriyā vinirmuktaṃ mṛtyuṃjayamanādimat .. 7.1.6.30 ..
16.6.d:
एवं सदाशिवं विद्धि प्रभासे लिंगरूपिणम् ..
योगक्रिया विनिर्मुक्तं मृत्युंजयमनादिमत् .. 7.1.6.30 ..
16.6.m: know Sadāśiva thus in Prabhāsa embodied as a liṅga, / entirely liberated from yogic actions, conqueror of death, beginningless,

16.6.s:
sarvopasargarahitaṃ sarvatovyāpakaṃ śivam ..
avyaktaṃ parato nityaṃ kevalaṃ dvaitavarjitam .. 31 ..
16.6.d:
सर्वोपसर्गरहितं सर्वतोव्यापकं शिवम् ..
अव्यक्तं परतो नित्यं केवलं द्वैतवर्जितम् .. 31 ..
16.6.m: free from all afflictions, all-pervading, Śiva, / unmanifest, eternally beyond, absolute, devoid of duality,

16.6.s:
ananyatejasākrāṃtaṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinam..
bhūrisvayaṃprabhaprakhyaṃ sarvatejo'dhikaṃ haram..32..
16.6.d:
अनन्यतेजसाक्रांतं प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिनम्..
भूरिस्वयंप्रभप्रख्यं सर्वतेजोऽधिकं हरम्..32..
16.6.m: pervaded by peerless splendor, dwelling in the Prabhāsa kṣetra, / resembling an immense self-luminous glow, Hara surpassing all splendor,

16.6.s:
śaraṇyaṃdevamīśānamoṃkāraṃ śivarūpiṇam..
devadevaṃ mahādevaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ vṛṣadhvajam..33..
16.6.d:
शरण्यंदेवमीशानमोंकारं शिवरूपिणम्..
देवदेवं महादेवं पंचवक्त्रं वृषध्वजम्..33..
16.6.m: the god who is a refuge, Īśāna, the syllable Oṃ, embodied as Śiva, / god of gods, Mahādeva, five-faced, with the bull on his banner,

16.6.s:
nirmalaṃ mānasātītaṃ bhāvagrāhyamanūpamam..
sadā śāṃtaṃ virūpākṣaṃ śūlahastaṃ jaṭādharam..34..
16.6.d:
निर्मलं मानसातीतं भावग्राह्यमनूपमम्..
सदा शांतं विरूपाक्षं शूलहस्तं जटाधरम्..34..
16.6.m: spotless, transcending the mind, graspable by devotion, incomparable, / ever tranquil, odd-eyed, trident in hand, wearing matted locks,

16.6.s:
hṛtpadmakośamadhyasthaṃ śūnyarūpaṃ nirañjanam ..
evaṃ sadāśivaṃ viddhi prabhāse liṅgarūpiṇam .. 35 ..
16.6.d:
हृत्पद्मकोशमध्यस्थं शून्यरूपं निरञ्जनम् ..
एवं सदाशिवं विद्धि प्रभासे लिङ्गरूपिणम् .. 35 ..
16.6.m: abiding within the pericarp of the heart-lotus, having the form of the void, untainted— / know Sadāśiva thus in Prabhāsa embodied as a liṅga.

16.6.s:
yo'sau parātparo devo haṃsākhyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
nādākhyaḥ suvrate devi so'sminsthāne sthitaḥ svayam .. 36 ..
16.6.d:
योऽसौ परात्परो देवो हंसाख्यः परिकीर्तितः ..
नादाख्यः सुव्रते देवि सोऽस्मिन्स्थाने स्थितः स्वयम् .. 36 ..
16.6.m: That god who is higher than the highest, renowned as the Haṃsa, / named Nāda, O goddess of good vows, is present in this place in person.

16.6.s:
etadādisvarūpaṃ ca mayā yogabalena tu ..
vijñātaṃ devi gaditaṃ divyamātmānamātmanā .. 37 ..
16.6.d:
एतदादिस्वरूपं च मया योगबलेन तु ..
विज्ञातं देवि गदितं दिव्यमात्मानमात्मना .. 37 ..
16.6.m: And this essential nature and the rest has been known by me through the power of yoga, / and declared, O goddess, as the divine Self by the self.

16.6.s:
ṛgvedasthastu pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne yajuṣi sthitaḥ ..
aparāhṇe tu sāmastho hyatharvastho niśāgame .. 38 ..
16.6.d:
ऋग्वेदस्थस्तु पूर्वाह्णे मध्याह्ने यजुषि स्थितः ..
अपराह्णे तु सामस्थो ह्यथर्वस्थो निशागमे .. 38 ..
16.6.m: In the forenoon he abides in the Ṛgveda; at midday he resides in the Yajurveda; / in the afternoon in the Sāmaveda, and indeed in the Atharvaveda at the arrival of night.

16.6.s:
