vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāṃtamādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt ..
tameva viditvā na bhavettu mṛtyurnānyaḥ paṃthā vidyate vai janānām .. 39 ..
16.6.d:
वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महांतमादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् ..
तमेव विदित्वा न भवेत्तु मृत्युर्नान्यः पंथा विद्यते वै जनानाम् .. 39 ..
16.6.m: “I know this great person, sun-colored, beyond darkness; / only by knowing him does death not occur; there is indeed no other path for people.”

16.6.s:
itīritaste tu mahāprabhāvaḥ someśaliṃgasya kṛtaikadeśaḥ ..
vṛtaṃ na cābdairbahubhiḥ sahasrairvaktuṃ ca kenāpi mukhairna śakyam ..7.1.6.40...
16.6.d:
इतीरितस्ते तु महाप्रभावः सोमेशलिंगस्य कृतैकदेशः ..
वृतं न चाब्दैर्बहुभिः सहस्रैर्वक्तुं च केनापि मुखैर्न शक्यम् ..7.1.6.40...
16.6.m: Thus has the great power of the Someśa liṅga been declared to you in a single fraction; / it could not be completed even in many thousands of years, nor can it be spoken by anyone with [all their] mouths.

16.6.s:
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro'pīdaṃ paṭhedyadi ..
nirmuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ..41..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrīsomeśvaramahimavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ..6..
16.6.d:
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रोऽपीदं पठेद्यदि ..
निर्मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ..41..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्रीसोमेश्वरमहिमवर्णनं नाम षष्ठोऽध्यायः..6..
16.6.m:
If a brahmin, kṣatriya, vaiśya, or even a śūdra recites this, / he is completely freed from all sins and attains all desires.
Thus ends the sixth chapter, named “Description of the Greatness of the Venerable Someśvara”, in the first [sub-section], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsa Kṣetra, in the seventh Section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of Śrī Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.7.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tatra tadā devī śrutvā māhātmyamuttamam ..
harṣotkaṃṭhitayā vācā punaḥ papraccha śaṃkaram .. 1 ..
16.7.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तत्र तदा देवी श्रुत्वा माहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
हर्षोत्कंठितया वाचा पुनः पप्रच्छ शंकरम् .. 1 ..
16.7.m: Sūta said: / Having thus heard that supreme māhātmya there at that time, / the goddess, with a voice eager with joy, asked Śaṃkara again.

16.7.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
devadeva jagannātha bhaktānugrahakāraka ..
samastajñānasaṃpanna namaste'stu maheśvara .. 2 ..
16.7.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
देवदेव जगन्नाथ भक्तानुग्रहकारक ..
समस्तज्ञानसंपन्न नमस्तेऽस्तु महेश्वर .. 2 ..
16.7.m: The Goddess said: / “O god of gods, lord of the universe, who bestows grace upon devotees, / endowed with all knowledge, salutation to you, O Maheśvara!

16.7.s:
namo'stu vai tripuraprahartre mahātmane tārakamardanāya ..
namo'stu te kṣīrasamudra dāyine śiśormunīndrasya samāhitasya ..3..
16.7.d:
नमोऽस्तु वै त्रिपुरप्रहर्त्रे महात्मने तारकमर्दनाय ..
नमोऽस्तु ते क्षीरसमुद्र दायिने शिशोर्मुनीन्द्रस्य समाहितस्य ..3..
16.7.m: Salutation to the destroyer of Tripura, the Great Self, the crusher of Tāraka; / salutation to you who granted the ocean of milk to the child, the concentrated king of sages!

16.7.s:
namo'stu te sarvajagadvidhātre sarvatra sarvātmaka sarvakartre ..
namo bhavāyāstu namo'bhavāya namo'stu te sarvagatāya nityam .. 4 ..
16.7.d:
नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वजगद्विधात्रे सर्वत्र सर्वात्मक सर्वकर्त्रे ..
नमो भवायास्तु नमोऽभवाय नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वगताय नित्यम् .. 4 ..
16.7.m: Salutation to you, creator of the entire universe, omnipresent, the soul of all, maker of all; / salutation to existence, salutation to non-existence, salutation to you who are eternally all-pervading!”

16.7.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kiṃ devi pṛcchase'dyāpi sarvaṃ te kathitaṃ mayā ..
saṃdigdhamasti kiṃciccetpunaḥ pṛcchasva bhāmini .. 5 ..
16.7.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
किं देवि पृच्छसेऽद्यापि सर्वं ते कथितं मया ..
संदिग्धमस्ति किंचिच्चेत्पुनः पृच्छस्व भामिनि .. 5 ..
16.7.m: Īśvara said: / “What are you still asking, O goddess? Everything has been told to you by me. / If anything is still uncertain, ask again, O beautiful woman.”

16.7.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
someśvareti yannāma kasminkāle babhūva tat ..
kiṃ nāmāgre'bhavalliṃgaṃ nāma kiṃ bhavitā'dhunā .. 6 ..
16.7.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
सोमेश्वरेति यन्नाम कस्मिन्काले बभूव तत् ..
किं नामाग्रेऽभवल्लिंगं नाम किं भविताऽधुना .. 6 ..
16.7.m: The Goddess said: / “At what time did that name ‘Someśvara’ come into being? / What was the name of the liṅga before? What will its name be in the future?

16.7.s:
evaṃ yasya prabhāvo vai noktaḥ pūrvaṃ tvayā vibho ..
anyeṣāṃ tīrthadevānāṃ māhātmyaṃ varṇitaṃ tvayā ..
na tvīdṛśaṃ tu kathitaṃ śrīsomeśasya yādṛśam .. 7 ..
16.7.d:
एवं यस्य प्रभावो वै नोक्तः पूर्वं त्वया विभो ..
अन्येषां तीर्थदेवानां माहात्म्यं वर्णितं त्वया ..
न त्वीदृशं तु कथितं श्रीसोमेशस्य यादृशम् .. 7 ..
16.7.m: Indeed, such power as this has not been spoken by you previously, O omnipresent lord; / the māhātmya of other deities of sacred fords has been described by you, / but not such as has been told of the venerable Someśa.”

16.7.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
pūrvamevāhamevāsaṃ sparśaliṃgasvarūpavān ..
na ca māṃ tattvato veda janaḥ kaścidiheśvari .. 8 ..
16.7.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पूर्वमेवाहमेवासं स्पर्शलिंगस्वरूपवान् ..
न च मां तत्त्वतो वेद जनः कश्चिदिहेश्वरि .. 8 ..
16.7.m: Īśvara said: / “Formerly I alone existed in the essential form of the Sparśaliṅga; / and no person here knows me in reality, O goddess.

16.7.s:
mahākalpe tu sañjāte brahmaṇaḥ prati saṃcare ..
nāmabhāvaṃ bhavedanyaddevi liṃge punaḥpunaḥ .. 9 ..
atītaṃ brahmaṇāṃ ṣaṭkaṃ saptamo'yaṃ prajāpatiḥ ..
varttate yo'dhunā devi śatānanda iti śrutaḥ .. .. 7.1.7.1...
16.7.d:
महाकल्पे तु सञ्जाते ब्रह्मणः प्रति संचरे ..
नामभावं भवेदन्यद्देवि लिंगे पुनःपुनः .. 9 ..
अतीतं ब्रह्मणां षट्कं सप्तमोऽयं प्रजापतिः ..
वर्त्तते योऽधुना देवि शतानन्द इति श्रुतः .. .. 7.1.7.1...
16.7.m:
When a great eon has occurred, at every dissolution of Brahmā, / a different state of name occurs again and again for the liṅga, O goddess.
A hexad of Brahmās has passed; this seventh Prajāpati, / who exists now, O goddess, is heard of as Śatānanda.

16.7.s:
asminbrahmaṇi deveśi saṃjāte hyaṣṭavārṣike ..
tadā kālātsamārabhya someśa iti viśrutaḥ .. 11 ..
16.7.d:
अस्मिन्ब्रह्मणि देवेशि संजाते ह्यष्टवार्षिके ..
तदा कालात्समारभ्य सोमेश इति विश्रुतः .. 11 ..
16.7.m: When this Brahmā, O ruler of gods, became eight years old, / starting from that time, [the liṅga] became renowned as Someśa.

16.7.s:
atīteṣu ca deveśi brahmasuptalayādanu ..
babhūvuryāni nāmāni tāni tvaṃ śṛṇu pārvati .. 12 ..
16.7.d:
अतीतेषु च देवेशि ब्रह्मसुप्तलयादनु ..
बभूवुर्यानि नामानि तानि त्वं शृणु पार्वति .. 12 ..
16.7.m: And after the sleep and dissolution of Brahmā among those who have passed, O ruler of gods, / listen, O Pārvatī, to the names that came to be.

16.7.s:
ādyo viraṃcināmāsīdyadā brahmā pitāmahaḥ ..
mṛtyuñjayastadā nāma somanāthasya kīrtitam .. .. 13 ..
16.7.d:
आद्यो विरंचिनामासीद्यदा ब्रह्मा पितामहः ..
मृत्युञ्जयस्तदा नाम सोमनाथस्य कीर्तितम् .. .. 13 ..
16.7.m: When the first Brahmā, the grandfather, had the name Virañci, / then the name of Somanātha was proclaimed as Mṛtyuñjaya.

16.7.s:
dvitīyo'bhūdyadā brahmā padmabhūriti viśrutaḥ ..
tadā kālāgnirudreti nāma proktaṃ śubheṃ'bike .. 14 ..
16.7.d:
द्वितीयोऽभूद्यदा ब्रह्मा पद्मभूरिति विश्रुतः ..
तदा कालाग्निरुद्रेति नाम प्रोक्तं शुभेंऽबिके .. 14 ..
16.7.m: When the second Brahmā was renowned as Padmabhū, / then, O auspicious Ambikā, the name was proclaimed as Kālāgnirudra.”

16.7.s:
tṛtīyo'bhūdyadā brahmā svayaṃbhūriti viśrutaḥ ..
amṛteśeti devasya tadā nāma prakīrtitam .. 15 ..
16.7.d:
तृतीयोऽभूद्यदा ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूरिति विश्रुतः ..
अमृतेशेति देवस्य तदा नाम प्रकीर्तितम् .. 15 ..
16.7.m: When the third Brahmā appeared, renowned as Svayambhū, / the God’s name was then proclaimed as Amṛteśa. (15)

16.7.s:
caturtho'bhūdyathā brahmā parameṣṭhīti viśrutaḥ ..
anāmayeti devasya tadā nāma smṛtaṃ śubhe..16..
16.7.d:
चतुर्थोऽभूद्यथा ब्रह्मा परमेष्ठीति विश्रुतः ..
अनामयेति देवस्य तदा नाम स्मृतं शुभे..16..
16.7.m: When the fourth Brahmā appeared, renowned as Parameṣṭhin, / the God’s name was then remembered as Anāmaya, O auspicious lady. (16)

16.7.s:
paṃcamo'bhūdyadā brahmā surajyeṣṭha iti smṛtaḥ..
kṛttivāseti devasya nāma proktaṃ tadāmbike..17..
16.7.d:
पंचमोऽभूद्यदा ब्रह्मा सुरज्येष्ठ इति स्मृतः..
कृत्तिवासेति देवस्य नाम प्रोक्तं तदाम्बिके..17..
16.7.m: When the fifth Brahmā appeared, remembered as Surajyeṣṭha, / the God’s name was then declared as Kṛttivāsas, O Ambikā. (17)

16.7.s:
ṣaṣṭhaścābhūdyadā brahmā hemagarbha iti śrutaḥ..
tadā bhairavanātheti nāma devasya kīrtitam..18..
16.7.d:
षष्ठश्चाभूद्यदा ब्रह्मा हेमगर्भ इति श्रुतः..
तदा भैरवनाथेति नाम देवस्य कीर्तितम्..18..
16.7.m: And when the sixth Brahmā appeared, renowned as Hemagarbha, / the God’s name was then celebrated as Bhairavanātha. (18)

16.7.s:
ayaṃ yo varttate brahmā śatānaṃda iti smṛtaḥ ..
somanātheti devasya vartate nāma sāṃpratam..19..
16.7.d:
अयं यो वर्त्तते ब्रह्मा शतानंद इति स्मृतः ..
सोमनाथेति देवस्य वर्तते नाम सांप्रतम्..19..
16.7.m: This Brahmā who exists now is remembered as Śatānanda; / the God’s name at present is Somanātha. (19)

16.7.s:
ataḥ paraṃ caturvaktro brahmā yo bhavitā yadā ..
prāṇanātheti devasya tadā nāma bhaviṣyati..7.1.7.20..
16.7.d:
अतः परं चतुर्वक्त्रो ब्रह्मा यो भविता यदा ..
प्राणनाथेति देवस्य तदा नाम भविष्यति..7.1.7.20..
16.7.m: When, hereafter, the next four-faced Brahmā shall come to be, / the God’s name at that time will be Prāṇanātha. (20)

16.7.s:
atītā ye vidhātāro bhaviṣyaṃti ca ye'dhunā..
tāvattadvarttate nāma yāvadanyoṣṭavārṣikaḥ ..
saṃdhyāsaṃdhyāṃśabhedena viṣṇvanaṃtasanātanāḥ .. 21 ..
16.7.d:
अतीता ये विधातारो भविष्यंति च येऽधुना..
तावत्तद्वर्त्तते नाम यावदन्योष्टवार्षिकः ..
संध्यासंध्यांशभेदेन विष्ण्वनंतसनातनाः .. 21 ..
16.7.m: Those creators who have passed away and those who shall be now— / that name endures so long as another is eight years old; / by the division of twilight and twilight-fraction, Viṣṇu, Ananta, and the eternal ones [remain]. (21)

16.7.s:
evaṃ nāmāni devasya saṃkṣepātkīrtitāni me ..
vistarātkathituṃ naiva śakyaṃte kālagauravāt .. 22 ..
16.7.d:
एवं नामानि देवस्य संक्षेपात्कीर्तितानि मे ..
विस्तरात्कथितुं नैव शक्यंते कालगौरवात् .. 22 ..
16.7.m: Thus the names of the God have been declared by me in brief; / they cannot possibly be told in full because of the vastness of time. (22)

16.7.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
āścaryaṃ devadeveśa yattvayā kathitaṃ prabho ..
pūrvoktāni ca nāmāni na smaraṃti ca me katham ..23..
16.7.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
आश्चर्यं देवदेवेश यत्त्वया कथितं प्रभो ..
पूर्वोक्तानि च नामानि न स्मरंति च मे कथम् ..23..
16.7.m: The Goddess said: / This is wondrous, O Lord of the gods of gods, what has been told by You, O Lord! / And why do I not remember the previously mentioned names? (23)

16.7.s:
etadvistarato brūhi kāraṇaṃ ca jagatpate ..
sarvabhūtahitārthāya mamānugrahakāmyayā .. 24 ..
16.7.d:
एतद्विस्तरतो ब्रूहि कारणं च जगत्पते ..
सर्वभूतहितार्थाय ममानुग्रहकाम्यया .. 24 ..
16.7.m: Tell this cause in detail, O Lord of the world, / for the welfare of all living beings and out of a desire to show grace to me. (24)

16.7.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kalpekalpe mahādevi avatāraṃ karoṣi yat ..
tena te smaraṇaṃ nāsti prabhāvātprakṛteḥ priye .. 25 ..
16.7.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
कल्पेकल्पे महादेवि अवतारं करोषि यत् ..
तेन ते स्मरणं नास्ति प्रभावात्प्रकृतेः प्रिये .. 25 ..
16.7.m: Īśvara said: / Because in kalpa after kalpa, O great goddess, you make an incarnation, / through the power of Prakṛti, O beloved, you have no memory of that. (25)

16.7.s:
tattvāvaraṇamadhye tu tatrādyā tvaṃ pratiṣṭhitā ..
sā'vatīryāṃḍamadhye tu mayā sārddhaṃ varānane .. 26 ..
16.7.d:
तत्त्वावरणमध्ये तु तत्राद्या त्वं प्रतिष्ठिता ..
साऽवतीर्यांडमध्ये तु मया सार्द्धं वरानने .. 26 ..
16.7.m: Within the sheath of principles, you are established there as primordial; / having descended into the Cosmic Egg together with me, O fair-faced lady, (26)

16.7.s:
anugrahārthaṃ lokānāṃ prādurbhūtā punaḥpunaḥ ..
ādye kalpe jaganmātā jagadyonirdvitīyake .. 27 ..
16.7.d:
अनुग्रहार्थं लोकानां प्रादुर्भूता पुनःपुनः ..
आद्ये कल्पे जगन्माता जगद्योनिर्द्वितीयके .. 27 ..
16.7.m: you manifested again and again for the grace of the worlds: / in the first kalpa as Jaganmātā, in the second as Jagadyoni, (27)

16.7.s:
tṛtīye śāṃbhavīnāma caturthe viśvarūpiṇī ..
pañcame naṃdinīnāma ṣaṣṭhe caiva gaṇāṃbikā .. 28 ..
16.7.d:
तृतीये शांभवीनाम चतुर्थे विश्वरूपिणी ..
पञ्चमे नंदिनीनाम षष्ठे चैव गणांबिका .. 28 ..
16.7.m: in the third named Śāmbhavī, in the fourth as Viśvarūpiṇī, / in the fifth named Nandinī, and in the sixth indeed as Gaṇāmbikā, (28)

16.7.s:
vibhūtiḥ saptame kalpe subhūtiścāṣṭame tadā ..
ānandā navame kalpe daśame vāmalocanā .. 29 ..
16.7.d:
विभूतिः सप्तमे कल्पे सुभूतिश्चाष्टमे तदा ..
आनन्दा नवमे कल्पे दशमे वामलोचना .. 29 ..
16.7.m: in the seventh kalpa as Vibhūti, and then in the eighth as Subhūti, / in the ninth kalpa as Ānandā, in the tenth as Vāmalocanā, (29)

16.7.s:
ekādaśe varārohā dvādaśe ca sumaṅgalā ..
kalpe trayodaśe caiva mahāmāyā hyudāhṛtā .. 7.1.7.30 ..
16.7.d:
एकादशे वरारोहा द्वादशे च सुमङ्गला ..
कल्पे त्रयोदशे चैव महामाया ह्युदाहृता .. 7.1.7.30 ..
16.7.m: in the eleventh as Varārohā, and in the twelfth as Sumaṅgalā, / and in the thirteenth kalpa you were proclaimed indeed as Mahāmāyā, (30)

16.7.s:
tataścaturdaśe kalpe'nantānāma prakīrtitā ..
bhūtamātā paṃcadaśe ṣoḍaśe cottamā smṛtā .. 31 ..
16.7.d:
ततश्चतुर्दशे कल्पेऽनन्तानाम प्रकीर्तिता ..
भूतमाता पंचदशे षोडशे चोत्तमा स्मृता .. 31 ..
16.7.m: then in the fourteenth kalpa celebrated by the name Anantā, / in the fifteenth as Bhūtamātā, and in the sixteenth remembered as Uttamā. (31)

16.7.s:
tataḥ saptadaśe kalpe pitṛkalpe tu viśrutā ..
dakṣasya duhitā jātā satīnāmnī mahāprabhā .. 32 ..
16.7.d:
ततः सप्तदशे कल्पे पितृकल्पे तु विश्रुता ..
दक्षस्य दुहिता जाता सतीनाम्नी महाप्रभा .. 32 ..
16.7.m: Then in the seventeenth kalpa, renowned as the Pitṛkalpa, / you were born as the daughter of Dakṣa, named Satī, of great splendor. (32)

16.7.s:
apamānāttu dakṣasya svāṃ tanūmatyajatpunaḥ ..
umāṃ kalāṃ tu candrasya purāpūrya ca saṃsthitā .. 33 ..
16.7.d:
अपमानात्तु दक्षस्य स्वां तनूमत्यजत्पुनः ..
उमां कलां तु चन्द्रस्य पुरापूर्य च संस्थिता .. 33 ..
16.7.m: Because of Dakṣa’s insult, you cast off your own body once more; / and fulfilling Umā, the digit of the moon, you remained as before. (33)

16.7.s:
tataḥ pravṛtte vārāhe kalpe tvaṃ surasundari ..
punarhimavatārādhya duhitā tvamataḥ kṛtā .. 34 ..
16.7.d:
ततः प्रवृत्ते वाराहे कल्पे त्वं सुरसुन्दरि ..
पुनर्हिमवताराध्य दुहिता त्वमतः कृता .. 34 ..
16.7.m: Then, when the Vārāha kalpa commenced, O beauty among the gods, / having been propitiated again by Himavat, you were made his daughter. (34)

16.7.s:
tato devyadbhutaṃ taptvā tapaḥ paramaduścaram ..
bharttāraṃ māṃ punaḥ prāpya pārvatīti nigadyase .. 35 ..
16.7.d:
ततो देव्यद्भुतं तप्त्वा तपः परमदुश्चरम् ..
भर्त्तारं मां पुनः प्राप्य पार्वतीति निगद्यसे .. 35 ..
16.7.m: Then, O goddess, having performed wondrous austerity extremely hard to perform, / and having obtained me once more as your husband, you are called Pārvatī. (35)

16.7.s:
kailāsanilayaścāhaṃ tvayā sārddhaṃ varānane ..
krīḍāmi tava deveśi yāvatkalpāvasānakam ..36..
16.7.d:
कैलासनिलयश्चाहं त्वया सार्द्धं वरानने ..
क्रीडामि तव देवेशि यावत्कल्पावसानकम् ..36..
16.7.m: Dwelling on Kailāsa together with you, O fair-faced lady, / I sport with you, O ruler of gods, until the end of the kalpa. (36)

16.7.s:
idaṃ caturguṇaṃ prāpya dvāpare viṣṇunā saha ..
mahiṣasya vadhārthāya utpannā kṛṣṇapiṃgalā .. 37 ..
16.7.d:
इदं चतुर्गुणं प्राप्य द्वापरे विष्णुना सह ..
महिषस्य वधार्थाय उत्पन्ना कृष्णपिंगला .. 37 ..
16.7.m: Attaining this fourfold form, together with Viṣṇu in the Dvāpara age, / dark and tawny, you arose for the slaying of Mahiṣa. (37)

16.7.s:
kātyāyanīti durgeti vividhairnāmaparyayaiḥ ..
navakoṭiprabhedena jātāsi vasudhātale .. 38 ..
16.7.d:
कात्यायनीति दुर्गेति विविधैर्नामपर्ययैः ..
नवकोटिप्रभेदेन जातासि वसुधातले .. 38 ..
16.7.m: Under diverse variant names such as Kātyāyanī and Durgā, / through nine-crore divisions you were born on the surface of the earth. (38)

16.7.s:
yāni te kalpanāmāni pūrvamuktāni sundari ..
tāni trayodaśākalpādudaktātkathitāni me .. 39 ..
16.7.d:
यानि ते कल्पनामानि पूर्वमुक्तानि सुन्दरि ..
तानि त्रयोदशाकल्पादुदक्तात्कथितानि मे .. 39 ..
16.7.m: Those kalpa-names of yours that were previously spoken, O beautiful lady, / they have been told by me starting upward from the thirteenth kalpa. (39)

16.7.s:
atītāni bhaviṣyāṇi varttamānāni sundari ..
evaṃ jñeyāni sarvāṇi brahmakalpāvadhi priye .. .. 7.1.7.40 ..
16.7.d:
अतीतानि भविष्याणि वर्त्तमानानि सुन्दरि ..
एवं ज्ञेयानि सर्वाणि ब्रह्मकल्पावधि प्रिये .. .. 7.1.7.40 ..
16.7.m: Past, future, and present, O beautiful lady— / all are to be known thus up to the limit of Brahmā’s kalpa, O beloved. (40)

16.7.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
somanātheti yannāma tvayā pūrvamudāhṛtam ..
tatkathaṃ niścalaṃ nāma manyate tripurāṃtaka .. 41 ..
16.7.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
सोमनाथेति यन्नाम त्वया पूर्वमुदाहृतम् ..
तत्कथं निश्चलं नाम मन्यते त्रिपुरांतक .. 41 ..
16.7.m: The Goddess said: / That name ‘Somanātha’ which was mentioned by You previously— / how is that regarded as a permanent name, O destroyer of Tripura? (41)

16.7.s:
asaṃkhyatvācca caṃdrāṇāṃ janmanāmaprabhedataḥ ..
manvantare tu saṃjāte yugānāmekasaptatau .. 42 ..
16.7.d:
असंख्यत्वाच्च चंद्राणां जन्मनामप्रभेदतः ..
मन्वन्तरे तु संजाते युगानामेकसप्ततौ .. 42 ..
16.7.m: For moons are innumerable, with distinctions of birth and names; / and when a manvantara has taken place in seventy-one yugas, (42)

16.7.s:
caṃdrasūryādayo devāḥ saṃhriyaṃte punaḥpunaḥ ..
saptarṣayaḥ surāḥ śakro manustatsūnavo nṛpāḥ .. 43 ..
16.7.d:
चंद्रसूर्यादयो देवाः संह्रियंते पुनःपुनः ..
सप्तर्षयः सुराः शक्रो मनुस्तत्सूनवो नृपाः .. 43 ..
16.7.m: the gods beginning with the Moon and the Sun are repeatedly dissolved— / the Seven Seers, the gods, Indra, Manu, and his sons, the kings. (43)

16.7.s:
ekakālaṃ ca sṛjyaṃte saṃhriyaṃte ca pūrvavat ..
etanme saṃśayaṃ deva yathāvadvaktumarhasi ..44..
16.7.d:
एककालं च सृज्यंते संह्रियंते च पूर्ववत् ..
एतन्मे संशयं देव यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि ..44..
16.7.m: They are created at one time and dissolved as before. / You ought to properly dispel this doubt of mine, O God! (44)

16.7.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ tatte vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ ..45..
16.7.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
साधु पृष्टं त्वया देवि रहस्यं पापनाशनम् ..
यन्न कस्यचिदाख्यातं तत्ते वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः ..45..
16.7.m: Īśvara said: / Well asked by you, O goddess! It is a secret that destroys sin; / what has not been told to anyone, that I shall explain to you entirely. (45)

16.7.s:
ayaṃ yo varttate brahmā śatānanda iti śrutaḥ..
tasya caivāṣṭame varṣe manuryaḥ prathamo bhavet .. 46 ..
16.7.d:
अयं यो वर्त्तते ब्रह्मा शतानन्द इति श्रुतः..
तस्य चैवाष्टमे वर्षे मनुर्यः प्रथमो भवेत् .. 46 ..
16.7.m: This Brahmā who exists now is known as Śatānanda; / and in his eighth year, the one who was the first Manu— (46)

16.7.s:
tasminmanvantare devi yaścādau rohiṇīpatiḥ ..
samudragarbhātsaṃjātaḥ salakṣmīkaustubhādibhiḥ .. 47 ..
16.7.d:
तस्मिन्मन्वन्तरे देवि यश्चादौ रोहिणीपतिः ..
समुद्रगर्भात्संजातः सलक्ष्मीकौस्तुभादिभिः .. 47 ..
16.7.m: in that manvantara, O goddess, the one who was initially the lord of Rohiṇī, / born from the womb of the ocean along with Lakṣmī, the Kaustubha jewel, and others, (47)

16.7.s:
tena cārādhitaṃ liṃgaṃ kālabhairavanāmataḥ ..
mahatā tapasā pūrvaṃ yugāni ca caturddaśe .. 48 ..
16.7.d:
तेन चाराधितं लिंगं कालभैरवनामतः ..
महता तपसा पूर्वं युगानि च चतुर्द्दशे .. 48 ..
16.7.m: by him the liṅga was propitiated by the name of Kālabhairava / through great austerity previously for fourteen yugas. (48)

16.7.s:
tasyādbhutaṃ tapo dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭo'haṃ tasya sundari ..
varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti mayā sa ca prokto niśākaraḥ .. 49 ..
16.7.d:
तस्याद्भुतं तपो दृष्ट्वा तुष्टोऽहं तस्य सुन्दरि ..
वरं वृणीष्वेति मया स च प्रोक्तो निशाकरः .. 49 ..
16.7.m: Seeing his wondrous austerity, I was pleased with him, O beautiful lady; / and that night-maker [the Moon] was told by me, ‘Choose a boon!’ (49)

16.7.s: sahovāca tadā devi bhaktyā saṃstutya māṃ śubhe .. 7.1.7.50 ..
16.7.d: सहोवाच तदा देवि भक्त्या संस्तुत्य मां शुभे .. 7.1.7.50 ..
16.7.m: Then, O goddess, having praised me with devotion, he spoke, O auspicious lady: (50)

16.7.s:
.. caṃdra uvāca .. ..
yadi prasanno deveśa varārho yadi vā'pyaham ..
somanātheti taṃ nāma bhūyādbrahmāvadhi prabho .. 51 ..
16.7.d:
.. चंद्र उवाच .. ..
यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश वरार्हो यदि वाऽप्यहम् ..
सोमनाथेति तं नाम भूयाद्ब्रह्मावधि प्रभो .. 51 ..
16.7.m: The Moon said: / If You are pleased, O Lord of the gods, or if I am worthy of a boon, / let that name of Yours be ‘Somanātha’ until Brahmā’s end, O Lord! (51)

16.7.s:
ye kecidbhavitāro'nye manvante śītaraśmayaḥ ..
teṣāṃ bhavatu deveśa devo'yaṃ kuladevatā .. .. 52 ..
16.7.d:
ये केचिद्भवितारोऽन्ये मन्वन्ते शीतरश्मयः ..
तेषां भवतु देवेश देवोऽयं कुलदेवता .. .. 52 ..
16.7.m: Whatever other cool-rayed ones [moons] there will be at the end of a manvantara, / let this God be their family deity, O Lord of the gods! (52)

16.7.s:
ārādhayaṃtu te sarve kṣetre'sminsaṃsthitā vibho ..
svakīyāyuḥpramāṇena brahmaṇaḥ pralayādanu .. 53 ..
16.7.d:
आराधयंतु ते सर्वे क्षेत्रेऽस्मिन्संस्थिता विभो ..
स्वकीयायुःप्रमाणेन ब्रह्मणः प्रलयादनु .. 53 ..
16.7.m: Let them all, dwelling in this sacred field, worship [You], O all-pervading Lord, / according to the measure of their own lifespan, until the dissolution of Brahmā. (53)

16.7.s:
somanātheti te nāma brahmāṃḍe sacarācare ..
khyātiṃ prayātu deveśa tejoliṃga namo'stu te .. 54 ..
16.7.d:
सोमनाथेति ते नाम ब्रह्मांडे सचराचरे ..
ख्यातिं प्रयातु देवेश तेजोलिंग नमोऽस्तु ते .. 54 ..
16.7.m: May Your name ‘Somanātha’ attain fame throughout the universe / containing the moving and the unmoving, O Lord of gods! O liṅga of splendor, obeisance to You! (54)

16.7.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evamastvityahaṃ procya punarliṃge layaṃ gataḥ ..
etatte kāraṇaṃ devi proktaṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ .. 55 ..
16.7.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवमस्त्वित्यहं प्रोच्य पुनर्लिंगे लयं गतः ..
एतत्ते कारणं देवि प्रोक्तं सर्वमशेषतः .. 55 ..
16.7.m: Īśvara said: / Having said ‘So be it!’, I merged back into the liṅga. / Thus this cause has been told to you completely, O goddess. (55)

16.7.s:
niḥsandigdhaṃ tu saṃkṣepātpurā pṛṣṭaṃ yatastvayā ..
uddeśamātraṃ kathitaṃ śrīsomeśaguṇānprati ..
samudrasyeva ratnānāmacintyastasya vistaraḥ .. 56 ..
16.7.d:
निःसन्दिग्धं तु संक्षेपात्पुरा पृष्टं यतस्त्वया ..
उद्देशमात्रं कथितं श्रीसोमेशगुणान्प्रति ..
समुद्रस्येव रत्नानामचिन्त्यस्तस्य विस्तरः .. 56 ..
16.7.m: Since you previously asked without doubt in brief, / only an indication has been given regarding the virtues of glorious Someśa; / its expanse is inconceivable, like the jewels of the ocean. (56)

16.7.s:
mohanaṃ tadabhaktānāṃ bhaktānāṃ buddhivarddhanam ..
mūḍhāste naiva paśyaṃti svarūpaṃ mama mohitāḥ .. 57 ..
16.7.d:
मोहनं तदभक्तानां भक्तानां बुद्धिवर्द्धनम् ..
मूढास्ते नैव पश्यंति स्वरूपं मम मोहिताः .. 57 ..
16.7.m: It is bewildering to non-devotees, but increases the intellect of devotees; / deluded, those fools do not at all see my true nature. (57)

16.7.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
īdṛśaṃ yasya māhātmyaṃ tejoliṃgasya śaṃkara ..
kutra tiṣṭhati talliṃgaṃ kṣetre tasminsureśvara .. 58 ..
16.7.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
ईदृशं यस्य माहात्म्यं तेजोलिंगस्य शंकर ..
कुत्र तिष्ठति तल्लिंगं क्षेत्रे तस्मिन्सुरेश्वर .. 58 ..
16.7.m:
The Goddess said:
Such is the māhātmya of that liṅga of fire, O Śaṃkara! / Where does that liṅga stand in that sacred field, O Lord of gods?

16.7.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi prayatnena śrutvā caivāvadhāraya ..
prabhāsaṃ paramaṃ devi kṣetrametanmama priyam .. 59 ..
16.7.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रयत्नेन श्रुत्वा चैवावधारय ..
प्रभासं परमं देवि क्षेत्रमेतन्मम प्रियम् .. 59 ..
16.7.m:
Īśvara said:
Listen attentively, O Goddess, and having heard, comprehend [it]. / Prabhāsa, O Goddess, is this supreme sacred field, dear to me.

16.7.s:
devānāmapi saṃsthānaṃ tacca dvādaśayojanam ..
paṃcayojanamānena pīṭhaṃ tatra prakīrttitam .. 7.1.7.60 ..
16.7.d:
देवानामपि संस्थानं तच्च द्वादशयोजनम् ..
पंचयोजनमानेन पीठं तत्र प्रकीर्त्तितम् .. 7.1.7.60 ..
16.7.m: It is the abode even of the gods, measuring twelve yojanas. / Within it, the seat is proclaimed to measure five yojanas.

16.7.s:
tanmadhye madgṛhaṃ devi tacca gavyūtimātrakam ..
samudrasyottare devi devikāmukhasaṃjñitam .. 61 ..
16.7.d:
तन्मध्ये मद्गृहं देवि तच्च गव्यूतिमात्रकम् ..
समुद्रस्योत्तरे देवि देविकामुखसंज्ञितम् .. 61 ..
16.7.m: In its midst is my home, O Goddess, and it measures only a gavyūti, / north of the ocean, O Goddess, known as Devikāmukha;

16.7.s:
vajriṇyāḥ pūrvataścaiva yāvannyaṃkumatī nadī ..
catuṣṭayaṃ ca vistārādāyāmātpaṃcayojanam .. 62 ..
16.7.d:
वज्रिण्याः पूर्वतश्चैव यावन्न्यंकुमती नदी ..
चतुष्टयं च विस्तारादायामात्पंचयोजनम् .. 62 ..
16.7.m: and east of the Vajriṇī as far as the Nyaṅkumatī river, / four [yojanas] in breadth and five yojanas in length.

16.7.s:
kṣetrapīṭhamiti proktamato garbhagṛhaṃ śṛṇu ..
samudrātkauravī yāvaddakṣiṇottaramānataḥ ..
pūrvapaścimato jñeyaṃ gomukhādā''śvamedhakam .. 63 ..
16.7.d:
क्षेत्रपीठमिति प्रोक्तमतो गर्भगृहं शृणु ..
समुद्रात्कौरवी यावद्दक्षिणोत्तरमानतः ..
पूर्वपश्चिमतो ज्ञेयं गोमुखादा'ऽश्वमेधकम् .. 63 ..
16.7.m: This is proclaimed to be the seat of the sacred field; now listen to the inner sanctuary: / from the ocean as far as the Kauravī by north-south measurement, / and from the Gomukha to the Āśvamedhika east to west it is to be known.

16.7.s:
etanmama gṛhaṃ devi na tyajāmi kadācana ..
tasya madhye sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ yatra tatte prakīrtitam .. 64 ..
16.7.d:
एतन्मम गृहं देवि न त्यजामि कदाचन ..
तस्य मध्ये स्थितं लिंगं यत्र तत्ते प्रकीर्तितम् .. 64 ..
16.7.m: This is my home, O Goddess; I never abandon it. / Situated in its center is the liṅga, whose location is proclaimed to you.

16.7.s:
vāruṇīṃ diśamāśritya sāgarasya ca sannidhau ..
kṛtasmarasyāparato dhanvantaraśatatraye .. 65 ..
16.7.d:
वारुणीं दिशमाश्रित्य सागरस्य च सन्निधौ ..
कृतस्मरस्यापरतो धन्वन्तरशतत्रये .. 65 ..
16.7.m: Facing the western direction, in the vicinity of the ocean, / to the west of Kṛtasmara at a distance of three hundred dhanus,

16.7.s:
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tuṃ svayaṃbhūtaṃ vyavasthitam ..
tatra saṃnihito devaḥ śaṃkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ.. 66 ..
16.7.d:
लिंगं महाप्रभावं तुं स्वयंभूतं व्यवस्थितम् ..
तत्र संनिहितो देवः शंकरः परमेश्वरः.. 66 ..
16.7.m: stands the self-manifest liṅga of great power. / Present there is the god Śaṃkara, the Supreme Lord.

16.7.s:
etasminnantare devi someśasya samīpataḥ ..
caturddaśe vibhāge tu dhanuṣāṃ ca śatadvayam .. .. 67 ..
16.7.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवि सोमेशस्य समीपतः ..
चतुर्द्दशे विभागे तु धनुषां च शतद्वयम् .. .. 67 ..
16.7.m: In this interval, O Goddess, in the vicinity of Someśa, / in the fourteenth division, across two hundred dhanus,

16.7.s:
samaṃtānmaṃḍalākārā karṇikā sā mama priyā ..
tasyāṃ ye prāṇinaḥ sarve mṛtāḥ kālena pārvati .. 68 ..
16.7.d:
समंतान्मंडलाकारा कर्णिका सा मम प्रिया ..
तस्यां ये प्राणिनः सर्वे मृताः कालेन पार्वति .. 68 ..
16.7.m: circular all around, is that pericarp dear to me. / All the living beings who die upon it in the course of time, O Pārvatī,

16.7.s:
kṛmikīṭapataṃgādyā jīvā uttama madhyamāḥ ..
nirddhūtakalmaṣāḥ sarve yāṃti lokaṃ mamāpi te ..69..
16.7.d:
कृमिकीटपतंगाद्या जीवा उत्तम मध्यमाः ..
निर्द्धूतकल्मषाः सर्वे यांति लोकं ममापि ते ..69..
16.7.m: worms, insects, moths, and other creatures, high and intermediate, / all have their impurities washed away and go to my realm as well.

16.7.s:
uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cāpi ayanaṃ na vicārayet ..
sarvasteṣāṃ śubhaḥ kālo ye mṛtāḥ kṣetramadhyataḥ .. 7.1.7.70 ..
16.7.d:
उत्तरं दक्षिणं चापि अयनं न विचारयेत् ..
सर्वस्तेषां शुभः कालो ये मृताः क्षेत्रमध्यतः .. 7.1.7.70 ..
16.7.m: One need not consider whether the sun's course is northern or southern; / any time is auspicious for those who die within the sacred field.

16.7.s:
ādināthena śarveṇa sarvaprāṇihitāya vai ..
ādyatattvānyathānīya kṣetrametanmahāprabham ..
prabhāsitaṃ mahādevi yatra siddhyaṃti mānavāḥ ..71..
16.7.d:
आदिनाथेन शर्वेण सर्वप्राणिहिताय वै ..
आद्यतत्त्वान्यथानीय क्षेत्रमेतन्महाप्रभम् ..
प्रभासितं महादेवि यत्र सिद्ध्यंति मानवाः ..71..
16.7.m: Brought forth as the primal principles by Śarva, the Primal Lord, for the welfare of all beings, / this sacred field of great splendor / was illumined, O Great Goddess, where mortals attain perfection.

16.7.s:
hanyamāno'pi yo vidvānvasedvighnaśatairapi ..
kṛtapratijño deveśi yāvajjīvaṃ sureśvari .. 72 ..
16.7.d:
हन्यमानोऽपि यो विद्वान्वसेद्विघ्नशतैरपि ..
कृतप्रतिज्ञो देवेशि यावज्जीवं सुरेश्वरि .. 72 ..
16.7.m: A wise man who, even though afflicted by hundreds of obstacles, would dwell [there], / having made a vow for the rest of his life, O Ruler of gods, O Ruler of deities,

16.7.s:
sa gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati..
tasya kṣetrasya māhātmyātsthāṇoścādbhutakarmaṇaḥ .. 73 ..
16.7.d:
स गच्छेत्परमं स्थानं यत्र गत्वा न शोचति..
तस्य क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यात्स्थाणोश्चाद्भुतकर्मणः .. 73 ..
16.7.m: he would go to the supreme abode, having gone where he does not grieve, / by virtue of the māhātmya of that sacred field and of Sthāṇu of wondrous deeds.

16.7.s:
kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi paścātsantāpameti vai ..
prabhāse tu viyujyeta na soṃ'takapurīṃ vrajet .. .. 74 ..
16.7.d:
कृत्वा पापसहस्राणि पश्चात्सन्तापमेति वै ..
प्रभासे तु वियुज्येत न सोंऽतकपुरीं व्रजेत् .. .. 74 ..
16.7.m: Having committed thousands of sins, if one later feels remorse, / and departs [this life] in Prabhāsa, he will not go to the city of the god of death.

16.7.s:
jñātvā kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ hāhābhūtamacetanam ..
niyuktastatra deveśi rakṣārthaṃ vighnanāyakaḥ .. 75 ..
16.7.d:
ज्ञात्वा कलियुगं घोरं हाहाभूतमचेतनम् ..
नियुक्तस्तत्र देवेशि रक्षार्थं विघ्ननायकः .. 75 ..
16.7.m: Knowing that the Kali Age is terrible, chaotic, and senseless, / the Leader of Obstacles was appointed there, O Ruler of deities, for its protection.

16.7.s:
ye tu brāhmaṇavidviṣṭāḥ śivabhaktivitaṃḍakāḥ ..
brahmaghnāśca kṛtaghnāśca tathā naiṣkṛtikāśca ye .. 76 ..
16.7.d:
ये तु ब्राह्मणविद्विष्टाः शिवभक्तिवितंडकाः ..
ब्रह्मघ्नाश्च कृतघ्नाश्च तथा नैष्कृतिकाश्च ये .. 76 ..
16.7.m: Those who hate brahmins, cavilers against devotion to Śiva, / killers of brahmins, ungrateful people, and the deceitful,

16.7.s:
lokadviṣṭā gurudviṣṭāstīrthāyatanakaṇṭakāḥ ..
sarvapāparatāścaiva ye cānye tu vikutsitāḥ .. 77 ..
16.7.d:
लोकद्विष्टा गुरुद्विष्टास्तीर्थायतनकण्टकाः ..
सर्वपापरताश्चैव ये चान्ये तु विकुत्सिताः .. 77 ..
16.7.m: haters of the world, haters of the guru, thorns in sacred fords and shrines, / those devoted to all manner of sins, and whatever others are despised—

16.7.s:
rakṣaṇārthaṃ ha vai teṣāṃ niyukto vighnanāyakaḥ ..
kālāgnirudrapārśve tu rudratulyaparākramaḥ .. 78 ..
16.7.d:
रक्षणार्थं ह वै तेषां नियुक्तो विघ्ननायकः ..
कालाग्निरुद्रपार्श्वे तु रुद्रतुल्यपराक्रमः .. 78 ..
16.7.m: for guarding against them, indeed, the Leader of Obstacles was appointed / beside Kālāgnirudra, equal in prowess to Rudra.

16.7.s:
kṣetraṃ rakṣati deveśi pāpiṣṭhānāṃ niyāmakaḥ ..
mriyaṃte yadi brahmaghnāstathā pātakino narāḥ .. 79 ..
16.7.d:
क्षेत्रं रक्षति देवेशि पापिष्ठानां नियामकः ..
म्रियंते यदि ब्रह्मघ्नास्तथा पातकिनो नराः .. 79 ..
16.7.m: He guards the sacred field, O Ruler of deities, checking the most wicked. / If killers of brahmins and other sinful men die

16.7.s:
kṣetre cāsminvarārohe teṣāṃ devi gatiṃ śṛṇu ..
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi divyāni kamalekṣaṇe .. 7.1.7.80 ..
dāsī putrāśca jāyante tadaṃte brahmarākṣasāḥ ..
tataḥ pāpakṣaye devi punaryāṃti viyonitām ..51..
16.7.d:
क्षेत्रे चास्मिन्वरारोहे तेषां देवि गतिं शृणु ..
दशवर्षसहस्राणि दिव्यानि कमलेक्षणे .. 7.1.7.80 ..
दासी पुत्राश्च जायन्ते तदंते ब्रह्मराक्षसाः ..
ततः पापक्षये देवि पुनर्यांति वियोनिताम् ..51..
16.7.m:
in this sacred field, O fair-hipped lady, hear their destination, O Goddess: / For ten thousand celestial years, O lotus-eyed one,
they are born as sons of female slaves, and after that, as brahmarākṣasas. / Then, with the exhaustion of sin, O Goddess, they again enter animal wombs.

16.7.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pāpaṃ tatra na kārayet ..
anyatrā''vartitaṃ pāpaṃ kṣetre cāsminvinaśyati .. 82 ..
16.7.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पापं तत्र न कारयेत् ..
अन्यत्रा'ऽवर्तितं पापं क्षेत्रे चास्मिन्विनश्यति .. 82 ..
16.7.m: Therefore, by every effort, one should not commit sin there. / A sin committed elsewhere is destroyed in this sacred field;

16.7.s:
asminpunaḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ paiśācanarakāvaham ..
bhaktānukaṃpī bhagavāṃstiryagyonigateṣvapi .. 83 ..
16.7.d:
अस्मिन्पुनः कृतं पापं पैशाचनरकावहम् ..
भक्तानुकंपी भगवांस्तिर्यग्योनिगतेष्वपि .. 83 ..
16.7.m: but a sin committed here leads to the hell of piśācas. / The Lord is compassionate toward devotees, even toward those born among animals;

16.7.s:
dadāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ na tu brahmadviṣāṃ priye..
ye ca dhyānaṃ samāsādya yuktātmānaḥ samāhitāḥ .. 84 ..
16.7.d:
ददाति परमं स्थानं न तु ब्रह्मद्विषां प्रिये..
ये च ध्यानं समासाद्य युक्तात्मानः समाहिताः .. 84 ..
16.7.m: he grants the supreme abode, but not to the enemies of brahmins, O dear one. / Those who have attained meditation, self-controlled and focused,

16.7.s:
saṃniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ japaṃti śatarudriyam..
prabhāse tu sthitā devi te kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ .. 85 ..
16.7.d:
संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं जपंति शतरुद्रियम्..
प्रभासे तु स्थिता देवि ते कृतार्था न संशयः .. 85 ..
16.7.m: restraining the senses, recite the Śatarudrīya; / dwelling in Prabhāsa, O Goddess, they have accomplished their goal, without a doubt.

16.7.s:
yadi gacchennaraḥ kaścitprabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam ..
tamupāyaṃ prakurvīta nirgacchenna punaryathā .. 86 ..
16.7.d:
यदि गच्छेन्नरः कश्चित्प्रभासं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
तमुपायं प्रकुर्वीत निर्गच्छेन्न पुनर्यथा .. 86 ..
16.7.m: If any person goes to Prabhāsa, the excellent sacred field, / he should employ such means that he never departs again.

16.7.s:
etadgopyaṃ varārohe na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit..
gopanīyamidaṃ śāstraṃ yathā prāṇāḥ svakāḥ priye.. 87..
16.7.d:
एतद्गोप्यं वरारोहे न देयं यस्य कस्यचित्..
गोपनीयमिदं शास्त्रं यथा प्राणाः स्वकाः प्रिये.. 87..
16.7.m: This is a secret, O fair-hipped lady; it must not be given to just anyone. / This teaching should be concealed just like one's own life-breaths, O dear one.

16.7.s:
yenedaṃ vihitaṃ śāstraṃ prabhāsakṣetradīpakam..
sa śivaścaiva vijñeyo mānuṣīṃ prakṛtiṃ sthitaḥ..88..
16.7.d:
येनेदं विहितं शास्त्रं प्रभासक्षेत्रदीपकम्..
स शिवश्चैव विज्ञेयो मानुषीं प्रकृतिं स्थितः..88..
16.7.m: He by whom this treatise illuminating the sacred field of Prabhāsa was composed, / he is to be recognized as Śiva himself residing in human nature.

16.7.s:
tasyavigrahasaṃstho'haṃ sadā tiṣṭhāmi pārvati..
vaṃditaḥ pūjito dhyāto yathāhaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 89 ..
16.7.d:
तस्यविग्रहसंस्थोऽहं सदा तिष्ठामि पार्वति..
वंदितः पूजितो ध्यातो यथाहं नात्र संशयः .. 89 ..
16.7.m: I always abide within his physical form, O Pārvatī; / he is revered, worshiped, and meditated upon just as I am; of this there is no doubt.

16.7.s:
kalau ca durllabhaṃ devi prabhāsakṣetramuttamam ..
idānīṃ tava snehena viśeṣaṃ kathayāmi vai ..
satyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ triḥsatyaṃ surasundari .. .. 7.1.7.90 ..
16.7.d:
कलौ च दुर्ल्लभं देवि प्रभासक्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
इदानीं तव स्नेहेन विशेषं कथयामि वै ..
सत्यंसत्यं पुनः सत्यं त्रिःसत्यं सुरसुन्दरि .. .. 7.1.7.90 ..
16.7.m: In the Kali Age, Prabhāsa, the excellent sacred field, is difficult to attain, O Goddess. / Now, out of affection for you, I shall indeed tell of its special nature; / it is true, true, and again true; thrice true, O beautiful goddess!

16.7.s:
yāni liṃgāni bhūrloke someśasteṣu me priyaḥ ..
asmim̐lliṃge guṇā ye tu te devi viditā mama .. 91 ..
16.7.d:
यानि लिंगानि भूर्लोके सोमेशस्तेषु मे प्रियः ..
अस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे गुणा ये तु ते देवि विदिता मम .. 91 ..
16.7.m: Among the liṅgas on earth, Someśa is dear to me; / and whatever qualities are in this liṅga, O Goddess, they are known to me.

16.7.s:
ahameva vijānāmi nānyo veda kathaṃcana ..
anyeṣu caiva liṃgeṣu ahaṃ pūjyaḥ surāsuraiḥ .. 92 ..
16.7.d:
अहमेव विजानामि नान्यो वेद कथंचन ..
अन्येषु चैव लिंगेषु अहं पूज्यः सुरासुरैः .. 92 ..
16.7.m: I alone know them; no one else knows them in any way. / In other liṅgas I am worshiped by gods and asuras,

16.7.s: liṃgaṃ cemaṃ punardevi pūjayāmo vayaṃ svayam .. 93 ..
16.7.d: लिंगं चेमं पुनर्देवि पूजयामो वयं स्वयम् .. 93 ..
16.7.m: but this liṅga, O Goddess, we ourselves worship.

16.7.s:
yasminkāle na vai brahmā na bhūmirna divākaraḥ ..
sarvaṃ caiva jagannātha tasminkāle yaśasvini .. 94 ..
16.7.d:
यस्मिन्काले न वै ब्रह्मा न भूमिर्न दिवाकरः ..
सर्वं चैव जगन्नाथ तस्मिन्काले यशस्विनि .. 94 ..
16.7.m: At that time when there was no Brahmā, no earth, no sun, / and no world at all, O illustrious lady,

16.7.s:
imaṃ liṃgaṃ paraṃ caiva brahmaṇaḥ pralaye tadā ..
bhāvinīṃ vṛttimāsthāya idaṃ sthānaṃ tu rakṣati .. 95 ..
16.7.d:
इमं लिंगं परं चैव ब्रह्मणः प्रलये तदा ..
भाविनीं वृत्तिमास्थाय इदं स्थानं तु रक्षति .. 95 ..
16.7.m: at that dissolution of Brahmā, this supreme liṅga, / assuming future existence, protects this abode.

16.7.s:
daśakoṭyastu liṃgānāṃ gaṃgādvārādvarānane ..
āgatya tāni madhyāhne liṃge'sminyāṃti saṃlayam .. 96 ..
16.7.d:
दशकोट्यस्तु लिंगानां गंगाद्वाराद्वरानने ..
आगत्य तानि मध्याह्ने लिंगेऽस्मिन्यांति संलयम् .. 96 ..
16.7.m: Ten crores of liṅgas from Gaṅgādvāra, O fair-faced one, / come and merge into this liṅga at midday.

16.7.s:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni gaganasthāni yāni tu ..
snānārthamasya liṃgasya samāgacchaṃti sarvadā .. 97 ..
16.7.d:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि गगनस्थानि यानि तु ..
स्नानार्थमस्य लिंगस्य समागच्छंति सर्वदा .. 97 ..
16.7.m: All the sacred fords on earth and those situated in the sky / come at all times for the ritual bath of this liṅga.

16.7.s:
dhanyāstu khalu te marttyāḥ prabhāse saṃvyavasthitāḥ ..
someśvaraṃ ye drakṣyaṃti saṃsārabhayamocanam .. 98 ..
16.7.d:
धन्यास्तु खलु ते मर्त्त्याः प्रभासे संव्यवस्थिताः ..
सोमेश्वरं ये द्रक्ष्यंति संसारभयमोचनम् .. 98 ..
16.7.m: Blessed indeed are those mortals settled in Prabhāsa / who shall behold Someśvara, the deliverer from the fear of transmigration.

16.7.s:
devi someśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ ye smariṣyaṃti bhāvitāḥ ..
sarvapāpakṣayasteṣāṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 99 ..
16.7.d:
देवि सोमेश्वरं लिंगं ये स्मरिष्यंति भाविताः ..
सर्वपापक्षयस्तेषां भविष्यति न संशयः .. 99 ..
16.7.m: Those who, being devoted, remember the Someśvara liṅga, O Goddess, / will have all their sins destroyed, without a doubt.

16.7.s:
etatsmṛtaṃ priyatamaṃ mama devi nityaṃ kṣetraṃ pavitramṛṣisiddhagaṇābhiramyam ..
asminmṛtāḥ sakalajīvamṛto'pi devi svargātparaṃ samupayāṃti na saṃśayo'tra .. 7.1.7.100 ..
16.7.d:
एतत्स्मृतं प्रियतमं मम देवि नित्यं क्षेत्रं पवित्रमृषिसिद्धगणाभिरम्यम् ..
अस्मिन्मृताः सकलजीवमृतोऽपि देवि स्वर्गात्परं समुपयांति न संशयोऽत्र .. 7.1.7.100 ..
16.7.m: This sacred field is remembered as ever most dear to me, O goddess, pure and delightful to hosts of seers and perfected beings. / Those who die here, even if dead while living among all creatures, O goddess, attain beyond heaven; there is no doubt in this.

16.7.s:
yaṃ devā na vijānaṃti brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ ..
na sāṃkhyena na yogena naiva pāśupatena ca .. 101 ..
16.7.d:
यं देवा न विजानंति ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः ..
न सांख्येन न योगेन नैव पाशुपतेन च .. 101 ..
16.7.m: That which the gods headed by Brahmā and Viṣṇu do not know, / neither by Sāṃkhya nor by Yoga nor by the Pāśupata system,

16.7.s:
kaivalyaṃ niṣkalaṃ yatta- dasmim̐lliṃge tu labhyate ..
tāvadbhramaṃti saṃsāre devādyāstu yaśasvini .. 102 ..
16.7.d:
कैवल्यं निष्कलं यत्त- दस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे तु लभ्यते ..
तावद्भ्रमंति संसारे देवाद्यास्तु यशस्विनि .. 102 ..
16.7.m: that unconditioned liberation without parts is obtained in this liṅga. / O renowned lady, the gods and others wander in saṃsāra only so long

16.7.s:
yāvatsomeśvaraṃ devaṃ na viṃdaṃti trilocanam ..
kṣetraṃ prabhāsamityuktaṃ kṣetrajño'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 103 ..
16.7.d:
यावत्सोमेश्वरं देवं न विंदंति त्रिलोचनम् ..
क्षेत्रं प्रभासमित्युक्तं क्षेत्रज्ञोऽहं न संशयः .. 103 ..
16.7.m: as they do not find the three-eyed lord Someśvara. / The field is called Prabhāsa, and I am the knower of the field; of this there is no doubt.

16.7.s:
etaṃ tavoktaṃ nanu bodhanāya someśvarasyaiva mahāprabhāvam ..
ye vai paṭhiṣyaṃti narā nitāṃtaṃ yāsyaṃti te tatpadamiṃdumauleḥ .. .. 104 ..
16.7.d:
एतं तवोक्तं ननु बोधनाय सोमेश्वरस्यैव महाप्रभावम् ..
ये वै पठिष्यंति नरा नितांतं यास्यंति ते तत्पदमिंदुमौलेः .. .. 104 ..
16.7.m: Truly, this great power of Someśvara has been proclaimed to you for your awakening; / those men who recite it constantly will attain the abode of the moon-crested god.

16.7.s:
someśvaraṃ devavaraṃ manuṣyā ye bhaktimaṃtaḥ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ ..
te ghorarūpe ca bhayāvahe ca saṃsāracakre na punarbhramaṃti .. 105 ..
16.7.d:
सोमेश्वरं देववरं मनुष्या ये भक्तिमंतः शरणं प्रपन्नाः ..
ते घोररूपे च भयावहे च संसारचक्रे न पुनर्भ्रमंति .. 105 ..
16.7.m: Those men endowed with devotion who have taken refuge in Someśvara, the best of gods, / never wander again in the wheel of worldly existence, terrifying and full of fear.

16.7.s:
ye dakṣiṇā mūrttimupāśritāḥ syurjapaṃti nityaṃ śatarudriyaṃ dvijāḥ ..
te'sminbhave naiva punarbhavaṃti saṃsārapāraṃ paramaṃ gatā vai .. 106 ..
16.7.d:
ये दक्षिणा मूर्त्तिमुपाश्रिताः स्युर्जपंति नित्यं शतरुद्रियं द्विजाः ..
तेऽस्मिन्भवे नैव पुनर्भवंति संसारपारं परमं गता वै .. 106 ..
16.7.m: Those twice-born who resort to the southern manifestation and constantly recite the Śatarudriya / are never born again in this world, having truly reached the supreme shore of saṃsāra.

16.7.s:
uddeśamātraṃ kathito mayā te śrīsomanāthasya kṛtaikadeśaḥ ..
abdairanekairbahubhiryugairvā na śakyamekena mukhena vaktum .. 107 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrīsomanāthaprādurbhāvavarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 7 .. ..
16.7.d:
उद्देशमात्रं कथितो मया ते श्रीसोमनाथस्य कृतैकदेशः ..
अब्दैरनेकैर्बहुभिर्युगैर्वा न शक्यमेकेन मुखेन वक्तुम् .. 107 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्रीसोमनाथप्रादुर्भाववर्णनंनाम सप्तमोऽध्यायः .. 7 .. ..
16.7.m:
Only an outline has been declared by me to you, a mere fraction of glorious Somanātha; / it is not possible to describe it with a single mouth even over many years or numerous yugas.
Thus ends the seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Manifestation of the Glorious Somanātha', in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.8.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
punaḥ kathaya deveśa māhātmyaṃ lokaśaṃkara ..
śrīsomeśvaradevasya sarvapātakanāśanam..
brahmaviṣṇvīśadaivatyaṃ tathātra tritayaṃ vada .. ... 1 ..
16.8.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
पुनः कथय देवेश माहात्म्यं लोकशंकर ..
श्रीसोमेश्वरदेवस्य सर्वपातकनाशनम्..
ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशदैवत्यं तथात्र त्रितयं वद .. ... 1 ..
16.8.m: The goddess said: / Speak again, O Lord of gods, O bringer of peace to the world, the māhātmya / of the glorious lord Someśvara, which destroys all sins; / and tell also of the triad here that has Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Īśa as presiding deities.

16.8.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā mama gopyaṃ purātanam ..
tasmim̐lliṃge ca yadvṛttamāścaryaṃ paramaṃ mahat .. 2 ..
16.8.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा मम गोप्यं पुरातनम् ..
तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे च यद्वृत्तमाश्चर्यं परमं महत् .. 2 ..
16.8.m: The lord said: / Listen with a single mind to my ancient secret, / and what great, supreme wonder occurred in that liṅga.

16.8.s:
ṣaṣṭikoṭi sahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāmūrddhvaretasām ..
tasmim̐lliṃge praviṣṭāni te ghṛtāhutirivānale .. 3 ..
16.8.d:
षष्टिकोटि सहस्राणि ऋषीणामूर्द्ध्वरेतसाम् ..
तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे प्रविष्टानि ते घृताहुतिरिवानले .. 3 ..
16.8.m: Sixty thousand tens of millions of seers of upward-drawn seed / entered into that liṅga, like an oblation of clarified butter into fire.

16.8.s:
siddhirvṛddhistathā tuṣṭirṛddhiḥ puṣṭistu paṃcamī ..
kīrtiḥ śāṃtistathā lakṣmīstasmiṃlliṃge samutthitā .. 4 ..
16.8.d:
सिद्धिर्वृद्धिस्तथा तुष्टिरृद्धिः पुष्टिस्तु पंचमी ..
कीर्तिः शांतिस्तथा लक्ष्मीस्तस्मिंल्लिंगे समुत्थिता .. 4 ..
16.8.m: Siddhi (Perfection), Vṛddhi (Increase), Tuṣṭi (Contentment), Ṛddhi (Prosperity), and fifthly Puṣṭi (Nourishment), / Kīrti (Renown), Śānti (Peace), and Lakṣmī arose from that liṅga.

16.8.s:
saptakoṭyastu maṃtrāṇāṃ siddhīnāṃ caiva saṃbhavaḥ ..
divyayogarasāścānye divyauṣadhirasāyanāḥ .. 5 ..
16.8.d:
सप्तकोट्यस्तु मंत्राणां सिद्धीनां चैव संभवः ..
दिव्ययोगरसाश्चान्ये दिव्यौषधिरसायनाः .. 5 ..
16.8.m: The origin of seventy million mantras and of perfections [took place there], / as well as other divine yogic elixirs and divine herbal panaceas.

16.8.s:
gāruḍaṃ bhūtataṃtraṃ ca khecaryo vyaṃtarīstathā ..
te sarve saha yogena tasmālliṃgātsamutthitāḥ .. 6 ..
16.8.d:
गारुडं भूततंत्रं च खेचर्यो व्यंतरीस्तथा ..
ते सर्वे सह योगेन तस्माल्लिंगात्समुत्थिताः .. 6 ..
16.8.m: The Gāruḍa lore and the Bhūtatantra, the sky-farers and the intermediate spirits— / all of them, along with yoga, arose from that liṅga.

16.8.s:
anyāścaiva tu yāḥ kāścitsiddhayo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ ..
tāḥ sarvāḥ saha liṃgena tasmātsthānātsamutthitāḥ .. 7 ..
16.8.d:
अन्याश्चैव तु याः काश्चित्सिद्धयोऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः ..
ताः सर्वाः सह लिंगेन तस्मात्स्थानात्समुत्थिताः .. 7 ..
16.8.m: And whatever other perfections are proclaimed as the eightfold perfections, / all of them arose from that place along with the liṅga.

16.8.s:
anyaddevi pravakṣyāmi atra siddhiṃ gatāstu ye ..
mamāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ prāptā asmim̐lliṃge layaṃ gatāḥ .. 9 ..
teṣāṃ ca vikramānsarvānpravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ ..
purākramā grahā muṇḍā guḍakāśca sahetukāḥ .. 9 ..
16.8.d:
अन्यद्देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि अत्र सिद्धिं गतास्तु ये ..
ममांशसंभवाः प्राप्ता अस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे लयं गताः .. 9 ..
तेषां च विक्रमान्सर्वान्प्रवक्ष्याम्यनुपूर्वशः ..
पुराक्रमा ग्रहा मुण्डा गुडकाश्च सहेतुकाः .. 9 ..
16.8.m:
I shall tell another matter, O goddess: those who attained perfection here, / originating from my own portions, reached dissolution in this liṅga.
And I shall tell of all their achievements in due order: / Purākrama, Graha, Muṇḍa, Guḍaka, along with Sahetuka,

16.8.s:
vimalā daṃḍikāścaiva saptaite kutsikāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
asmiṃlliṃge purā siddhā yogātpāśupatānmama .. 7.1.8.10 ..
16.8.d:
विमला दंडिकाश्चैव सप्तैते कुत्सिकाः स्मृताः ..
अस्मिंल्लिंगे पुरा सिद्धा योगात्पाशुपतान्मम .. 7.1.8.10 ..
16.8.m: Vimala, and Daṇḍika—these seven are remembered as Kutsikas. / They became perfected in this liṅga long ago through my Pāśupata yoga.

16.8.s:
rudro viprastathā dānaścaṃdro mantho'valokakaḥ ..
sūryāvalokaśceti gārgeyāḥ sapta kīrttitāḥ .. 11 ..
16.8.d:
रुद्रो विप्रस्तथा दानश्चंद्रो मन्थोऽवलोककः ..
सूर्यावलोकश्चेति गार्गेयाः सप्त कीर्त्तिताः .. 11 ..
16.8.m: Rudra, Vipra, as well as Dāna, Candra, Mantha, Avalokaka, / and Sūryāvaloka: these are proclaimed as the seven Gārgyas.

16.8.s:
someśvare ca te siddhāḥ prabhāse varavarṇini ..
mūkamanyaḥ śivaścaiva prakāśaḥ kapilastathā .. 12 ..
16.8.d:
सोमेश्वरे च ते सिद्धाः प्रभासे वरवर्णिनि ..
मूकमन्यः शिवश्चैव प्रकाशः कपिलस्तथा .. 12 ..
16.8.m: They attained perfection in Someśvara at Prabhāsa, O fair-complexioned lady. / Mūka, Manya, Śiva, Prakāśa, and Kapila,

16.8.s:
satkulaḥ karṇikāraśca pauruṣeyāḥ prakīrttitāḥ ..
someśvare purā siddhāḥ prabhāse pāpanāśane .. 13 ..
16.8.d:
सत्कुलः कर्णिकारश्च पौरुषेयाः प्रकीर्त्तिताः ..
सोमेश्वरे पुरा सिद्धाः प्रभासे पापनाशने .. 13 ..
16.8.m: Satkula, and Karṇikāra are proclaimed as the Pauruṣeyas. / They attained perfection long ago at Someśvara in Prabhāsa, which destroys sins.

16.8.s:
yugeyuge purā siddhāstasmim̐lliṃge priye mama ..
ete cānye ca ye viprā bhaviṣyaṃti kalau yuge .. 14 ..
16.8.d:
युगेयुगे पुरा सिद्धास्तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे प्रिये मम ..
एते चान्ये च ये विप्रा भविष्यंति कलौ युगे .. 14 ..
16.8.m: Age after age they attained perfection in that liṅga long ago, O my beloved. / These and other brahmins who will exist in the Kali yuga

16.8.s:
tatra siddhiṃ gamiṣyaṃti durllabhāṃ tridaśairapi ..
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ talliṃgaṃ siddhidaṃ param .. 19 ..
durllabhaṃ sarvamarttyānāṃ prabhāse tu vyavasthitam ..
na ca kaścidvijānāti aśubhaiḥ karmabhirvṛtaḥ .. 16 ..
grahadoṣāstu ye kecidbhūtadoṣāstathā pare ..
ḍākinīpretavetālā rākṣasā grahapūtanāḥ .. 17 ..
piśācā yātudhānāśca mātaro jātahārikāḥ ..
bālagrahāstathā cānye buddhāścaiva tu ye grahāḥ .. 18 ..
jvarabhūta grahāścānye hyatisārabhagaṃdarāḥ ..
aśmarī mūtrakṛcchraṃ ca rogāścānye sahasraśaḥ .. 19 ..
16.8.d:
तत्र सिद्धिं गमिष्यंति दुर्ल्लभां त्रिदशैरपि ..
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं तल्लिंगं सिद्धिदं परम् .. 19 ..
दुर्ल्लभं सर्वमर्त्त्यानां प्रभासे तु व्यवस्थितम् ..
न च कश्चिद्विजानाति अशुभैः कर्मभिर्वृतः .. 16 ..
ग्रहदोषास्तु ये केचिद्भूतदोषास्तथा परे ..
डाकिनीप्रेतवेताला राक्षसा ग्रहपूतनाः .. 17 ..
पिशाचा यातुधानाश्च मातरो जातहारिकाः ..
बालग्रहास्तथा चान्ये बुद्धाश्चैव तु ये ग्रहाः .. 18 ..
ज्वरभूत ग्रहाश्चान्ये ह्यतिसारभगंदराः ..
अश्मरी मूत्रकृच्छ्रं च रोगाश्चान्ये सहस्रशः .. 19 ..
16.8.m:
will attain perfection there that is difficult to obtain even for the thirty gods. / All this has been declared to you; that liṅga is the supreme bestower of perfection,
difficult to be attained by all mortals, yet situated in Prabhāsa; / and nobody enveloped by impure deeds comprehends it.
Whatever afflictions caused by planets and others caused by evil spirits there are, / ḍākinīs, ghosts, vetālas, rākṣasas, seizing pūtanās,
piśācas, yātudhānas, mothers who snatch newborns, / afflicting spirits of children, and whatever other known seizing spirits,
other spirits of fever, dysentery, fistula in ano, / urinary gravel, strangury, and thousands of other diseases,

16.8.s:
durnāmakāstathā cānye kuṣṭharogāstathā pare ..
kṣayarogāstathā cānye vātagulmāstathaiva ca ..
anye caiva tu ye kecidvyādhayastu prakīrttitāḥ .. 7.1.8.20 ..
16.8.d:
दुर्नामकास्तथा चान्ये कुष्ठरोगास्तथा परे ..
क्षयरोगास्तथा चान्ये वातगुल्मास्तथैव च ..
अन्ये चैव तु ये केचिद्व्याधयस्तु प्रकीर्त्तिताः .. 7.1.8.20 ..
16.8.m: piles, other forms of leprosy, / consumption, flatulent tumours in the abdomen, / and whatever other diseases are proclaimed—

16.8.s:
someśvaraṃ samāsādya tasya liṃgasya darśanāt ..
sarva eva vinaśyaṃti vahnau kṣiptamivendhanam .. 21 ..
16.8.d:
सोमेश्वरं समासाद्य तस्य लिंगस्य दर्शनात् ..
सर्व एव विनश्यंति वह्नौ क्षिप्तमिवेन्धनम् .. 21 ..
16.8.m: upon approaching Someśvara, through the darśana of that liṅga, / all of them perish completely, like fuel cast into fire.

16.8.s:
upasargāśca () cānye sarpaghoṇapavṛścikāḥ ..
sarve tatra vinaśyaṃti śrīsomeśvaradarśanāt .. 22 ..
16.8.d:
उपसर्गाश्च () चान्ये सर्पघोणपवृश्चिकाः ..
सर्वे तत्र विनश्यंति श्रीसोमेश्वरदर्शनात् .. 22 ..
16.8.m: Afflictions and other […] snakes, adders, and scorpions— / all of them are destroyed there by the darśana of glorious Someśvara.

16.8.s:
yo'sau someśvaro nāmnā paścimo bhairavaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
kālāgnirudranātheti paryāyairnāmabhiḥ śrutaḥ .. 23 ..
16.8.d:
योऽसौ सोमेश्वरो नाम्ना पश्चिमो भैरवः स्मृतः ..
कालाग्निरुद्रनाथेति पर्यायैर्नामभिः श्रुतः .. 23 ..
16.8.m: He who is known by the name Someśvara is remembered as the western Bhairava, / heard of through synonymous names such as Kālāgnirudranātha.

16.8.s:
tasmiṃstiṣṭhāmi deveśi bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ ..
sarvaṃ ca duṣkṛtaṃ nṛṇāṃ bhakṣayāmi na saṃśayaḥ .. 24 ..
16.8.d:
तस्मिंस्तिष्ठामि देवेशि भक्तानुग्रहकारकः ..
सर्वं च दुष्कृतं नृणां भक्षयामि न संशयः .. 24 ..
16.8.m: I abide in it, O ruler of the gods, bestowing grace on devotees; / and I consume all the misdeeds of men, without a doubt.

16.8.s:
yo'sau prāṇaḥ śarīrastho dehināṃ dehasaṃcaraḥ ..
brahmāṃḍametadyasyāṃtareko yaścāpyanekadhā .. 25 ..
16.8.d:
योऽसौ प्राणः शरीरस्थो देहिनां देहसंचरः ..
ब्रह्मांडमेतद्यस्यांतरेको यश्चाप्यनेकधा .. 25 ..
16.8.m: He who is the vital breath residing in the body, moving within the body of embodied beings, / inside whom is this cosmic egg, and who is one though many—

16.8.s:
vedāḥ sarve'pi yaṃ devaṃ praśaṃsaṃti maharṣayaḥ ..
parasya brahmaṇo rūpaṃ yasya dvāreṇa labhyate .. 26 ..
16.8.d:
वेदाः सर्वेऽपि यं देवं प्रशंसंति महर्षयः ..
परस्य ब्रह्मणो रूपं यस्य द्वारेण लभ्यते .. 26 ..
16.8.m: that god whom all the Vedas and great seers praise, / through whose doorway the nature of the supreme Brahman is attained,

16.8.s:
so'yaṃ devi mahādevaḥ prabhāse saṃvyavasthitaḥ ..
yathā guptaṃ gṛhe ratnaṃ na kaścidviṃdate naraḥ .. 27 ..
16.8.d:
सोऽयं देवि महादेवः प्रभासे संव्यवस्थितः ..
यथा गुप्तं गृहे रत्नं न कश्चिद्विंदते नरः .. 27 ..
16.8.m: that very Mahādeva, O goddess, is situated in Prabhāsa. / Just as a man does not find a jewel hidden in a house,

16.8.s:
prabhāse tu sthitaṃ tadvadratnabhūtaṃ gṛhe mama ..
tacca liṃgaṃ purā kalpe saptapātālabhedakam .. 28 ..
16.8.d:
प्रभासे तु स्थितं तद्वद्रत्नभूतं गृहे मम ..
तच्च लिंगं पुरा कल्पे सप्तपातालभेदकम् .. 28 ..
16.8.m: so it stands in Prabhāsa like a jewel in my house. / And that liṅga in a former kalpa pierced through the seven netherworlds,

16.8.s:
kathitaṃ koṭi sūryasya pralayānalasaṃnibham ..
tenakālāgnirudreti proktaṃ someśvaraḥ purā .. 29 ..
16.8.d:
कथितं कोटि सूर्यस्य प्रलयानलसंनिभम् ..
तेनकालाग्निरुद्रेति प्रोक्तं सोमेश्वरः पुरा .. 29 ..
16.8.m: and is declared to be equal to ten million suns and the fire of cosmic dissolution; / therefore Someśvara was proclaimed of old as Kālāgnirudra.

16.8.s:
iti devi samāsena kathitaṃ tava pārvati ..
someśvarasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 7.1.8.30 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsamāhātmye śrīsomeśvaraiśvaryavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 8 ..
16.8.d:
इति देवि समासेन कथितं तव पार्वति ..
सोमेश्वरस्य माहात्म्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 7.1.8.30 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासमाहात्म्ये श्रीसोमेश्वरैश्वर्यवर्णनं नामाष्टमोऽध्यायः .. 8 ..
16.8.m:
Thus, O goddess Pārvatī, the māhātmya of Someśvara, / which destroys all sins, has been told to you in brief.
Thus ends the eighth chapter, titled “Description of the Sovereign Power of Śrī Someśvara,” in the first part, the Prabhāsamāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses.

16.9.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
divyaṃ tejo namasyāmi yanme dṛṣṭaṃ purātane ..
kālāgnirudramadhyasthaṃ prabhāse śaṃkarodbhavam .. 1 ..
16.9.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
दिव्यं तेजो नमस्यामि यन्मे दृष्टं पुरातने ..
कालाग्निरुद्रमध्यस्थं प्रभासे शंकरोद्भवम् .. 1 ..
16.9.m:
The Goddess said:
I bow to the divine splendor which I beheld in ancient times,
standing in the midst of Kālāgnirudra, originating from Śaṃkara, at Prabhāsa.

16.9.s:
yo vedasaṃghairṛṣibhiḥ purāṇairvedoktayogairapi ijyamānaḥ ..
taṃ devadevaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi someśvaraṃ pāpavināśahetum .. 2 ..
16.9.d:
यो वेदसंघैरृषिभिः पुराणैर्वेदोक्तयोगैरपि इज्यमानः ..
तं देवदेवं शरणं व्रजामि सोमेश्वरं पापविनाशहेतुम् .. 2 ..
16.9.m:
He who is worshiped by the hosts of the Vedas, by the seers, by the Purāṇas, and by the yogas taught in the Vedas—
in that God of gods, Someśvara, the cause of the destruction of sins, I take refuge.

16.9.s:
devadeva jagannātha bhaktānugrahakāraka ..
saṃśayo hṛdi me kaścittaṃ bhavāñchettumarhati .. 3 ..
16.9.d:
देवदेव जगन्नाथ भक्तानुग्रहकारक ..
संशयो हृदि मे कश्चित्तं भवाञ्छेत्तुमर्हति .. 3 ..
16.9.m:
O God of gods, Lord of the universe, Bestower of grace upon your devotees!
A doubt has arisen in my heart; be pleased to dispel it.

16.9.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kaḥ saṃśayaḥ samutpannastava devi yaśasvini ..
tanme kathaya kalyāṇi tatsarvaṃ kathayāmyaham .. 4 ..
16.9.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
कः संशयः समुत्पन्नस्तव देवि यशस्विनि ..
तन्मे कथय कल्याणि तत्सर्वं कथयाम्यहम् .. 4 ..
16.9.m:
Īśvara said:
What doubt has arisen in you, O glorious Goddess?
Tell me that, O auspicious lady; I shall explain it all to you.

16.9.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
yadi tvaṃ ca mahādevo muṇḍamālā kathaṃ kṛtā ..
anādi nidhano dhātā sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ .. 5 ..
16.9.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
यदि त्वं च महादेवो मुण्डमाला कथं कृता ..
अनादि निधनो धाता सृष्टिसंहारकारकः .. 5 ..
16.9.m:
The Goddess said:
If you are indeed Mahādeva, why have you made a garland of skulls,
[you who are] the creator without beginning or end, the cause of creation and dissolution?

16.9.s:
tato vihasya deveśaḥ śaṃkaro vākyamabravīt ..
anekamuṇḍakoṭībhiryā me mālā virājate .. 6 ..
16.9.d:
ततो विहस्य देवेशः शंकरो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..
अनेकमुण्डकोटीभिर्या मे माला विराजते .. 6 ..
16.9.m:
Then the Lord of gods, Śaṃkara, smiled and spoke these words:
This garland that adorns me with many crores of skulls,

16.9.s: nārāyaṇa sahasrāṇāṃ brahmaṇāmayutasya ca .. kṛtā śiraḥkaroṭībhiranādinidhanā tataḥ .. 7 ..
16.9.d: नारायण सहस्राणां ब्रह्मणामयुतस्य च .. कृता शिरःकरोटीभिरनादिनिधना ततः .. 7 ..
16.9.m:
was made from the skulls of thousands of Nārāyaṇas and tens of thousands of Brahmās;
hence it is without beginning or end.

16.9.s:
anyo viṣṇuśca bhavati anyo brahmā bhavatyapi ..
kalpe kalpe mayā sṛṣṭaḥ kalpe viṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ .. 8 ..
16.9.d:
अन्यो विष्णुश्च भवति अन्यो ब्रह्मा भवत्यपि ..
कल्पे कल्पे मया सृष्टः कल्पे विष्णुः प्रजापतिः .. 8 ..
16.9.m:
In every aeon another Viṣṇu appears, and another Brahmā appears as well;
in aeon after aeon, Viṣṇu and Prajāpati are created by me.

16.9.s:
ahamevaṃvidho devi kṣetre prābhāsike sthitaḥ ..
kālāgniliṃgamūle tu muṃḍamālāvibhūṣitaḥ .. 9 ..
16.9.d:
अहमेवंविधो देवि क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके स्थितः ..
कालाग्निलिंगमूले तु मुंडमालाविभूषितः .. 9 ..
16.9.m:
Such as I am, O Goddess, I abide in the sacred field of Prabhāsa,
at the root of the Kālāgni-liṅga, adorned with a garland of skulls.

16.9.s:
akṣasūtradharaḥ śānta ādimadhyāṃtavarjitaḥ ..
padmāsanastho varado himakundendusannibhaḥ .. 7.1.9.10 ..
16.9.d:
अक्षसूत्रधरः शान्त आदिमध्यांतवर्जितः ..
पद्मासनस्थो वरदो हिमकुन्देन्दुसन्निभः .. 7.1.9.10 ..
16.9.m:
Holding a rosary, tranquil, devoid of beginning, middle, or end,
seated on a lotus seat, granting boons, resembling snow, the kunda flower, or the moon.

16.9.s:
mama vāme sthito viṣṇurdakṣiṇe ca pitāmahaḥ ..
jaṭhare caturo vedāḥ hṛdaye brahma śāśvatam .. 11 ..
16.9.d:
मम वामे स्थितो विष्णुर्दक्षिणे च पितामहः ..
जठरे चतुरो वेदाः हृदये ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् .. 11 ..
16.9.m:
On my left stands Viṣṇu, and on my right stands the Grandfather [Brahmā];
in my belly are the four Vedas, and in my heart is the eternal Brahman.

16.9.s: agniḥ somaśca sūryaśca locaneṣu vyavasthitāḥ .. 12 ..
16.9.d: अग्निः सोमश्च सूर्यश्च लोचनेषु व्यवस्थिताः .. 12 ..
16.9.m: Fire, the moon, and the sun are situated in my eyes.

16.9.s:
evaṃvidho mahādevi prabhāse saṃvyavasthitaḥ ..
āpyatattvātsamānīte mā te bhūtsaṃśayaḥ kvacit .. 13 ..
16.9.d:
एवंविधो महादेवि प्रभासे संव्यवस्थितः ..
आप्यतत्त्वात्समानीते मा ते भूत्संशयः क्वचित् .. 13 ..
16.9.m:
Abiding thus at Prabhāsa, O Great Goddess,
brought forth from the water-principle—let there be no doubt in you anywhere!

16.9.s:
evamuktā tadā devī harṣagadgadayā girā ..
tuṣṭāva devadeveśaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutā .. 14 .. ..
16.9.d:
एवमुक्ता तदा देवी हर्षगद्गदया गिरा ..
तुष्टाव देवदेवेशं भक्त्या परमया युता .. 14 .. ..
16.9.m:
Having been spoken to thus, the Goddess, with a voice choked with joy
and filled with supreme devotion, then praised the Lord of the gods of gods.

16.9.s:
devyuvāca .. .. jaya deva mahādeva sarvabhāvana īśvara ..
namaste'stu sureśāya parameśāya vai namaḥ ..15..
16.9.d:
देव्युवाच .. .. जय देव महादेव सर्वभावन ईश्वर ..
नमस्तेऽस्तु सुरेशाय परमेशाय वै नमः ..15..
16.9.m:
The Goddess said:
Victory, O God, Mahādeva, Source of all beings, Īśvara!
Obeisance to you, Lord of the gods; obeisance indeed to the Supreme Lord!

16.9.s:
anādisṛṣṭikartre ca namaḥ sarvagatāya ca ..
sarvasthāya namastubhyaṃ dhāmnāṃ dhāmne namo'stu te .. 16 ..
16.9.d:
अनादिसृष्टिकर्त्रे च नमः सर्वगताय च ..
सर्वस्थाय नमस्तुभ्यं धाम्नां धाम्ने नमोऽस्तु ते .. 16 ..
16.9.m:
Obeisance to the author of beginningless creation, and obeisance to the all-pervading one!
Obeisance to you who dwell in everything; obeisance to you, the Light of lights!

16.9.s:
ṣaḍaṃtāya namastubhyaṃ dvādaśāntāya te namaḥ ..
haṃsabheda namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ ca mokṣada .. 17 ..
16.9.d:
षडंताय नमस्तुभ्यं द्वादशान्ताय ते नमः ..
हंसभेद नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्तुभ्यं च मोक्षद .. 17 ..
16.9.m:
Obeisance to you who end at the six [centers], obeisance to you who end at the twelve [centers];
obeisance to you who are the distinctions of the haṃsa; obeisance to you, bestower of liberation!

16.9.s:
iti stutastadā devyā pracalaccandraśekharaḥ ..
tatastuṣṭastu bhagavānidaṃ vacanamabravīt.. 18 .. ..
16.9.d:
इति स्तुतस्तदा देव्या प्रचलच्चन्द्रशेखरः ..
ततस्तुष्टस्तु भगवानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्.. 18 .. ..
16.9.m:
Having been praised thus by the Goddess, the Lord who wears the trembling crescent moon
was pleased and spoke these words:

16.9.s:
īśvara uvāca .. ..
sādhusādhu mahāprājñe tuṣṭo'haṃ vriyatāṃ varaḥ .. 19 ..
16.9.d:
ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
साधुसाधु महाप्राज्ञे तुष्टोऽहं व्रियतां वरः .. 19 ..
16.9.m:
Īśvara said:
Well done, well done, O highly wise lady! I am pleased; choose a boon.

16.9.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa varārhā yadi vāpyaham..
prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmyaṃ punarvistarato vada .. 7.1.9.20 ..
16.9.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि देवेश वरार्हा यदि वाप्यहम्..
प्रभास क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यं पुनर्विस्तरतो वद .. 7.1.9.20 ..
16.9.m:
The Goddess said:
If you are pleased, O Lord of gods, or if I am worthy of a boon,
tell me again in detail the greatness of the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.9.s:
bhūteśa bhagavānviṣṇurdaityānāmantakāgraṇīḥ ..
sa kasmāddvārakāṃ hitvā prabhāsakṣetramāśritaḥ .. 21 ..
16.9.d:
भूतेश भगवान्विष्णुर्दैत्यानामन्तकाग्रणीः ..
स कस्माद्द्वारकां हित्वा प्रभासक्षेत्रमाश्रितः .. 21 ..
16.9.m:
O Lord of beings, why did the blessed Viṣṇu, the foremost destroyer of the Daityas,
abandon Dvārakā and resort to the sacred field of Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
ṣaṣṭi tīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca ..
dvārakāmadhyasaṃsthāni kathaṃ nyakkṛtavānhariḥ .. 22 ..
16.9.d:
षष्टि तीर्थसहस्राणि षष्टिकोटिशतानि च ..
द्वारकामध्यसंस्थानि कथं न्यक्कृतवान्हरिः .. 22 ..
16.9.m:
There are sixty thousand sacred fords and sixty thousand crores
situated within Dvārakā; how did Hari cast them aside?

16.9.s:
amarairāvṛtāṃ puṇyāṃ puṇyakṛdbhirniṣevitām ..
evaṃ tāṃ dvārakāṃ tyaktvā prabhāsaṃ kathamāgataḥ .. 23 ..
16.9.d:
अमरैरावृतां पुण्यां पुण्यकृद्भिर्निषेविताम् ..
एवं तां द्वारकां त्यक्त्वा प्रभासं कथमागतः .. 23 ..
16.9.m:
Having thus abandoned that Dvārakā, surrounded by immortals, holy, and served by the performers of meritorious deeds,
how did he come to Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
devamānuṣayornetā dyobhuvoḥ prabhavo hariḥ ..
kimarthaṃ dvārakāṃ tyaktvā prabhāse nidhanaṃ gataḥ .. 24 ..
16.9.d:
देवमानुषयोर्नेता द्योभुवोः प्रभवो हरिः ..
किमर्थं द्वारकां त्यक्त्वा प्रभासे निधनं गतः .. 24 ..
16.9.m:
Hari, the leader of gods and men, the source of heaven and earth—
why did he leave Dvārakā and meet his end at Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
yaścakraṃ varttayatyeko mānuṣāṇāṃ manomayam ..
prabhāse sa kathaṃ kālaṃ cakre cakrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ..25..
16.9.d:
यश्चक्रं वर्त्तयत्येको मानुषाणां मनोमयम् ..
प्रभासे स कथं कालं चक्रे चक्रभृतां वरः ..25..
16.9.m:
How did he, the foremost among wielders of the discus,
who alone sets in motion the mental wheel of men, meet his end at Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
gopāyanaṃ yaḥ kurute jagataḥ sārvalaukikam ..
sa kathaṃ bhagavānviṣṇuḥ prabhāsakṣetramāśritaḥ .. 26 ..
16.9.d:
गोपायनं यः कुरुते जगतः सार्वलौकिकम् ..
स कथं भगवान्विष्णुः प्रभासक्षेत्रमाश्रितः .. 26 ..
16.9.m:
How did the blessed Lord Viṣṇu, who provides protection
for the entire universe, resort to the sacred field of Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
yoṃtakāle jalaṃ pītvā kṛtvā toyamayaṃ vapuḥ ..
lokamekārṇavaṃ cakre dṛṣṭyā dṛṣṭena cātmanā .. 27 ..
16.9.d:
योंतकाले जलं पीत्वा कृत्वा तोयमयं वपुः ..
लोकमेकार्णवं चक्रे दृष्ट्या दृष्टेन चात्मना .. 27 ..
16.9.m:
He who at the time of the cosmic dissolution, drinking up the water and assuming a watery body,
turned the world into a single ocean by his gaze and by his visible self—

16.9.s:
sa kathaṃ pañcatāṃ prāpa prabhāse pārvatīpate ..
yaḥ purāṇe purāṇātmā vārāhaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ .. 28 ..
16.9.d:
स कथं पञ्चतां प्राप प्रभासे पार्वतीपते ..
यः पुराणे पुराणात्मा वाराहं वपुरास्थितः .. 28 ..
16.9.m:
How did he meet death at Prabhāsa, O Lord of Pārvatī?
He who, the ancient Self in the ancient past, assumed the form of a boar

16.9.s:
uddadhāra mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ saśailavanakānanām..
sa kathaṃ tyaktavāngātraṃ prabhāse pāpanāśane .. 29 ..
16.9.d:
उद्दधार महीं कृत्स्नां सशैलवनकाननाम्..
स कथं त्यक्तवान्गात्रं प्रभासे पापनाशने .. 29 ..
16.9.m:
and lifted up the entire earth with its mountains, forests, and groves—
how did he cast off his body at sin-destroying Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
yena siṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ ..
sa kathaṃ devadeveśaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritaḥ .. 7.1.9.30 ..
16.9.d:
येन सिंहं वपुः कृत्वा हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः ..
स कथं देवदेवेशः प्रभासं क्षेत्रमाश्रितः .. 7.1.9.30 ..
16.9.m:
He who, having assumed a lion's form, slew Hiraṇyakaśipu—
how did that God of the gods of gods take refuge in the sacred field of Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
sahasracaraṇaṃ devaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ mahāprabham..
sahasraśirasaṃ vedā yamāhurvai yugeyuge .. 31 ..
16.9.d:
सहस्रचरणं देवं सहस्राक्षं महाप्रभम्..
सहस्रशिरसं वेदा यमाहुर्वै युगेयुगे .. 31 ..
16.9.m:
The God with a thousand feet, a thousand eyes, of great splendor,
with a thousand heads, of whom the Vedas speak in aeon after aeon—

16.9.s:
tatyāja sa kathaṃ devaḥ prabhāse svaṃ kalevaram..
nābhyaraṇyāṃ samudbhūtaṃ yasya paitāmahaṃ gṛham .. 32 ..
16.9.d:
तत्याज स कथं देवः प्रभासे स्वं कलेवरम्..
नाभ्यरण्यां समुद्भूतं यस्य पैतामहं गृहम् .. 32 ..
16.9.m:
how did that God abandon his body at Prabhāsa?
He in the forest of whose navel the abode of the Grandfather arose;

16.9.s:
ekārṇavagate loke tatpaṃkajamapaṃkajam ..
yenoddhṛtaṃ kṣaṇenaiva prabhāsasthaḥ sa kiṃ hariḥ .. 33 ..
16.9.d:
एकार्णवगते लोके तत्पंकजमपंकजम् ..
येनोद्धृतं क्षणेनैव प्रभासस्थः स किं हरिः .. 33 ..
16.9.m:
when the world had turned into a single ocean, that lotus which was freed from mud,
which was lifted up by him in an instant—how did that Hari come to abide at Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
uttarāṃśe samudrasya kṣīrodasyā mṛtodadheḥ ..
yaḥ śete śāśvataṃ yogamāsthāya paravīrahā ..
sa kathaṃ tyaktavāndehaṃ prabhāse parameśvaraḥ .. 34 ..
16.9.d:
उत्तरांशे समुद्रस्य क्षीरोदस्या मृतोदधेः ..
यः शेते शाश्वतं योगमास्थाय परवीरहा ..
स कथं त्यक्तवान्देहं प्रभासे परमेश्वरः .. 34 ..
16.9.m:
He, the slayer of enemy heroes, who slumbers on the northern part of the ocean,
the ocean of milk, the ocean of nectar, taking resort to eternal yoga—
how did that Supreme Lord abandon his body at Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
havyādānyaḥ surāṃścakre kavyādāṃśca pitṝ napi ..
sa kathaṃ devadeveśaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritaḥ .. 35 ..
16.9.d:
हव्यादान्यः सुरांश्चक्रे कव्यादांश्च पितॄ नपि ..
स कथं देवदेवेशः प्रभासं क्षेत्रमाश्रितः .. 35 ..
16.9.m:
He who made the gods consumers of oblations, and the ancestors consumers of ancestral offerings—
how did that God of the gods of gods resort to the sacred field of Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
yugānurūpaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā rūpaṃ lokahitāya vai ..
dharmamuddharate devaḥ sa kathaṃ kṣetramāśritaḥ ..36..
16.9.d:
युगानुरूपं यः कृत्वा रूपं लोकहिताय वै ..
धर्ममुद्धरते देवः स कथं क्षेत्रमाश्रितः ..36..
16.9.m:
He who, assuming a form appropriate for each aeon for the welfare of the world,
upholds dharma—how did that God resort to this sacred field?

16.9.s:
trayo varṇāstrayo lokāstraividyaṃ pāṭhakāstrayaḥ..
traikālyaṃ trīṇi karmāṇi trayo devāstrayo guṇāḥ..
sṛṣṭaṃ yena purā devaḥ sa kathaṃ kṣetramāśritaḥ.. 37 ..
16.9.d:
त्रयो वर्णास्त्रयो लोकास्त्रैविद्यं पाठकास्त्रयः..
त्रैकाल्यं त्रीणि कर्माणि त्रयो देवास्त्रयो गुणाः..
सृष्टं येन पुरा देवः स कथं क्षेत्रमाश्रितः.. 37 ..
16.9.m:
The three castes, the three worlds, the three Vedas, the three reciters,
the three times, the three actions, the three gods, and the three guṇas—
by whom these were created of old: how did that God resort to this sacred field?

16.9.s:
yā gatirddharmayuktānāmagatiḥ pāpakarmiṇām..
cāturvarṇyasya prabhavaścāturvarṇyasya rakṣitā .. 38 ..
16.9.d:
या गतिर्द्धर्मयुक्तानामगतिः पापकर्मिणाम्..
चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य प्रभवश्चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षिता .. 38 ..
16.9.m:
He who is the destination of those endowed with dharma, and the absence of a goal for evil-doers,
the source of the four castes and the protector of the four castes,

16.9.s:
cāturvidyasya yo vettā cāturāśramyasaṃsthitaḥ..
kasmātsa dvārakāṃ hitvā prabhāse paṃcatāṃ gataḥ ..39..
16.9.d:
चातुर्विद्यस्य यो वेत्ता चातुराश्रम्यसंस्थितः..
कस्मात्स द्वारकां हित्वा प्रभासे पंचतां गतः ..39..
16.9.m:
the knower of the four Vedas, the one established in the four stages of life—
why did he leave Dvārakā and meet his death at Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
digaṃtaraṃ nabhobhūmirāpo vāyurvibhāvasuḥ..
caṃdrasūryadvayaṃ jyotiryugeśaḥ kṣaṇadātanuḥ ..7.1.9.40...
16.9.d:
दिगंतरं नभोभूमिरापो वायुर्विभावसुः..
चंद्रसूर्यद्वयं ज्योतिर्युगेशः क्षणदातनुः ..7.1.9.40...
16.9.m:
The directions, the sky, the earth, the waters, the wind, the fire,
the two luminaries, the moon and the sun, the Lord of aeons, whose body is the night;

16.9.s:
yaḥ paraṃ śrūyate jyotiryaḥ paraṃ śrūyate tapaḥ..
yaḥ paraṃ parataḥ proktaḥ paraṃ yaḥ paramātmavān..41..
16.9.d:
यः परं श्रूयते ज्योतिर्यः परं श्रूयते तपः..
यः परं परतः प्रोक्तः परं यः परमात्मवान्..41..
16.9.m:
he who is heard of as the supreme light, who is heard of as the supreme austerity,
who is proclaimed higher than the highest, who possesses the supreme Self—

16.9.s:
ādityādiśca yo divyo yaśca daityāṃtako vibhuḥ..
sa kathaṃ devakīsūnuḥ prabhāse siddhimīyivān ..42..
16.9.d:
आदित्यादिश्च यो दिव्यो यश्च दैत्यांतको विभुः..
स कथं देवकीसूनुः प्रभासे सिद्धिमीयिवान् ..42..
16.9.m: He who is the divine origin of the Ādityas, the all-pervading destroyer of the Daityas— / how did that son of Devakī attain siddhi in Prabhāsa?

16.9.s:
yugāṃte cāṃtako yaśca yaśca lokāṃtakāṃtakaḥ ..
seturyo lokasattānāṃ medhyo yo medhyakarmaṇām .. 43 ..
16.9.d:
युगांते चांतको यश्च यश्च लोकांतकांतकः ..
सेतुर्यो लोकसत्तानां मेध्यो यो मेध्यकर्मणाम् .. 43 ..
16.9.m: He who is the destroyer at the end of the yuga, and the destroyer of the destroyer of the worlds, / who is the bridge for the existence of the worlds, and the pure one among those of pure deeds,

16.9.s:
vettā yo vedaviduṣāṃ prabhuryaḥ prabhavātmanām..
somabhūtastu bhūtānāmagnibhūto'gnivartmanām .. 44 ..
16.9.d:
वेत्ता यो वेदविदुषां प्रभुर्यः प्रभवात्मनाम्..
सोमभूतस्तु भूतानामग्निभूतोऽग्निवर्त्मनाम् .. 44 ..
16.9.m: who is the knower among the knowers of the Veda, the lord among those whose nature is sovereignty, / who has become the moon among beings, and the fire among those whose path is fire,

16.9.s:
manuṣyāṇāṃ manobhūtastapobhūtastapasvinām ..
vinayo nayabhūtānāṃ tejastejasvināmapi ..45..
16.9.d:
मनुष्याणां मनोभूतस्तपोभूतस्तपस्विनाम् ..
विनयो नयभूतानां तेजस्तेजस्विनामपि ..45..
16.9.m: who has become the mind among human beings, and the austerity among the austere, / the humility among those endowed with policy, and the splendor even among the splendid,

16.9.s:
vigraho vigrahāṇāṃ yo gatirgatimatāmapi ..
sa kathaṃ dvārakāṃ hitvā prabhāsakṣetramāśritaḥ..46..
16.9.d:
विग्रहो विग्रहाणां यो गतिर्गतिमतामपि ..
स कथं द्वारकां हित्वा प्रभासक्षेत्रमाश्रितः..46..
16.9.m: who is the embodied form among bodies, and the goal even among those who move— / how did he, abandoning Dvārakā, take refuge in Prabhāsakṣetra?

16.9.s:
ākāśaprabhavo vāyurvāyuprāṇo hutāśanaḥ..
devā hutāśanaprāṇāḥ prāṇo'gnermadhusūdanaḥ ..
sakathaṃ padmajaprāṇaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritaḥ ..47..
16.9.d:
आकाशप्रभवो वायुर्वायुप्राणो हुताशनः..
देवा हुताशनप्राणाः प्राणोऽग्नेर्मधुसूदनः ..
सकथं पद्मजप्राणः प्रभासं क्षेत्रमाश्रितः ..47..
16.9.m: Wind arises from the ether, and the consumer of oblations has wind as his life-breath; / the gods have the consumer of oblations as their life-breath, and Madhusūdana is the life-breath of fire; / how did he, the life-breath of the lotus-born, take refuge in Prabhāsakṣetra?

16.9.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti proktastadā devyā śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ pārvatīṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 48 ..
16.9.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इति प्रोक्तस्तदा देव्या शंकरो लोकशंकरः ..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं पार्वतीं द्विजसत्तमाः .. 48 ..
16.9.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed at that time by the goddess, Śaṃkara, who brings welfare to the world, / laughed and addressed words to Pārvatī, O best of the twice-born:

16.9.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi prabhāsakṣetravistaram ..
rahasyaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ devānāmapi durllabham .. 49 ..
16.9.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रभासक्षेत्रविस्तरम् ..
रहस्यं सर्वपापघ्नं देवानामपि दुर्ल्लभम् .. 49 ..
16.9.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I will explain the extent of Prabhāsakṣetra, / a secret that destroys all sins, hard to attain even for the gods.

16.9.s:
devi kṣetrāṇyanekāni pṛthivyāṃ saṃti bhāmini ..
tīrthāni koṭisaṃkhyāni prabhāvasteṣu saṃkhyayā .. 7.1.9.50 ..
16.9.d:
देवि क्षेत्राण्यनेकानि पृथिव्यां संति भामिनि ..
तीर्थानि कोटिसंख्यानि प्रभावस्तेषु संख्यया .. 7.1.9.50 ..
16.9.m: O goddess, O radiant one, there are many sacred fields on the earth, / and sacred fords by the crores, having power in [measurable] number;

16.9.s:
asaṃkhyeya prabhāvaṃ hi prabhāsaṃ parikīrtitam ..
brahmatattvaṃ viṣṇutattvaṃ raudratattvaṃ tathaiva ca ..51..
16.9.d:
असंख्येय प्रभावं हि प्रभासं परिकीर्तितम् ..
ब्रह्मतत्त्वं विष्णुतत्त्वं रौद्रतत्त्वं तथैव च ..51..
16.9.m: but Prabhāsa is indeed celebrated as having immeasurable power. / The reality of Brahmā, the reality of Viṣṇu, and likewise the reality of Rudra—

16.9.s:
tatra bhūyaḥ samāyogo durllabho'nyeṣu pārvati..
prabhāse devadeveśi tattvānāṃ tritayaṃ sthitam ..52..
16.9.d:
तत्र भूयः समायोगो दुर्ल्लभोऽन्येषु पार्वति..
प्रभासे देवदेवेशि तत्त्वानां त्रितयं स्थितम् ..52..
16.9.m: their combination is further found there, hard to find elsewhere, O Pārvatī. / In Prabhāsa, O ruler of the gods, the triad of principles is present.

16.9.s:
caturviṃśatitattvaiśca brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ..
bālarūpī ca nāmnāṃ ca tatra sthāne sthitaḥ svayam ..53..
16.9.d:
चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वैश्च ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ..
बालरूपी च नाम्नां च तत्र स्थाने स्थितः स्वयम् ..53..
16.9.m: Along with the twenty-four principles, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / having the form of a child and by that name, dwells in that place himself.

16.9.s:
paṃcaviśatitattvānāma dhipo devatāgraṇīḥ ..
tasminsthāne sthitaḥ sākṣāddaityānāmaṃtakaḥ śubhe .. 54 ..
16.9.d:
पंचविशतितत्त्वानाम धिपो देवताग्रणीः ..
तस्मिन्स्थाने स्थितः साक्षाद्दैत्यानामंतकः शुभे .. 54 ..
16.9.m: The overlord of the twenty-five principles, the foremost among the deities, / the destroyer of the Daityas, is directly present in that place, O auspicious one.

16.9.s:
ahaṃ devi tvayā sārddhaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṃyutaḥ ..
nivasāmi mahābhāge prabhāse pāpanāśane .. 55 ..
16.9.d:
अहं देवि त्वया सार्द्धं षट्त्रिंशत्तत्त्वसंयुतः ..
निवसामि महाभागे प्रभासे पापनाशने .. 55 ..
16.9.m: I, O goddess, together with you and united with the thirty-six principles, / dwell in Prabhāsa which destroys sins, O highly fortunate one.

16.9.s:
evaṃ tattvamayaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvatīrthamayaṃ śubham ..
prabhāsameva jānīhi mā kārṣīḥ saṃśayaṃ kvacit .. 56 ..
16.9.d:
एवं तत्त्वमयं क्षेत्रं सर्वतीर्थमयं शुभम् ..
प्रभासमेव जानीहि मा कार्षीः संशयं क्वचित् .. 56 ..
16.9.m: Know Prabhāsa alone to be such an auspicious sacred field consisting of all principles and all sacred fords; / do not entertain doubt anywhere.

16.9.s:
api kīṭapataṃgā ye mriyaṃte tatra ye narāḥ ..
te'pi yāṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 57 ..
16.9.d:
अपि कीटपतंगा ये म्रियंते तत्र ये नराः ..
तेऽपि यांति परं स्थानं नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 57 ..
16.9.m: Even worms, insects, or men who die there, / they too attain the supreme state; there should be no deliberation on this.

16.9.s:
striyo mlecchāśca śūdrāśca paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ..
prabhāse tu mṛtā devi śivalokaṃ vrajaṃti te .. 58..
16.9.d:
स्त्रियो म्लेच्छाश्च शूद्राश्च पशवः पक्षिणो मृगाः..
प्रभासे तु मृता देवि शिवलोकं व्रजंति ते .. 58..
16.9.m: Women, barbarians, Śūdras, beasts, birds, and wild animals— / dying in Prabhāsa, O goddess, they go to the world of Śiva.

16.9.s:
kāmakrodhena ye baddhā lobhena ca vaśīkṛtāḥ ..
ajñānatimirākrāṃtā māyātattve ca saṃsthitāḥ .. 59 ..
16.9.d:
कामक्रोधेन ये बद्धा लोभेन च वशीकृताः ..
अज्ञानतिमिराक्रांता मायातत्त्वे च संस्थिताः .. 59 ..
16.9.m: Those who are bound by desire and anger, enslaved by greed, / overcome by the darkness of ignorance, and abiding in the principle of illusion,

16.9.s:
kālapāśena ye baddhāstṛṣṇājālena mohitāḥ ..
adharmaniratā ye ca ye ca tiṣṭhaṃti pāpinaḥ .. 7.1.9.60 ..
16.9.d:
कालपाशेन ये बद्धास्तृष्णाजालेन मोहिताः ..
अधर्मनिरता ये च ये च तिष्ठंति पापिनः .. 7.1.9.60 ..
16.9.m: those bound by the noose of Time, bewildered by the net of craving, / those devoted to unrighteousness, and whatever sinners remain,

16.9.s:
brahmaghnāśca kṛtaghnāśca ye cānye gurutalpagāḥ ..
mahāpātakinaścāpi te yānti paramāṃ gatim .. 61 ..
16.9.d:
ब्रह्मघ्नाश्च कृतघ्नाश्च ये चान्ये गुरुतल्पगाः ..
महापातकिनश्चापि ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् .. 61 ..
16.9.m: slayers of brahmins, ungrateful people, and others who violate the teacher’s bed, / even perpetrators of the greatest sins—they attain the supreme goal.

16.9.s:
mātṛhaṃtā naro yastu pitṛhaṃtā tathaiva ca ..
te sarve muktimāyāṃti kiṃ punaḥ śubhakāriṇaḥ .. 62 ..
iti jñātvā mahādevi daityānāmaṃtako hariḥ..
prabhāsakṣetramāsādya tyaktavānsvaṃ kalevaram..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prabhāsakṣetre śrīharisthitipraśnavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 9..
16.9.d:
मातृहंता नरो यस्तु पितृहंता तथैव च ..
ते सर्वे मुक्तिमायांति किं पुनः शुभकारिणः .. 62 ..
इति ज्ञात्वा महादेवि दैत्यानामंतको हरिः..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमासाद्य त्यक्तवान्स्वं कलेवरम्..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये प्रभासक्षेत्रे श्रीहरिस्थितिप्रश्नवर्णनं नाम नवमोऽध्यायः .. 9..
16.9.m:
A person who is a slayer of his mother, and likewise a slayer of his father— / they all attain liberation, not to mention those who perform good deeds!
Knowing this, O great goddess, Hari, the destroyer of the Daityas, / reached Prabhāsakṣetra and abandoned his own mortal body. / Thus in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the Samhitā of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the ninth chapter entitled ‘Description of the Question concerning the Abode of Śrī Hari in Prabhāsakṣetra’.

16.10.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
anyacca kathayiṣyāmi rahasyaṃ tava bhāmini ..
yatra kasya cidākhyātaṃ tatte vacmi varānane .. 1 ..
16.10.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अन्यच्च कथयिष्यामि रहस्यं तव भामिनि ..
यत्र कस्य चिदाख्यातं तत्ते वच्मि वरानने .. 1 ..
16.10.m: Īśvara said: / I shall tell you another secret, O radiant one; / I will declare to you that which has been told only to anyone [truly worthy], O fair-faced one.

16.10.s:
pṛthvībhāge sthito brahmā apāṃ bhāge janārddanaḥ ..
tejobhāgasthito rudro vāyubhāge tatheśvaraḥ .. 2 ..
16.10.d:
पृथ्वीभागे स्थितो ब्रह्मा अपां भागे जनार्द्दनः ..
तेजोभागस्थितो रुद्रो वायुभागे तथेश्वरः .. 2 ..
16.10.m: Brahmā is situated in the division of earth; Janārdana is in the division of waters; / Rudra is situated in the division of fire; and likewise Īśvara is in the division of wind;

16.10.s: ākāśabhāgasaṃsthāne sthitaḥ sākṣātsadāśivaḥ .. 3 ..
16.10.d: आकाशभागसंस्थाने स्थितः साक्षात्सदाशिवः .. 3 ..
16.10.m: Sadāśiva is directly situated in the place belonging to the division of ether.

16.10.s:
yasyayasyaiva yo bhāgastasmiṃstīrthāni yāni vai ..
tasyatasya na saṃdehaḥ sa sa eveśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 4 ..
16.10.d:
यस्ययस्यैव यो भागस्तस्मिंस्तीर्थानि यानि वै ..
तस्यतस्य न संदेहः स स एवेश्वरः स्मृतः .. 4 ..
16.10.m: Whatever sacred fords are indeed situated in whichever division, / of each [ford], without doubt, that very one is remembered as the presiding lord.

16.10.s:
chāgalaṃḍaṃ dugaṇḍaṃ ca mākoṭaṃ maṇḍaleśvaram ..
kāliṃjaraṃ vanaṃ caiva śaṃkukarṇaṃ sthaleśvaram .. 5 .. mahābhūtopari ṭippaṇī
16.10.d:
छागलंडं दुगण्डं च माकोटं मण्डलेश्वरम् ..
कालिंजरं वनं चैव शंकुकर्णं स्थलेश्वरम् .. 5 .. महाभूतोपरि टिप्पणी
16.10.m: Chāgalaṇḍa, Dugaṇḍa, Mākoṭa, Maṇḍaleśvara, / Kāliñjara, Vana, Śaṅkukarṇa, Sthaleśvara,

16.10.s:
śūleśvaraṃ ca vikhyātaṃ pṛthvītattve ca saṃsthitam ..
hariścandraṃ ca śrīśailaṃ jalpeśonnāṃtikeśvaram.. 6 ..
16.10.d:
