शूलेश्वरं च विख्यातं पृथ्वीतत्त्वे च संस्थितम् ..
हरिश्चन्द्रं च श्रीशैलं जल्पेशोन्नांतिकेश्वरम्.. 6 ..
16.10.m: and the renowned Śūleśvara are situated in the earth principle. / Hariścandra, Śrīśaila, Jalpeśa, Unmāntikeśvara,

16.10.s:
mahākālaṃ madhyamaṃ ca kedāraṃ bhairavaṃ tathā ..
pavitrāṣṭakametaddhi jalasaṃsthaṃ varānane .. 7 ..
16.10.d:
महाकालं मध्यमं च केदारं भैरवं तथा ..
पवित्राष्टकमेतद्धि जलसंस्थं वरानने .. 7 ..
16.10.m: Mahākāla, Madhyama, Kedāra, and Bhairava— / this group of eight holy [tīrthas] is situated in water, O fair-faced one.

16.10.s:
amareśaṃ prabhāsaṃ ca naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā ..
āṣāḍhiṃ caiva daṇḍiṃ ca bhārabhūtiṃ ca lāṃgalam .. 8 ..
16.10.d:
अमरेशं प्रभासं च नैमिषं पुष्करं तथा ..
आषाढिं चैव दण्डिं च भारभूतिं च लांगलम् .. 8 ..
16.10.m: Amareśa, Prabhāsa, Naimiṣa, Puṣkara, / Āṣāḍhi, Daṇḍi, Bhārabhūti, and Lāṅgala—

16.10.s:
ādi guhyāṣṭakaṃ hyetattejastattve pratiṣṭhitam ..
gayā caiva kurukṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ tathā .. 9 ..
16.10.d:
आदि गुह्याष्टकं ह्येतत्तेजस्तत्त्वे प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
गया चैव कुरुक्षेत्रं तीर्थं कनखलं तथा .. 9 ..
16.10.m: this primeval secret group of eight is established in the fire principle. / Gayā, Kurukṣetra, and the tīrtha Kanakhala,

16.10.s:
vimalaṃ cāṭṭahāsaṃ ca māhendraṃ bhīmasaṃjñakam ..
guhyādguhyataraṃ hyetatproktaṃ vāyvaṣṭakaṃ tava .. 7.1.10.10 ..
16.10.d:
विमलं चाट्टहासं च माहेन्द्रं भीमसंज्ञकम् ..
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं ह्येतत्प्रोक्तं वाय्वष्टकं तव .. 7.1.10.10 ..
16.10.m: Vimala, Aṭṭahāsa, Māhendra, and that named Bhīma— / this group of eight of the wind, more secret than the secret, has been spoken to you.

16.10.s:
vastrāpathaṃ rudrakoṭirjyeṣṭheśvaraṃ mahālayam ..
gokarṇaṃ rudrakarṇaṃ ca varṇākhyaṃ sthāpasaṃjñakam .. 11 ..
16.10.d:
वस्त्रापथं रुद्रकोटिर्ज्येष्ठेश्वरं महालयम् ..
गोकर्णं रुद्रकर्णं च वर्णाख्यं स्थापसंज्ञकम् .. 11 ..
16.10.m: Vastrāpatha, Rudrakoṭi, Jyeṣṭheśvara, Mahālaya, / Gokarṇa, Rudrakarṇa, Varṇākhya, and that named Sthāpasa—

16.10.s:
pavitrāṣṭakametaddhi ākāśasthaṃ varānane ..
etāni tattvatīrthāni sarvāṇi kathitāni vai .. 12 ..
16.10.d:
पवित्राष्टकमेतद्धि आकाशस्थं वरानने ..
एतानि तत्त्वतीर्थानि सर्वाणि कथितानि वै .. 12 ..
16.10.m: this group of eight holy [tīrthas] is situated in ether, O fair-faced one. / All these tīrthas corresponding to the principles have indeed been declared.

16.10.s:
yo yasmindevatā tattve sā tanmāhātmyasūcikā ..
audakaṃ ca mahātattvaṃ viṣṇoścātipriyaṃ priye .. 13 ..
16.10.d:
यो यस्मिन्देवता तत्त्वे सा तन्माहात्म्यसूचिका ..
औदकं च महातत्त्वं विष्णोश्चातिप्रियं प्रिये .. 13 ..
16.10.m: Whichever deity resides in whichever principle, that [tīrtha] indicates his greatness. / The great watery principle is exceedingly dear to Viṣṇu, O beloved.

16.10.s:
jalaśāyī smṛtastena nārāyaṇa iti śrutiḥ ..
āpyatattvaṃ tu tīrthāni yāni proktā- ni te mayā .. 14..
16.10.d:
जलशायी स्मृतस्तेन नारायण इति श्रुतिः ..
आप्यतत्त्वं तु तीर्थानि यानि प्रोक्ता- नि ते मया .. 14..
16.10.m: Therefore he is remembered as reclining on water, called Nārāyaṇa according to sacred scripture. / The tīrthas belonging to the water principle which have been spoken by me to you,

16.10.s:
tāni priyāṇi deveśi dhruvaṃ nārāyaṇasya vai ..
audakaṃ caiva yattattvaṃ tasminprābhāsikaṃ smṛtam .. 15 ..
16.10.d:
तानि प्रियाणि देवेशि ध्रुवं नारायणस्य वै ..
औदकं चैव यत्तत्त्वं तस्मिन्प्राभासिकं स्मृतम् .. 15 ..
16.10.m: they are certainly dear to Nārāyaṇa, O ruler of the gods. / And the watery principle is remembered as belonging to Prabhāsa.

16.10.s:
tatra devo layaṃ yāti harirjanmanijanmani ..
sa vāsudevaḥ sūkṣmātmā parātparatare sthitaḥ .. 16 ..
16.10.d:
तत्र देवो लयं याति हरिर्जन्मनिजन्मनि ..
स वासुदेवः सूक्ष्मात्मा परात्परतरे स्थितः .. 16 ..
16.10.m: There the divine Hari enters dissolution birth after birth. / He is Vāsudeva, subtle-souled, situated beyond what is beyond the highest.

16.10.s:
sa śivaḥ paramaṃ vyoma anādinidhano vibhuḥ ..
tasmātparataraṃ nāsti sarvaśāstrāgameṣu ca .. 17 ..
16.10.d:
स शिवः परमं व्योम अनादिनिधनो विभुः ..
तस्मात्परतरं नास्ति सर्वशास्त्रागमेषु च .. 17 ..
16.10.m: He is Śiva, the supreme firmament, omnipresent, without beginning or end; / there is nothing higher than that in all the scriptures and Āgamas,

16.10.s:
siddhāṃtāgamavedāṃtadarśaneṣu viśeṣataḥ ..
teṣu caiva na bhinnastu mayā sārddhaṃ yaśasvini .. 18 ..
16.10.d:
सिद्धांतागमवेदांतदर्शनेषु विशेषतः ..
तेषु चैव न भिन्नस्तु मया सार्द्धं यशस्विनि .. 18 ..
16.10.m: especially in the views of the Siddhāntas, Āgamas, and the Vedānta. / And in them he is indeed not distinct from me, O illustrious one.

16.10.s:
tasminsthāne hariḥ sākṣātpratyakṣeṇa tu saṃsthitaḥ ..
liṃgaiścaturbhiḥ saṃyukto jñāyate na ca kenacit .. 19 ..
16.10.d:
तस्मिन्स्थाने हरिः साक्षात्प्रत्यक्षेण तु संस्थितः ..
लिंगैश्चतुर्भिः संयुक्तो ज्ञायते न च केनचित् .. 19 ..
16.10.m: In that place Hari is directly present visibly; / joined with four liṅgas, he is not recognized by anyone.

16.10.s:
mokṣārthaṃ naiṣṭhikairvarṇairvrataiścaiva tu yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti bhallukātīrthadarśanāt.. 7.1.10.20 ..
16.10.d:
मोक्षार्थं नैष्ठिकैर्वर्णैर्व्रतैश्चैव तु यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति भल्लुकातीर्थदर्शनात्.. 7.1.10.20 ..
16.10.m: Whatever fruit is attained by lifelong practitioners of the orders of society and by vows for liberation, / one obtains that fruit from the darśana of Bhallukātīrtha.

16.10.s:
gocarmamātraṃ tatsthānaṃ samaṃtātparimaṇḍalam ..
na hi kaścidvijānāti vinā śāstreṇa bhāmini.. 21 ..
16.10.d:
गोचर्ममात्रं तत्स्थानं समंतात्परिमण्डलम् ..
न हि कश्चिद्विजानाति विना शास्त्रेण भामिनि.. 21 ..
16.10.m: That place measures merely a gocarma, circular all around. / Indeed, no one knows it without the scripture, O spirited lady.

16.10.s:
viṣuvaṃ vahate tatra nṛṇāmadyāpi pārvati ..
paṃcaliṃgāni tatraiva paṃcavaktrāṇi kāni cit .. 22 ..
16.10.d:
विषुवं वहते तत्र नृणामद्यापि पार्वति ..
पंचलिंगानि तत्रैव पंचवक्त्राणि कानि चित् .. 22 ..
16.10.m: Even today the equinox is observed there by men, O Pārvatī. / Five liṅgas are situated right there, some having five faces,

16.10.s:
kukkuṭāṃḍakamānāni mahāsthūlāni kānicit..
sarpeṇa veṣṭitānyeva cihnitāni triśūlibhiḥ .. 23 ..
16.10.d:
कुक्कुटांडकमानानि महास्थूलानि कानिचित्..
सर्पेण वेष्टितान्येव चिह्नितानि त्रिशूलिभिः .. 23 ..
16.10.m: some the size of a hen's egg, and some exceedingly massive, / wrapped with serpents and marked with tridents.

16.10.s:
teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa koṭiliṃgārcanaphalam ..
tasmādidaṃ mahākṣetraṃ brahmādyaiḥ sevyate sadā ..24 ..
16.10.d:
तेषां दर्शनमात्रेण कोटिलिंगार्चनफलम् ..
तस्मादिदं महाक्षेत्रं ब्रह्माद्यैः सेव्यते सदा ..24 ..
16.10.m: From merely beholding them comes the fruit of worshipping ten million liṅgas. / Therefore this great sacred field is always frequented by Brahmā and the other [gods],

16.10.s:
śrutimadbhiśca vipreṃdraiḥ saṃsiddhaiśca tapasvibhiḥ ..
pratimāsaṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ pratimāsaṃ caturdaśīm .. 25 ..
16.10.d:
श्रुतिमद्भिश्च विप्रेंद्रैः संसिद्धैश्च तपस्विभिः ..
प्रतिमासं तथाष्टम्यां प्रतिमासं चतुर्दशीम् .. 25 ..
16.10.m: and by eminent brahmins learned in the Vedic scriptures, and by perfected ascetics. / Every month on the eighth day, and every month on the fourteenth,

16.10.s:
śaśibhānūparāge vā kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ..
prabhāsasthāni liṃgāni prapūjyante varānane .. 26 ..
16.10.d:
शशिभानूपरागे वा कार्त्तिक्यां तु विशेषतः ..
प्रभासस्थानि लिंगानि प्रपूज्यन्ते वरानने .. 26 ..
16.10.m: or during an eclipse of the moon or the sun, and especially on the full-moon day of Kārttika, / the liṅgas situated in Prabhāsa are worshipped, O fair-faced lady.

16.10.s:
saṃnihatyāṃ kurukṣetre sarvastīrthāyutaiḥ saha ..
puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ caivaṃ prayāgaṃ saṃpṛthūdakam ..27..
16.10.d:
संनिहत्यां कुरुक्षेत्रे सर्वस्तीर्थायुतैः सह ..
पुष्करं नैमिषं चैवं प्रयागं संपृथूदकम् ..27..
16.10.m: At the Saṃnihitā pool in Kurukṣetra, along with tens of thousands of all sacred fords, / Puṣkara, Naimiṣa, and likewise Prayāga, together with Pṛthūdaka,

16.10.s:
ṣaṣṭi tīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca ..
māghyāṃmāghyāṃ sameṣyaṃti sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame .. 28 ..
16.10.d:
षष्टि तीर्थसहस्राणि षष्टिकोटिशतानि च ..
माघ्यांमाघ्यां समेष्यंति सरस्वत्यब्धिसंगमे .. 28 ..
16.10.m: sixty thousand sacred fords and six billion [more] / will arrive at every full moon of Māgha at the confluence of the Sarasvatī and the ocean.

16.10.s:
smaraṇāttasya tīrthasya nāmasaṃkīrtanādapi ..
mṛtyukālabhavādvāpi pāpaṃ tyakṣyati suvrate .. 29 ..
16.10.d:
स्मरणात्तस्य तीर्थस्य नामसंकीर्तनादपि ..
मृत्युकालभवाद्वापि पापं त्यक्ष्यति सुव्रते .. 29 ..
16.10.m: From the remembrance of that sacred ford and from reciting its name, / or even at the moment of death, one will cast off sin, O lady of good vows.

16.10.s:
ānarttasāraṃ saumyaṃ ca tathā bhuvanabhūṣaṇam ..
divyaṃ pāṃcanadaṃ puṇyamādiguhyaṃ mahodayam .. 7.1.10.30 ..
16.10.d:
आनर्त्तसारं सौम्यं च तथा भुवनभूषणम् ..
दिव्यं पांचनदं पुण्यमादिगुह्यं महोदयम् .. 7.1.10.30 ..
16.10.m: The essence of Ānarta, gentle, and the ornament of the world, / divine, possessing five rivers, meritorious, the primordial secret, highly prosperous,

16.10.s:
siddha ratnākaraṃ nāma samudrāvaraṇaṃ tathā..
dharmākāraṃ kalādhāraṃ śivagarbhagṛhaṃ tathā ..31..
16.10.d:
सिद्ध रत्नाकरं नाम समुद्रावरणं तथा..
धर्माकारं कलाधारं शिवगर्भगृहं तथा ..31..
16.10.m: named Siddharatnākara ('the ocean of perfections'), enclosed by the ocean, / the source of dharma, the support of arts, the inner sanctum of Śiva,

16.10.s:
sarvadevaniveśaṃ ca sarvapātakanāśanam..
asya kṣetrasya nāmāni kalpe kalpe pṛthakpriye .. 32 ..
16.10.d:
सर्वदेवनिवेशं च सर्वपातकनाशनम्..
अस्य क्षेत्रस्य नामानि कल्पे कल्पे पृथक्प्रिये .. 32 ..
16.10.m: the dwelling place of all gods, and the destroyer of all sins— / such are the names of this sacred field in each kalpa, O dear one.

16.10.s:
āyāmādīni jānīhi guhyāni surasundari ..
ādye kalpe purā devi pramodanamiti smṛtam .. 33 ..
16.10.d:
आयामादीनि जानीहि गुह्यानि सुरसुन्दरि ..
आद्ये कल्पे पुरा देवि प्रमोदनमिति स्मृतम् .. 33 ..
16.10.m: Know the secret [names] denoting its expanse and the like, O beautiful lady among goddesses: / In the first kalpa of old, O goddess, it was known as Pramodana.

16.10.s:
nandanaṃ paritastasya tasyāpi parataḥ śivam ..
śivātparataraṃ cograṃ bhadrikaṃ parataḥ punaḥ .. 34 ..
16.10.d:
नन्दनं परितस्तस्य तस्यापि परतः शिवम् ..
शिवात्परतरं चोग्रं भद्रिकं परतः पुनः .. 34 ..
16.10.m: Around it, Nandana; and beyond that, Śiva; / more transcendent than Śiva, Ugra; and beyond that again, Bhadrika;

16.10.s:
samiṃdhanaṃ paraṃ tasmātkāmadaṃ ca tataḥ param ..
siddhidaṃ cāpi dharmajñaṃ vaiśvarūpaṃ ca muktidam.. 35 ..
16.10.d:
समिंधनं परं तस्मात्कामदं च ततः परम् ..
सिद्धिदं चापि धर्मज्ञं वैश्वरूपं च मुक्तिदम्.. 35 ..
16.10.m: Samindhana beyond that, and Kāmada beyond that; / Siddhida, Dharmajña, Vaiśvarūpa, and Muktida;

16.10.s:
tathā śrīpadmanābhaṃ tu śrīvatsaṃ tu mahāprabham..
tathā ca pāpasaṃhāraṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ tathā .. 36 ..
16.10.d:
तथा श्रीपद्मनाभं तु श्रीवत्सं तु महाप्रभम्..
तथा च पापसंहारं सर्वकामप्रदं तथा .. 36 ..
16.10.m: likewise Śrīpadmanābha, and Śrīvatsa of great splendour; / and likewise Pāpasaṃhāra, and Sarvakāmaprada;

16.10.s:
mokṣamārgaṃ varā rohe tathā devi sudarśanam ..
dharmagarbhaṃ tu dharmāṇāṃ prabhāsaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
ataḥ paraṃ bhavantīha utpalāvarttikāni ca .. 37 ..
16.10.d:
मोक्षमार्गं वरा रोहे तथा देवि सुदर्शनम् ..
धर्मगर्भं तु धर्माणां प्रभासं पापनाशनम् ..
अतः परं भवन्तीह उत्पलावर्त्तिकानि च .. 37 ..
16.10.m: Mokṣamārga, O slender-waisted lady, and likewise, O goddess, Sudarśana; / Dharmagarbha among the dharmas, and Prabhāsa, the destroyer of sin; / subsequent to this are the Utpalāvartikas.

16.10.s:
kṣetrasya madhye yaddevi mama garbhagṛhaṃ smṛtam ..
tasya nāmāni te devi kathitānyanupūrvaśaḥ .. 38 ..
16.10.d:
क्षेत्रस्य मध्ये यद्देवि मम गर्भगृहं स्मृतम् ..
तस्य नामानि ते देवि कथितान्यनुपूर्वशः .. 38 ..
16.10.m: That which is known as my inner sanctum in the middle of the sacred field, O goddess— / its names have been declared to you in succession, O goddess.

16.10.s:
śrutvā nāmānyaśeṣāṇi kṣetramāhātmyameva ca ..
teṣāṃ tu vāṃchitā siddhi rbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 39 ..
16.10.d:
श्रुत्वा नामान्यशेषाणि क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यमेव च ..
तेषां तु वांछिता सिद्धि र्भविष्यति न संशयः .. 39 ..
16.10.m: Having heard all the names and the māhātmya of the sacred field, / their desired perfection will come to pass, without a doubt.

16.10.s:
etatkīrttayamānasya trikālaṃ tu mahodayam ..
saṃdhyākālāṃtaraṃ pāpamahorātraṃ vinaśyati .. 7.1.10.40 ..
16.10.d:
एतत्कीर्त्तयमानस्य त्रिकालं तु महोदयम् ..
संध्याकालांतरं पापमहोरात्रं विनश्यति .. 7.1.10.40 ..
16.10.m: For one reciting this great prosperity at the three junctures of the day, / the sin [accrued] in the interval between the twilight periods, day and night, is destroyed.

16.10.s:
api vai dāṃbhikāścaiva ye vasaṃtyalpabuddhayaḥ ..
mūḍhā jīvanikā viprāste'pi yāṃti mṛtā divam .. 41 ..
16.10.d:
अपि वै दांभिकाश्चैव ये वसंत्यल्पबुद्धयः ..
मूढा जीवनिका विप्रास्तेऽपि यांति मृता दिवम् .. 41 ..
16.10.m: Even hypocrites of little intellect who dwell [there], / fools, and brahmins seeking a livelihood—even they, upon dying, go to heaven.

16.10.s:
asya kṣetrasya madhye tu raviyojanamadhyataḥ ..
upakṣetrāṇi deveśi saṃtyanyāni sahasraśaḥ .. 42 ..
16.10.d:
अस्य क्षेत्रस्य मध्ये तु रवियोजनमध्यतः ..
उपक्षेत्राणि देवेशि संत्यन्यानि सहस्रशः .. 42 ..
16.10.m: Within this sacred field, across twelve yojanas, / there are thousands of other secondary fields, O queen of gods.

16.10.s:
kānicitpadmarūpāṇi yavākārāṇi kānicit ..
ṣaṭkoṇāni trikoṇāni daṇḍākārāṇi kānicit .. 43 ..
16.10.d:
कानिचित्पद्मरूपाणि यवाकाराणि कानिचित् ..
षट्कोणानि त्रिकोणानि दण्डाकाराणि कानिचित् .. 43 ..
16.10.m: Some are lotus-shaped, some shaped like barley grains, / hexagonal, triangular, and some rod-shaped,

16.10.s:
caṃdrabiṃbārddhabhedāni caturasraprabhedataḥ ..
brahmādidaivatānīśe kṣetramadhye sthitāni tu .. 44 ..
16.10.d:
चंद्रबिंबार्द्धभेदानि चतुरस्रप्रभेदतः ..
ब्रह्मादिदैवतानीशे क्षेत्रमध्ये स्थितानि तु .. 44 ..
16.10.m: shaped like a half-moon disc, or differentiated as quadrangles. / Deities beginning with Brahmā, O ruler, are situated in the middle of the sacred field.

16.10.s:
kānicidyojanārddhāni tadardhārdhāni kānicit ..
nivarttanapramāṇena daṇḍamānena kānicit ..45 ..
16.10.d:
कानिचिद्योजनार्द्धानि तदर्धार्धानि कानिचित् ..
निवर्त्तनप्रमाणेन दण्डमानेन कानिचित् ..45 ..
16.10.m: Some measure half a yojana, some a quarter of that, / some the measure of a nivartana, some the measure of a staff,

16.10.s:
gocarmamānamadhyāni kāniciddhanuṣāṃtaram ..
yajñopavītamātrāṇi prabhāse saṃti koṭiśaḥ .. 46 ..
16.10.d:
गोचर्ममानमध्यानि कानिचिद्धनुषांतरम् ..
यज्ञोपवीतमात्राणि प्रभासे संति कोटिशः .. 46 ..
16.10.m: some the measure of a gocarma, some the span of a bow, / and some merely the size of a sacred thread; they exist by the millions in Prabhāsa.

16.10.s:
aṃgulyaṣṭama bhāgo'pi nabhosti kamalekṣaṇe ..
na saṃti yasmiṃstīrthāni divyāni ca nabhastale .. 47 ..
16.10.d:
अंगुल्यष्टम भागोऽपि नभोस्ति कमलेक्षणे ..
न संति यस्मिंस्तीर्थानि दिव्यानि च नभस्तले .. 47 ..
16.10.m: There is not even the eighth part of an inch in the space, O lotus-eyed lady, / in which there are not sacred fords, divine and in the sky.

16.10.s:
prabhāsakṣetramāsādya tiṣṭhaṃti pralayādanu ..
kedāre caiva yalliṃgaṃ yacca devi mahālaye .. 48 ..
16.10.d:
प्रभासक्षेत्रमासाद्य तिष्ठंति प्रलयादनु ..
केदारे चैव यल्लिंगं यच्च देवि महालये .. 48 ..
16.10.m: Having reached Prabhāsa-kṣetra, they remain after dissolution. / The liṅga that is at Kedāra and that which is at Mahālaya, O goddess,

16.10.s:
madhyameśvarasaṃsthaṃ ca tathā pāśupateśvaram ..
śaṃkukarṇeśvaraṃ caiva bhadreśvaramathāpi ca .. 49 ..
16.10.d:
मध्यमेश्वरसंस्थं च तथा पाशुपतेश्वरम् ..
शंकुकर्णेश्वरं चैव भद्रेश्वरमथापि च .. 49 ..
16.10.m: that situated at Madhyameśvara, and likewise Pāśupateśvara, / Śaṅkukarṇeśvara, and also Bhadreśvara,

16.10.s:
some śvaramathaikāgraṃ kāleśvaramajeśvaram ..
bhairaveśvaramīśānaṃ tathā kāyāvarohaṇam .. 7.1.10.50 ..
16.10.d:
सोमे श्वरमथैकाग्रं कालेश्वरमजेश्वरम् ..
भैरवेश्वरमीशानं तथा कायावरोहणम् .. 7.1.10.50 ..
16.10.m: Someśvara, then Aikāgra, Kāleśvara, Ajeśvara, / Bhairaveśvara, Īśāna, and likewise Kāyāvarohaṇa,

16.10.s:
cāpaṭeśvarakaṃ puṇyaṃ tathā badarikāśramam ..
rudrakoṭirmahākoṭi stathā śrīparvataṃ śubham ..51..
16.10.d:
चापटेश्वरकं पुण्यं तथा बदरिकाश्रमम् ..
रुद्रकोटिर्महाकोटि स्तथा श्रीपर्वतं शुभम् ..51..
16.10.m: the meritorious Cāpaṭeśvara, and likewise Badarikāśrama, / Rudrakoṭi, Mahākoṭi, and auspicious Śrīparvata,

16.10.s:
kapālī caiva deveśaḥ karavīraṃ tathā punaḥ ..
oṃkāraṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ vaśiṣṭhāśramameva ca ..
yatra koṭiḥ smṛtā devi rudrāṇāṃ kāmarūpiṇām .. 52 ..
16.10.d:
कपाली चैव देवेशः करवीरं तथा पुनः ..
ओंकारं परमं पुण्यं वशिष्ठाश्रममेव च ..
यत्र कोटिः स्मृता देवि रुद्राणां कामरूपिणाम् .. 52 ..
16.10.m: Kapālin the lord of gods, Karavīra, and then again / Omkāra of supreme merit, and Vaśiṣṭhāśrama— / where ten million Rudras of wish-assuming form are remembered, O goddess—

16.10.s:
yāni cānyāni sthānāni puṇyāni mama bhūtale ..
prayāgaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā prabhāse nivasaṃti ca .. 53 ..
16.10.d:
यानि चान्यानि स्थानानि पुण्यानि मम भूतले ..
प्रयागं पुरतः कृत्वा प्रभासे निवसंति च .. 53 ..
16.10.m: and whatever other meritorious places of mine there are on the earth's surface / dwell in Prabhāsa, placing Prayāga at their head.

16.10.s:
uttare raviputrī tu dakṣiṇe sāgaraṃ smṛtam ..
dakṣiṇottaramāno'yaṃ kṣetrasyāsya prakīrttitaḥ .. 54 ..
16.10.d:
उत्तरे रविपुत्री तु दक्षिणे सागरं स्मृतम् ..
दक्षिणोत्तरमानोऽयं क्षेत्रस्यास्य प्रकीर्त्तितः .. 54 ..
16.10.m: The daughter of the sun on the north, and the ocean is recorded on the south; / this north-south dimension of this sacred field has been proclaimed.

16.10.s:
rukmiṇyāḥ pūrvataścaiva taptatoyācca paścime ..
pūrvapaścimamāno'yaṃ prabhāsasya prakīrttitaḥ .. 55 ..
16.10.d:
रुक्मिण्याः पूर्वतश्चैव तप्ततोयाच्च पश्चिमे ..
पूर्वपश्चिममानोऽयं प्रभासस्य प्रकीर्त्तितः .. 55 ..
16.10.m: East of Rukmiṇī and west of Taptatoyā; / this east-west dimension of Prabhāsa has been proclaimed.

16.10.s:
etadantaramāsādya tīrthāni surasundari ..
pātālādikaṭāhāṃtaṃ tāni tatra vasaṃti vai .. 56 ..
16.10.d:
एतदन्तरमासाद्य तीर्थानि सुरसुन्दरि ..
पातालादिकटाहांतं तानि तत्र वसंति वै .. 56 ..
16.10.m: Arriving within this interval, the sacred fords, O beautiful lady among goddesses, / extending from Pātāla to the cosmic cauldron, indeed dwell there.

16.10.s:
evaṃ jñātvā mahādevi sarvadevamayo hariḥ ..
prabhāsakṣetramāsādya tatyāja svaṃ kalevaram .. 57 ..
16.10.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा महादेवि सर्वदेवमयो हरिः ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमासाद्य तत्याज स्वं कलेवरम् .. 57 ..
16.10.m: Knowing thus, O great goddess, Hari, composed of all gods, / arrived at Prabhāsa-kṣetra and cast off his mortal body.

16.10.s:
divyaṃ mamedaṃ caritaṃ hi raudraṃ śroṣyaṃti ye parvasu vā sadā vā ..
te cāpi yāsyaṃti mama prasādāttriviṣṭapaṃ puṇyajanādhivāsam .. 58 ..
16.10.d:
दिव्यं ममेदं चरितं हि रौद्रं श्रोष्यंति ये पर्वसु वा सदा वा ..
ते चापि यास्यंति मम प्रसादात्त्रिविष्टपं पुण्यजनाधिवासम् .. 58 ..
16.10.m: Those who hear this divine, awe-inspiring account of mine on festival days or at all times, / they too shall go, through my grace, to heaven, the dwelling of the virtuous.

16.10.s:
iti kathitamaśeṣameva citraṃ caritamidaṃ tava devi puṇyayuktam ..
itaramapi tavātivallabhaṃ yadvada kathayāmi mahodayaṃ munīnām .. 59 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prabhāsa kṣetrastha tīrthakṣetramāhātmyadvārā prabhāsakṣetrasya sarvakṣetrottamatvavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ..10..
16.10.d:
इति कथितमशेषमेव चित्रं चरितमिदं तव देवि पुण्ययुक्तम् ..
इतरमपि तवातिवल्लभं यद्वद कथयामि महोदयं मुनीनाम् .. 59 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये प्रभास क्षेत्रस्थ तीर्थक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यद्वारा प्रभासक्षेत्रस्य सर्वक्षेत्रोत्तमत्ववर्णनंनाम दशमोऽध्यायः ..10..
16.10.m:
Thus this wondrous, meritorious account has been told to you in its entirety, O goddess; / speak of what else is very dear to you, that I may tell [you of] that great fortune of sages.
Thus ends the tenth chapter, named 'The Description of the Supremacy of Prabhāsa-kṣetra over All Sacred Fields by Means of the Māhātmya of the Sacred Fords in Prabhāsa-kṣetra', in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
